tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rje btsun mid la ras pa'i rnam par thar pa nyi zla'i 'od zer sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rje btsun mid la ras pa'i rnam par thar pa nyi zla'i 'od zer sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rje btsun mid la ras pa'i rnam par thar pa nyi zla'i 'od zer sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo rat+na gu ru bh+yaḥ gang gis mthong thos dran reg gyur pa yis// 'jig rten srid pa'i mun pa 'joms byed nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs// rigs kyi bdag po rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud// grangs med tshogs bsags spangs rtogs mtha' ru phyin// lha dang mi sogs mkha' mnyam yongs kyi dpal// bstan bdag ston pa chen por gyur pa yi// shākya seng ge de la gus pas 'dud// rgyal dang de'i sras rgyan drug mchog brgyad sogs// gang 'dod re skong thabs chen du ma yis// las can gdul bya dag pa'i sa la (248)'god// 'dzam gling mkhas grub rnams la gus pas 'dud// tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i gdung chen 'dzin// byang sems rnam gnyis 'gro la chos spyan gzigs// rim gnyis theg pas skal ldan lam sna 'dren// bod khams bka' brgyud rnams la gus pas 'dud// zhe sdang lam slong 'gyod sems drag po yis// bla ma'i bka' bsgrubs dka' thub pha rol phyin// rlung sems dbang 'dus bstan pa'i ba dan phyar// mi la ras chen zhabs la gus pas 'dud// dngos grub rnam gnyis dad brtson can la ster// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i gang bsam (249)nye bar bsgrub// log 'dren bgegs 'joms bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i// mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gus pas 'dud// mkhas grub bla ma dam pas ci gsung bsgrub// ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar// de srid skad cig le lo mi byed par// shes rab rnam gsum blo gros rab 'byongs pa'i// phyogs dus chos mdzad yongs la gus pas 'dud// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus par// ma rig sgrib gnyis rtsad nas rab bsam ste// rang rig bde chen sku gsum stsal du gsol// 'o na sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de yi don du lam dam pa'i chos zhus la nyams su blang snyam pa thugs bskyed kyi zin par mdzad par zhu/

de yang skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma yin pas/ gang rung cig gis mi chog pas/ 'bung sha bton nas rdo rus thug pa cig byed dgos pa lags pas/ bka' chad lung rdum lam log ston pa'i slob dpon dang mi phrad pa 'di gal che'o ang*/ de yang bka' mdo rgyud nas bshad pa byed (250)na/ sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs la sogs pa'i/ rgyal ba dgongs rgyud kyi byung khungs bshad gzhung gtam rgyud dang bcas pa rnams la dper na cu gang dar la gtsags pa'am/ nam mkha' dwangs pa la gza' skar bkra ba ltar du zhib la rgyas pa zhig byed tshul/ de la dgos don ci yod zer na/ khungs btsun yid ches pa/ mu stegs byed la sogs lam log pa rnams kyis rang gar mi tshud pa yin no// bstan bcos la bshad pa byed na rgya gar grub chen lnga brgya'am/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'am/ lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'am/ mdor na rgyan drug mchog brgyad la sogs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang rgyud brda' 'grol dang bcas pa rnams la/ dper na 'tsho byed mkhas pa'i sman sgro bzhin du ma nor la grangs tshang ba zhig dgos so// de la dgos don ci yod zer na/ gang zag blo cing rnams kyis thob rdzun dang*/ ra chod gzu lums mi chud cing*/ bka' brgyud dang byin rlabs la ru mi tra zhugs pa yin/ zab don dmar dbyangs ma rim gnyis kyi sgo nas/ lam khrid (251)gsum gyi sgo nas srang su 'jug na/ dper na spyi dgos bye brag bka' bstan bcos phyogs med kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi rigs rus dka' spyad dang*/ yon tan rnams la dper na bal pos rdo sgrib pa'am mda' mkhan gyi mig bzhin byed 'tshal/ de la dgos pa ci yod zer na/ gang zag ya rabs rnams kyi gsal 'debs su 'gro ba dang*/ phal pa rnams blo kha 'khrid pa dang*/ snying rus bskyed pa dang*/ ma rabs rigs chad rnams la yang las 'brel chud pa yin no// de yang da res 'dis bla ma mid la ras pa zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de'i lo rgyus la rnam pa gnyis kyis ston pa la/

dang po rigs dang rus/ gnyis pa chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa'i yon tan gyi gsal byed gnyis lags so// gdung rus chen po bco brgyad kyi nang tshan be ri yin la/ de'i nang tshan khyung tsha yin la/ khyung tsha la stod smad gnyis yod pa'i nang tshan khyung tsha stod pa phu bo'i rgyud/ khyung tsha stod pa yin la/ de'i nang tshan 'brog pa mi tshang cig la bu chung mid la tsakras zin pa'i ltas ngan cig skyes pa la/ bon po mkhas pa zhig bos nas/ ltas ngan bzlog pa'i mid la chu sel byas pas ltas ngan bzlog nas/ bu chung sha lus rgyas nas legs (252)por song ba dang*/ ming yang mid la g.yang blon rgyal po bya bar btags skad do// de'i bu mid la g.yu rung rgyal yin la/ de'i bu mid la bkra shis rgyal po de la stod byang na yar phyin nas/ bcung pa'i 'og skyid pa phug ring nas khyim thab ci ga byas nas bsdad pas bu rdo rje rgyal po skyes pa la/ rang bzhin mi gzhi dga' mo zhig yod cing*/ rogs dga' ches nas sho rtses pas/ cho lo pham nas nor yod tshad shor nas mnga' ris gung thang gi tsa pa nyang mi cig dang shag po byas nas/ tshur yongs nas rgyal lnga yul gyi tsa rong gi mkhar sgong thang na/ dge bshes tsa pa grags pa bsod nams kyi/ dbon mo cig gnang ba la/ bu tsha ming sring lnga skyes pa'i bu che ba'i ming mid la rin rgyal yin la/ chung ba mid la sher rgyal yin/ bu mo che ba sgron skyid/ de 'og sgron chung*/ de 'og sgron ne yin/ rin rgyal la sru chung cig chung mar blangs pa la/ bu drug bu mo gsum dang mi sring dgu tsam skyes/ gser sku dang gsung rab rgyas 'bring rnam gsum dang*/ dkon brtsegs la sogs chos mang po bzhengs nas bzhugs pa'i rgyas 'bring rnam gsum gyis 'go byas pa'i cha rkyen mang rab rin rgyal la phogs byas la/ sher rgyal lo bcu bdun lon pa'i dus na/ (253)dge bshes tsa pa'i dbon mo nyang bzang dkar legs zer ba de sru chung yin pas gnyen byas nas/

lo bco brgyad lon pa dang bsu tshis yin pa la/ mid la rdo rje rgyal po bza' tsho gnyis kha shi nas lo bcu dgu lon dus na/ dkar legs lo nyi shu rtsa gcig lon pa de bag mar blangs nas/ pha ma'i shul gyi nor mdo sde dkon brtsegs kyis 'go byas pa'i nor thams cad sher rgyal la phogs byas pa la/ rin rgyal gyi chung ma na re rang re bu tsha mang po yod pa dang*/ cha rkyen chung du song ba dang*/ da rung sring mo chung ba gnyis kyang rang res rdzong dgos pa la/ pha ma'i shul gyi nor yod tshad sher rgyal la byin pa de ma legs zer nas/ rin rgyal la ngo gnag shing 'thab sha byas kyang gtad tshar nas byed thabs med par song skad/ de nas stag gi lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i snga dro dkar legs la bu zhig btsas skyes pa la/ dge bshes tsa pa grags bsod pas/ ming klu grub mgon bya bar btags/ bus lo gsum dang zhag bdun lon dus su bu mo cig skyes pa la/ mgon po skyid bya bar btags la/ yar tshar shing glen ma 'dra ba cig byung bas pe ta zer ba yin/ lha bon pa zhang po dge bshes tsa pa rang legs skad/ bus ni glu srung (254)byed mi mthong na de la dga' bas pha ma'i char mi chags par rtsed mo la 'gro zhing kho rang yang glu srung len pa cig byung bas der ming yang thos pa dga' bya bar grags/ 'di yang gtam rgyud gnyis yod pa rnam thar chen mor gsal zhing*/ der bus lo gsum dang zla ba bzhi lon/ bu mos zla ba bzhi lon dus na/ dkar legs lo nyis shu rtsa bzhi lon pa dang*/ sher rgyal lo nyi shu rtsa gcig lon dus su der shi bas/ dge rtsa bzang po byas kyang da rung cha rkyen chen po yod la/ de nas dkar legs lo nyi shu rtsa bdun lon pa dang*/ pho gnyen mo gnyen tshogs nas gros byas nas/ da yugs sa yang sangs pas/ dkar len rin rgyal gyi bu dang dus cig sdod dgos zer ba la/ dkar legs na re sher rgyal 'dra ba'i skyes pa shi nas bu tshab 'di gnyis mi skyong bar da ngas tshe 'di la skyes pa gzhan dang sdod ri zer nas/

mna' bskyal nas nyan du ma 'dod/ der rin rgyal gyis khyod nga'i bu dang mi sdod na/ ngas nor tsho len zer nas gsung rab dkon brtsegs kyis 'go byas pa'i nor thams cad khyer ba dang*/ nye du thams cad kyang rin rgyal bden zer nas dkar legs la 'thab skad/ dge bshes tsa pas (255)dkar legs kyi phyogs mdzad nas kha bzung yang nye mnyam du song bas bya thabs tsam yang ma byung nas ma smad gsum nan tar sdug par yod pa las/ rje btsun de dus lo lnga pa yin zer/ de nas dkar legs kyi pha ma gnyis kar shi nas sngar las kyang sdug tu song yod par 'dug la/ de nas rje btsun lo bdun lon pa dang*/ dge bshes tsa pa'i drung du bzhag nas ma smad gnyis po khang stong der sdod pa la zas gos ci yang med/ yul mi khyim mtshes rnams kyis kyang dkar legs la khyod skud po'i bu dang mi sdod pa zer nas 'thab cing shin tu sdug pa'i tshod du song la/ dge bshes tsa pa la yang nye du rnams kyis thos pa dga' sdod du ma 'jug zer nas skur ba 'debs so// rje btsun ni de dus na yang thugs rgyus che bas klog bzang po shes yod par 'dug /mas bkal thags byed/ pe tas yas 'dra len byed pa la/ rin rgyal pha spad bza' tsho rnams kyis ni/ rje btsun dang pe ta gar mthong yang rdo rdeg par byed cing*/ dkar legs la yang rdung ni mi phod de/ kha ngan tshig ngan zlos te/ de nas dge bshes pas kyang thugs kyis mi phod na yang*/ thos pa dga' da khyod snying rje bar 'dug ste/ da 'gro dgos par 'dug gsung ste bton nas btang*/ (256)de dus na rje btsun lo bcu bdun pa yin gsung*/ ma smad gsum sdug rir shi la khad nas yod dus sngar gyi go mi zhig gis chang rgyu cig byin pa de btsos te/ nye du rnams bsags nas khu bo la blud nas da nged ma smad la nor dum cig blang byas pas dum cig ster ba skad zer ba la bu smad kyi bsgyur nas ster du ma 'dod/

de nas rje btsun gyi glu len/ pe tas yas len/ lam zan 'dra blangs/ mas bka' thags byed cing*/ gos med zas med la tshe ye ma phyid nas/ yang dge bshes pa dang sngar gyi go mi ma des phag tu nas bre do byin pa de chang btsos nas khu bo la khong mi gzhan gyis ni/ nyon spu btsong spu ngo len byed cing yang 'dug pa nga rang dag mo nor la rten spang chog ste/ khyed rang gi tsha yug 'di kun ltogs rir shi ba la dgos pa ci yod byas nas zhu ba byas pas kho chang gi bzi se byas nas nan tar rang yin na ma smad gsum kar bsad na ci yin zer ste dkar legs la rdo cig brgyab/ rje btsun rdog ril byas nas do bsad/ pe ta sgo na mar bros nas bya rgyu med cing*/ khu bo song tsa na ma smad gsum tshogs nas ngu yin yod tsa na/ yang sgo tsa na mi cig slebs grags pa dang*/ yang khu bo yin bsam (257)nas bu tsha gnyis ngu yin bsdad/ mas gri dang ber ka gzung nas bkras khar sgugs pas khu bo min par go mi bza' rgyu 'dra khyer nas sems gso ba la yong ba yin par 'dug zer/ 'di la ni dus phyis kyang rje btsun chen pos go mi de rigs drug nas legs par 'don pa'i gnyer ka nga la yod pa yin/ yang yang gsung skad/ de dus na kho bo dag a cang che ste/ a ne kun ngan par byung gsung*/ gar phyin pa na yang khu bo tshang dang 'phrad dogs pa'i sems khral chen po yod gsung skad/ der nyin gcig ni ma phar ri na yar me shing 'thu yin yod tsa na/ mi tshang cig gis mdos cig bskyal ba la pe tas yas len du phyin pas gtor ma la bsnyabs pas lag pa khyi'i kha shor bas khyi'i mgo la rdog pa brgyab pas khyis lag pa btang nas 'doms na tshur bsnyabs te mo mtshan la phug pas sdug skad chen po shor ba dang mas thur la rgyugs nas yongs pas/ pha ri'i sbal pa kha gdangs can du rbab la 'gril bas/ kha ngo brag la phog nas kha so chag /lus po nyag nyog du song nas bu mo'i rtsar slebs nas bsdongs ste yar yong tsa na/

rje btsun rtsa phu na yar skyur srun la song na pha spun (258)tsho dang phrad pas brdungs shing rdog ril byas/ mgo bcag nas mar yong ba dang*/ ma smad gsum kar lam ka na khrag tsa re 'dzoms pas/ thos pa dga' ni da rung glu len cing 'dug pa dang*/ mas a ngas khyod 'dra ba'i bsam rlag can cig yod pa ang*/ rang re ma smad gsum las sdug pa sa steng na med/ khu bos gsod la thug cing las 'di la slebs nas yod pa la/ khyod da rung glu len pa rang dran rgya che ba byas nas ngus pas/ rje btsun yug pa zhig kha rog bsdad nas 'dug la/ de nas 'o na a ma da ci byas pa drag /yang na da rung a mas khu bo'i bu dang yug cig bsdad nas/ nor dum cig lon pa dang de nas rang re ma smad gar shed bros na drag gam zer bas/ mas sa sbar gang bu'i ngo la gtor/ mo rang gi brang la khu tshur rgyab nas ngu zhing*/ pha sher rgyal 'dra ba la bu khyod 'dra skye ba/ nga rin rgyal gyi bu dang yug cig bsdad nor len ran tsa na/ nga'i lus la bu tsha cig tshud pa dang*/ khyed ming sring gnyis ltogs ris shi ba cig mi yong ngam zer nas ngu yin yod tsa na/ dge bshes tsa pa dang sngar sher rgyal gyi mi mna' bcad yin zer ba'i shag po cig dang*/ go mi ma de dang gsum po (259)yongs nas/ ma smad gsum gyi khrag tsho phyis/ rma la sngags btab/ bza' rgyu 'dra byin nas sems gso yin yod pa la/ khu bo bza' tsho rnams kyi mi res ber ka re khyer yong nas/ shag po dang go mi ma gnyis la rgyab/ dge bshes pa la yang a khu bas nged la khyad gsod byed pa zhan/ mi shi ba kun la yong ste/ dkar legs 'dis nged la sma dbabs chen po byas/ mo kha na so ma brjes pa'i gna' ma yugs sar lus pa la/ nga'i bu la sdod ma nyan zer nas ngar ba dang*/ khong gnyis po bros nas song*/ dge bshes pa thugs khros te/ rin rgyal la khyod nan tan rang nga rgyal che na/ ngas nor tsho phrogs nas jo bo la gtad/

khyed rang rnam 'ba' di re bton na ci yin/ dkar legs 'dra ba'i las su la yong ba/ bu tsha ltogs rir bzhag nas nor khyer bas mi chog par da rung khyod nga rgyal che ba/ mo bu tsha'i thog na sdug sgur byas pa min pa/ skyes pa gzhan la song ba ni ma yin zer nas/ dge bshes pa khros pa dang*/ dge bshes pa yul mi kha drag tu song ba dang*/ mid la tshang mi 'khyams su song bas ci yang smra ma phod zer bas 'di la ni dus phyis kyang*/ mid la'i zhal nas zhang po de sku drin che gsung skad/ dus (260)phyis rje btsun cung pa che'u chung na byon dus/ yon bdag mo legs gsal 'bum gyis nged bud med bya ba 'di nyon mongs pa shas che ba yin te/ rje btsun gyi yum de ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rang yin par gda' zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni cha med de/ skud po sos ka'i bong reng 'dra ba khyu cig bzhag nas/ gna' ma yugs sa mo lo nyer bzhi ma kha na so ma brjes ma cig nyal rogs pus mo la byas pa de nga'i ma tsam du mi 'dug gam gsung skad/ de nas ma smad gsum ye rang sdug tshe phyir ma ster nas/ nyin cig dkar legs kyis bu la da sdod pas ni rang res khu bo ba rnams mi thub par 'dug pas/ khyod kyis yi ge 'dra shes par 'dug pas/ da mthu 'dra bslab nas byed pa las ma shes byas pas/ mid la na re a mas rgyags ster nas ngas dag mthu yong ste zer skad/ de dus rje btsun dgung lo bco brgyad pa yin zer/ mid la la na re bla ma mid las mang gung bar du rku jag 'ga' re byas zer te de ni blun gtam yin no// de nas dgung lo bcu brgyad pa la/ mas mo rang gi nor zhing cig yod pa de yang btsongs la dkar legs rang gi nye du rnams la slongs cig kyang byas nas/ gzhan yang phan chas dam dum (261)dngas chos ldang drug dang bcas pa rnams rta kham ste la grags la bkal nas/ mang gung nas rogs mi lnga byung ba dang 'grogs te/

dpal mo rong kha thug pa mas skyel pa la phyin nas/ ma na re khyod mthu shes nas kyang yar ma yong cig /mthu ma byas pa la yang gsod pa la mthu byas ni rting sod pa la the tshom med do// khyed rogs rnams kyis kyang kho yar khrid ma yong cig /ma gi rang du sdod cig zer nas/ ngas kyang rgyags 'dra ci slob bya yi zer nas/ yar log nas song ba dang*/ rogs rnams na re nged tsho la yang dgra drag po snying na ba mang rab yod te/ khyod kyi bzhin ni med zer skad/ mid la'i dgongs pa la nga'i ma de snying re rje/ yar res lam la rogs ni med/ de 'khyags nas 'chi'am/ spyang kus za'am bsam pa byung gsung skad/ de nas mar la mthu su che 'dri yin byon pas/ yar lung skyur po grong gi gnyag g.yung ston khro rgyal zer nas/ kha rag gi la la phyin pas la mtho la brtan pa'i spyi rgya/ ban bon gyi mthu rgya yod bya ba bris 'dug pas/ su'i yin dris pas g.yung ston gyi yin zer bas/ lam rgya la phyin nas/ g.yung ston la rta dang*/ ltang tshe dang bcas pa dus cig la thams cad phul nas/ mthu zhus pas/ khong (262)na re nga la mthu zhu ba mang po byung ste/ khyod bzhin 'bul ba sngon la byed pa mi yong bar 'dug /der ngas kyang 'phral rang cag ster snying yang mi 'dod par 'dug /khyod thag ring nas kyang yongs nas 'bul ba yang sngon la byed pa la/ mthu gsha' ma cig ma byin na mir gar 'dod/ lar mthu gsha' ma cig slob na dag zla ba re re'am/ zla ba phyed dam/ zhag bcu re tsam gyis shes pa yod de/ 'on kyang slob dpon de can yun 'di tsam bsdad zer ba yang dgos pa yin pas/ khyod rang la rgyags ni 'dug pas yug tsam sdod zer bas/ der bsdad pa la mthu yong yong 'dra ba kha tshabs can mang po bslabs nas/ rogs rnams yar chas pa dang*/ mi la 'gro ma nyan pa dang*/ gnyag gis khyod mi 'gro ba ci yin gsungs pas/ nga la 'gro sa med zer nas/ sngar khu bo pha spad kyis ngan byas pa'i lo rgyus rnams bshad nas ngus pas/

rogs rnams theg pa dang*/ gnyag na re nga la mthu zhu ba mang po byung ste khyod las snying rje ba ma byung bas/ khyod la mthu gsha' ma cag rang dgos par 'dug pas/ sngar gyi de rnams la mthu mi yong ba ni min/ yong ni yong ste nga rang gis lag len byed pa cig yod pa de/ (263)gtsang g.yas ru rta nag gi bon po zhig la byin nas gzhan su la'ang mi ster bar byas/ kho'i ser ba cig khong la ngas bslabs nas gzhan su la'ang mi ster bar byas pa yin pas/ da khyod der btang dgos zer nas/ rta dkar ru cig la gos tshos sdang cig bkal nas gnyag gi bu dang gnyis btang nas/ bu de la pha jo na re mi 'di snying rje bar 'dug pas/ mthu gsha' ma cig dgos par 'dug pas/ nged la sbyin dbang med pas/ nyid kyis gnang bar zhu zer cing 'dug byas nas gnyer gtad pas/ bon pos lo rgyus dris pas/ mid las sdug gtam btang nas ngus pa dang*/ bon po na re khyod la mthu gsha' ma cig cis kyang dgos par 'dug zer nas bon po'i bu dang gnyis g.yog cig dang gsum mtshams bcad du bcug nas/ mthu yong bar 'dug zer ba dang*/ yab rang gis zla ba gcig mtshams bcad pas/ mthu ni chog par byung ste/ de dus na khu'i bu la bag ma blangs pa'i ston mo byas pa'i phyi mi rnams gyes/ nang mi rnams ma gyes pa la sprang pos sgo brdungs pas/ 'og khang gi ka ba la rta btags pa 'drogs nas/ ka ba 'gyel nas khang pa rdibs pas/ mi thams cad dkrugs (264)shi'o// ma shi ba nyag nyog kun yang nga thos pa dgas mthu btang ba yin zer nas kha smra yin byung la/ gcag shor ram zer ba de a ne smon skyid yin zer/ lar mi nyis shu rtsa gcig shi zer nas yul pa rnams na re/ dang po dag kho bden te/ da mi 'di tsam bsad/ yul pa phung la btang bas/ 'di gsod pa'i sngan zan cig btang dgos par 'dug byas te gros byas pas/ de pa'i gtso bos chang gi bzi ba'i brla chol la thos pa dga' 'dis mi mang po bsad/

yul pa phung la btang bas 'di gsod pa'i sngan zan cig btang dgos par 'dug zer ba dang*/ gtso bo'i chung ma des thos pas/ de dang po mid la sher rgyal gyi go mi ma byas pa yin pas/ mos ma phod nas dkar legs la bya btang bas/ dkar legs skrag nas sngan zan cig btsal bas/ yul thag ring rab cig nas rnal 'byor pa don 'grub shes rab bya ba cig brnyed nas/ de la mas khyod kyis go bcad nas 'dir mthu ni slebs te/ yul pa rnams kyis khyod gsod pa'i gros zin yod pas/ su la yang blo ma gtod par zon gyis byas nas btang bas/ mid la skrag ste/ bon po la zhus pas/ bon po na re nga la thabs yod zer nas/ yi ge bris nas khyod yul pa (265)rnams kyis nga gsod pa'i gros byed gyin 'dug ste/ de'i gong du nga'i chos bsrungs kyis tshor nas byung bas/ da nga bsad pas gsod dam yang lta/ khyed rnams bsad pas 'dzad dam yang lta/ khyed la srog dang ser ba gnyis ka byed pa yin byas nas/ yi ge bskur nas btang bas/ gung thang pa rnams kyi mi phrad tshad la ston/ la btsas dang lam 'phrang rnams la yi ge thob byas nas btang bas/ de yul pa rnams kyi thos nas/ da bsad pas gsod par mi 'dug la/ mngon shes kyang yod par 'dug pas/ da dums byed dgos zer ba dang*/ gros byed rnams kyang shi/ lar snga phyi gnyis la skyes pa rang yang bzhi cu zhe gcig tsam shi la/ spyir grong khyim bcu bdun gyi sgo rdib zer/ de nas gnyag gi drung du phyin nas mthu ni byung yod par 'dug lags te/ khong rnams kyis nga gsod zer bas ser ba gcig gtong bar zhu byas pas/ kho pa mi bden pas 'gro ba 'dul ba la ser ba dgos pas/ ser ba byed dgos gsungs nas/ gnyag gi sras po dang thos pa dga' gnyis mtshams la bcug nas/ zhag nyer gcig nas phebs pa'i rtags byung bas/ da tsam lo thog ji tsam yod gsungs pas/ yur ma snga phyi'i bar (266)tsam yod byas pas/ 'o na da khyod la rogs cig dgos pa la de yang bang rta bas kyang mgyogs pa/

shed gyad pas kyang che ba cig dgos pa de nga'i g.yog 'di la tshang yod pa yin gsung nas/ mi nag po mthong ba tsam gyis kyang zil chum byed pa zhig rogs la btang ste/ de chos skyong 'dzim mgon po yin par 'dug ste/ de mid las kyang phyis min pa ma shes gsung*/ gung thang na yur ma snga phyi'i bar tsam la slebs nas/ nub mo zhing la ser tho btsugs nas/ nyin mo ri kha nas mthu 'phangs pas/ ser ba chen po phebs te/ ri lung thams cad gangs su song nas ma thar bas/ ri la bsdad pas khyi ra ba mthong nas/ yul pa la skad btang nas ded pas/ rogs de na re 'dir bsdad na gnyis kar gsod pa las med zer te/ rgyags dogs nas zla ba phyed na ding ri'i gnang chung cig tu 'tshogs dus byas te/ rogs mid nag po des mid lar brdzus te ral gri drangs nas bros pas/ yul pa rnams kyis de'i rjes la ded pas/ mid las de'i tshe lam gzhan cig nas bros te/ phyi snyegs byung gis dogs pas snya nam ngos la bros pas/ zhag bcu bdun gyi nyin bar ti thung gnas chung du slebs pa dang/ pho le (267)ma rnams 'dir mgron po cig byung ngam dris pas/ rogs cig sgugs pa yin zer ba cig 'dug pa de ni/ da lta ni ston mo la srur song yug cig nas yong zer ba dang*/ khong gis sha zan cig khyer nas byung bas/ khong na re ma dang khyod rmis nas di ring bsdad pa yin/ yong ngam bsam nas di ring ma slebs na nga nang par 'gro rtsis yin/ de tsam thogs pa ci yin zer bas/ kha bas rkang pa phyid/ do shi byas pas ma thar ba lags byas/ de nas mar lam rta nag tu phyin pas mas kyang rgyags bong khal cig bskyal nas 'dug zer/ de nas yar lung na slebs pas gnyag na re ser ba phebs sam gsung*/ phebs byas pas/ da thebs cig tsam phab pas yul mi rnams thul nas 'gro ba yin/ da res yar 'gro mi dgos/ thun kha gsos pas chog gsung nas gnyag gi sras po dang mid la gnyis kyis zhag gsum mtshams bcad pas/

gung thang na snye ma rdzogs tsam de la ser ba che nges pa cig phab pas/ ri rdo thams cad klung du phab/ klung rdo thams cad chu la pho bas/ mi la grogs po bya ba'i grogs po chen po rnams byung gda'/ de nas gung thang tsam pa rnams la lo re la ser ba thengs gnyis gnyis kyis lo bdun (268)ston thog la ma re cig byas nas la btsas dang lam 'phrang la btags nas bzhag go /de'i dus na ma de yang shi zer ba thos pas/ thos pa dgas ngus pas gnyag dang bon po gnyis kyis sems gsos sdug zan gnang nas zhal ta mdzad zer/ dus phyis kyang mid la'i zhal nas/ slob dpon gnyis po de'i bka' drin la bsam na da rung yid la cag go yod gsung nas/ skabs su spyan chab byon skad do// gnas skabs cig tu gnyag g.yung ston khro rgyal de sprang po cig shi ba la thugs skyo ba skyes nas nyin gcig ni bshums te/ kho de thos pa dga' khyod kyis kyang mthu dang ser ba de tsam byas/ mi nor sems can grangs med pa la gnod pa chen po byas/ sdig pa chen po bsags/ khyod kyi rin la nged rnams 'khor bcas la yang sdig pa mang po dgos pas/ da ni khyod rang sdig bshags la chos cig byas pa drag /rang re shi ba'i dus na chos min pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan gsungs pa dang*/ der thos pa dga' chos byed pa de las dga' ba med lags te/ slob dpon rnam gnyis las sku drin che ba med pas/ nga la nor longs spyod kyi zhabs tog ni byed rgyu med pas/ g.yog dang khol po byas la drin (269)lan 'bul ba bsam pa lags zhus pas/ khong na re de yang yin te/ chos cig rang byung na khyod rang la yang de las phan che ba med/ nged la yang phan che gsung ba la/ 'o na slob dpon bon po la yang zhal ta zhu dgos byas pas/ de 'thad gsung nas bon po la gnyag gis 'di skad gsung zhus pas/ bon pos kyang dang po spyan chab byon te/ de nas ngas kyang de rang bsams de byas pas rang re thams cad la phan gsung*/

de nas der gnyag dang bon po la sku khams zhus pas/ gnang sbyin dang skyel thung yang mdzad cing*/ spyan chab yang byon nas/ khyod la snying rus chen po 'dug kyang 'dug ste/ da rung chos la snying rus bskyed gsung skad/ der gdams ngag su che dris nas thams cad la rtsad bcad pas/ rong khu lung gi na/ rje ye shes gzungs/ chos mkhas gdams ngag che zer nas/ de'i drung du gshin rje'i skor dang drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag la sogs gdams ngag mang bar zhus/ de nas nyang stod kho re na/ ba mi byang chub rgyal po'i drung du rgyu 'phrul zhus/ de nas nyang stod rgyan mkhar na/ gyer ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyi drung du rdzogs chen snga 'gyur zhus/ yar 'brog glang bu do ru/ mar pa 'byung gnas ye shes kyi drung du mdo sems phyogs dang mdo rgyu (270)'phrul zhus/ de nas nyang stod khu le dang rong g.yu phug gi dgon pa gnyis na bzhugs pa'i bla ma 'dre ston lha dga' ba dpal gyi drung du phyin nas sngar gyi mthu byas pa'i lo rgyus rnams zhus nas/ bdag sdig po che cig lags pas gdams ngag thugs la 'dogs par zhu byas pas/ khong gi zhal nas bu khyod bsod nams rab cig 'dug /nged kyi bka' rdzogs pa chen po 'di/ chos theg pa rim pa dgu'i yang rtse/ rtsa ba brtan pas gzhi gtan la phebs pa/ rtse mo byung rgyal yin pas 'bras bu grub rgyu med pa/ zur bzhi logs brgyad rtse mo dpal dang dgu/ kha gser kha dang g.yu kha yin la/ nang rtogs na nang sangs rgyas/ nub rtogs na nub sangs rgyas gsung nas/ 'di las lhag pa'i chos ni gzhan gang na yang med zer nas/ der 'o na slob dpon rnam gnyis kyi zhal nas mthu la tshegs med gsung tsa na yang sla mor 'dug pas/ da sangs rgyas sam de yang sla rab yong ngam bsam nas blo bde 'bol le song nas lo gcig tsam bsdad nas chos 'dra nyan/ dpe 'dra bris pas lag len byed rgyu tsam ma rnyed par yod tsa na/

nyin gcig ni bla ma 'dre ston skyems gsol nas bad pa'i dus cig na/ thos (271)pa dga' 'di sa na mi su 'dug gsung bas/ su mi 'dug zhus pas/ kho de khyod kyang sdig po che rang cig 'dug go /nged kyi chos 'dis kyang en tsam byung ngo*// gzhi rang gcig pu'i steng du lus/ lta ba kha ltar song*/ sgom pa nyams kyis rtsi bral/ spyod pa la bogs ma thon/ 'bras bu la bsngo ba'i rgyas ma thebs/ 'dis kyang bag mi yong bar 'dug gsung skad/ der thos pa dgas 'o na bla ma rang kha sing ni/ nged kyi chos 'di theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse/ nang rtogs na nang sangs rgyas/ nub rtogs na nub sangs rgyas/ 'di las lhag pa med gsung ba byas pas/ khong na re de kun bla ma gong ma'i gsung sgros rkyang pa yin/ nged kyi snga 'gyur 'di lta ba'i 'khyer so dag legs pa cig 'dug ste/ byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa chad pas/ nga rang la yang ci zer cha med do// ya ki lho brag bya ba na/ rje btsun mar pa lo tsā bya ba/ rgya gar du lan gsum byon pa/ nā ro dang mai tri la sogs pa'i grub thob mang po dang mjal nas gsang sngags pha rgyud kyi gdams ngag rtsa rlung dang thig le'i rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas byed pa cig yod par 'dug pas/ khyod der 'gro ba drag pas/ (272)nga yang 'gro ba yin te nga rgas pas rtsa rlung bsgoms par mi nus pas/ phyi ma la smon lam btab gsung*/ der mtshan mo ma bde bar nyal/ nang par snga dro zhal ta dang gnang sbyin blangs nas/ phye slud bu gang gi steng du gdams ngag gi ka ba li bzhag nas khur te lho brag tu phyin nas/ sa stegs na sleb pa dang*/ ban rgan cig spang rko yin 'dug pa la/ bdag bla ma mar pa'i drung du mjal ba lags pas zhu 'phrin cig mdzod dang byas pas/ des sa la ri mo cig bris nas 'di brkos zin pa dang 'gro zer/ der zin dus ma byung nas ngas rko yis byas nas la 'ur brkos nas da 'byon par zhu byas pas yang sngar las kyang che ba zhig bris nas 'di zin pa dang 'gro zer bas/

de bas habs se brkos pas/ mi las ka yong ba cig 'dug zer nas/ thang theb cig gi 'og nas chang ma sham gshor ma gang bton nas phor gang blugs nas khong rang gsol/ de'i lhag ma thos pa dga' la blud nas tog tsam phrag pa la bkal nas song ba'i phyi na phar phyin pas/ mi mang rab kyi rgyang nas phyag 'tshal gyin 'dug pa la/ 'di yang zur chos pa'i dge bshes cig yin nam bsam/ khyod rang der sdod (273)dang ngas 'phrin byed zer nang du gshegs song*/ yug cig nas mi cig btang nas yar shog zer te phyin tsa na/ da ci'i ban rgan de 'bol grum cig gi thog na bhir re/ sen bar 'dag pa khel le 'dug pa dang*/ en tsam ngo tsha nas sa la sdod ma phod par/ krang nge langs nas yod pa la/ skrag mi dgos nga so nam byed zer ba ma tshor ram gsung*/ de ma thos lags zhus skad/ snyan rgyud ston pa byang chub rgyal mtshan pa'i lugs nas/ bur ldang cig dang*/ ras phrug gi snam bu cig phul zer ba 'dug ste/ de rang phul rgyu med pa 'dra lags/ de nas phyag rten dam dum yod pa rnams phul nas/ sngar mthu byas pa'i lo rgyus rnams zhus nas/ bdag sdig po che cig lags pas/ chos dang zas gos thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ spyan hur mdzad nas/ gnyis ka ga na yong*/ gang rung cig 'doms gsung*/ 'o na zas gos gnyis tshol gro 'dra byed lags/ dus gtan gyi don yin pas/ chos thugs la 'dogs par zhu byas pas/ khyod kyi ming yang gung thang pa a po mthu chen yin gsung*/ rdzogs chen gyi ka ba li (274)mchod khang na yar khyer bas/ bka' chad lung brdum de 'dra yar ma khyer/ nga'i bka' chod lung tshod dri ma med pa rnams chams pa yong gsung nas 'jog ma bcug gsung*/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ khyod rang la rgyags zong dam dum yod dam gsung*/ der ci yang med nas/ lho brag lung par glu blangs cing blangs pas/ mi rnams kyi stod kyi gung glu snyan zer nas/ nyi ma gcig rang la yang nas khal bdun rnyed nas/

byin po bcol nas khur cig khur nas yongs pas/ mi rang shed ni che ste khang thog 'joms pa yin gsung nas bkyon du byung ba dang*/ jo mo'i zhal nas mi sto 'di 'dra las g.yag khang yang theg pa yin/ ga le phog gsung*/ rje btsun na re 'di tsam khugs pa ci btsongs pa yin gsung*/ ci yang btsongs rgyu med lags blangs pa lags/ 'dis mi tshad bcol nas rang yod zhus pas/ khyod mi rgod po cig 'dug /ngas ni lho brag na lo 'di tsam bsdad de 'di 'dra ba ma rnyed gsung*/ lar nyi ma bzhi blangs pas/ nas khal nyi shu rnyed skad/ de'i dus na dgung lo nyer brgyad pa yin gsung skad/ der rje btsun na re da nang nas khyod rang gis (275)lto zo/ las nged kyi las ka gyis gsung*/ lar bla ma'i phyag rdzas nas lan lnga zos skad/ las rogs byas shing bsdad nas gdams ngag zhus pas ni/ dbang thob dgos gsung nas ma gnang*/ de'i dus su mes chen pos lho brag gi zhing zho cig 'gro ba'i sa dang*/ tshos dang bu ram la sogs ltang tsos bkang nas phul ba la des gzhi byas pa'i gser gyis bzhengs pa'i mdo sde sum cu dum cig dang*/ sku mkhar dgu thog pa cig gi gzhi bting ba'i rdo khur bas/ sku rgyab la rma chen po byung bas/ jo mo na re mi la sgal pa byung ba 'di las ma mthong*/ 'di da yug rdo khur du ma bcug zhus pas/ rje btsun na re nga la thabs yod bong bu la yang byad pa yin gsung nas/ sgal khang byas cing rdo khur bas/ sgal pa lan gsum byung byung du rdo skyas/ nang nub jo mo'i chu len yos btags byas pas thugs zin nas/ thugs la btags skad/ 'di'i dus su dgung lo nyer brgyad pa yin gsung*/ rje mar pa'i bu chen bzhi ni/ rngog gzhung pa dang*/ mes tshon po dang*/ shud kyi lba ba can dang*/ rgyang ro zhang ston pa dang bzhi yin la/ de nas tshur ston dbang nge dang*/ dgyer phu'i klog skya 'byung rgyal (276)dang*/ 'phan yul gyi mar pa mgon g.yag dang*/

lho rje sa ring dang*/ 'phrang gi rgya ston zhig po dang*/ mar pa bya ze pa dang*/ nyang sgom sprang btags dang*/ ba ngar rang zo lba ba can dang*/ bla ma mid la ras chen la sogs rnams kyi rnam thar yang kho bo la gtam rgyud yod de zur na gsal/ sku'i sras po dgu 'khrungs pa la/ gnyis ni snga po grongs gda'/ dar ma mdo sde la sogs bdun po ni/ rje btsun mid la yar byon pa'i rjes la grongs pa yin pa la/ dus phyis g.yang mkhan la sogs rgyus med rnams kyis don dang ma 'brel ba'i 'ol tshod kyis rdzun 'ga' re byed cing 'dug ste/ de 'dra la blo gtad mi nyan no// yang mar pa'i drung du mid la ras pa lung ston mkhan yang*/ mar pa 'byung ye dang*/ 'dre ston lha dga' yin la sku drin che gsung skad/ bla ma mid la ras pa'i yab grongs dus nas dgung lo gsum dang zla ba ngo bzhi pa yin/ dge bshes tsa pa'i drung du sdod dus na lo bdun pa/ mthu slob dus na bco brgyad pa/ mar pa 'byung ye yar bcad lo nyer bdun pa/ bla ma 'dre ston lha dga'i drung du lo gcig song*/ mar pa'i drung du mjal (277)dus na lo nyer brgyad pa yin gsung*/ yang la la na re yum bdag med mas mid la ras pa la sku lus gnang ngam zer ba yang 'dug ste/ de'i tshod kyi blun skad yin no// rje btsun mid las dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa'i dus na/ sprul pa'i dpa' mo tshe'i dbang phyug ma la sogs pa phyag rgya rten gda'/ de man chad mi'i bud med kyang brten nam/ sngar yan chod grong chos kyi ma gos gsungs so// rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ mi la ras pa la zhal ta 'di rnams gnang gsung*/ sgom chen pa bya ba de nyal dus glang nyal ba bzhin cig dgos la/ ldang dus na stag langs pa bzhin cig dgos pa yin no// de yang gang 'dug sa der spang la phur ba btab pa ltar du sdod tshugs pa cig dgos la/ gzhi lam cig la yun ring na nyes skyon du ma rnams yod pas/

ri khrod dang bas mtha' skor ba la stag gis gzan tshol ba 'dra ba cig dgos la/ lar chos pas pha yul dang gzhi dgon lam du slongs pa ni/ rgya gar na rgyal po chen po in+d+ra bho dhi tsam yin la/ bod na nga tsam yin gsung*/ bla ma mid la ras pas lho brag tu rje mar pa'i sku mkhar dgu thog pa de thebs bzhi rtsigs/ thebs (278)bzhi bshig /gzhan yang dka' ba spyad lugs rnams/ nga zhi byed ri khrod pas thos tshad bshad na dus da lta'i mi phal cher gyis ni sangs rgyas dag phar zhog la mi skyin kyang ga na lon/ jo mo bdag med pa'i bzhon 'jo ba'i zhabs stegs mid las mdzad pa yang grangs las 'das/ sku rgyab la sgal pa thengs gsum byung zer/ snga phyi gnyis la lo dgu bzhugs pa la/ glu blangs cing slangs nas gsol cing*/ bla ma'i zhabs tog mdzad gda'/ yang lan cig lho brag lcags yul du 'gyod cig byung ba la/ mi las kyang byon pas/ mi rnams la blang 'bul re re byas pas gnas brtan cig la zangs cig dang re phrug gi snam bu cig phul ba la/ khong ma mgu nas len ma nyan pa dang*/ ston mo tshar nas mi rnams gzings langs pa dang*/ mid las yar rgyugs nas de ngas khyer nas 'gro byas pas/ mi rnams kyis gnas brtan gyi g.yog po yin bsam nas khong la gtad pas/ de khyer nas mar pa'i drung du phul bas/ bla ma mnyes nas 'o pho rgod yin zangs 'di la dgos jo mo'i chu ra byed/ re phrug de khyod rang gi gos gyis/ zangs (279)'di nang dmar ba des khyod la chos dmar po cig yong ba yin/ phyi nag po des khyed la da rung dka' ba kha cig spyad dgos pa cig yong bar 'dug gsung ste/ phyis kyang bla mas gsung ba bzhin rang byung gsung*/ yang dus lan cig rje mar pa'i nas chad pa la/ mi las glu blangs cing lho brag lung pa ru blangs pas nas mang rab rnyed pa phul bas/ bla ma dang jo mo gnyis kar mnyes skad/ yang rje mar pa dang rngog gzhung pa la ngan byed rnams la mid las ser ba phab pas/

mi ngan rnams 'babs so la byung dus na/ bya ro byi ro mang rab khyer byung nas/ mi ngan rnams na re nged dag nyes can yin te/ 'di rnams kyis ci byas pa snying mi rje'am/ khyed chos pa ma lags sam zer nas/ bya 'brul gyi ro rnams mdun du spungs pas/ mi las ngus pa dang*/ rje mar pas/ rigs lnga bya 'phur ches nyid rlung*// 'khor lo rgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// nga la na ro paṇa chen gyi// sdig sdug yod pa yin gsungs nas// se gol gtogs mdzad pas bya brul shi ro rnams nam mkha' la 'phur nas song skad/ spyir mid la ras pas lho brag du lo dgu bzhugs pa la/ rje mar pa'i rdo mkhar chen po de la/ (280)rtsig gshig thebs bzhi byas pa'i rting ma de phyin pa dang*/ mar pa yang mnyes pa ltar mdzad nas/ da na rab gnas byed ran gsung nas/ khang pa la skor ba khyil pa cig mdzad nas/ rmang rdo kun la gzigs te/ chu rdo chen po lug ro tsam cig mid la min pa cig gis khur rogs byas pa de ngo shes nas/ rdo 'di thos pa dga' min pa cig gis khur bar 'dug /'di sus khur ba yin gsung nas bkyon du byung bas/ 'di grwa pa rnams shed tshad 'gran pa yin zhus pas/ mar pa'i zhal nas da lta rang shig gsung nas rdo mkhar de ga rang rtsa ba nas bshig bcug nas/ da ci'i grwa pa tshos khur ba'i rdo chen po de/ mi la ras pa la rdo 'di khur la khar tsang gi sa der skyol gsung nas/ sngar gyi sar zhog gsung nas/ de nas de yang yar long la shog gsungs pas/ yang yar khur nas yongs pas/ de yang brtsigs gsung nas/ da gzod brtsigs te/ sku mkhar dgu thog pa yang tshar ba dang*/ mar pa'i zhal nas/ da ni thos pa dga' kho de ngang ma thung dang*/ dus res cig tsa na kha mo zos pa'i rjes la mngar mo cig myong ngam mi shes gsung skad/ lar skyes mchog mid la ras chen dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo (281)rje'i snying rus dang*/ dka' spyad 'di dran tsa na/ dus da lta'i chos pa phal cher ni 'chi 'phyis pa rang yin lags so// gangs can rgyud du sku 'khrungs shing*// 'jig rten skyon rnams yongs spongs te// rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'dzam gling brgyan// mid la ras chen khyad zhabs dang*// sprang po zhi byed ri pa yi// spyi bor dus rnams thams cad du// skad cig 'bral bar ma gyur cig

/a la la/ a la la/ pha mi la ras chen ang/ yang mched grogs kun gyis ka ca ston nas dbang gral la zhugs pas/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ khyod la dbang khral ci yod gsung*/ nga la ka ca med pas mched grogs rnams kyis dbang khral byin pa yin zhus pas/ chos zhu ba la rang re dbang ba'i nor btang dgos pa yin/ mis nga la 'bul rgyu la yongs ba rnams lam kar bgo bsha' byed pa de khyed tsho mi bden gsung nas/ mi la a cang che de gzhan rnams kyang khong gi rin la sgor bton pa yang lan drug tsam byas gsung*/ gzhan rnams la dbang dang chos gnang tsa na/ thos pa dga' las ka gang dka' ba cig bskos nas gtong ba yin skad/ tshogs 'khor dus na skal ba drag po re byung na/ de la mar pa spyan cer ba re (282)gzigs nas/ mi la la lhag ma 'dra byin pas chog /kho'i de yang long nged kyi 'gron chas gyis gsung nas phrogs pa yin gsung skad/ yang dus lan cig mar pa'i bu chen bzhis dbang cig zhus pa la/ jo mo na re khyed rnams kyi zhor la mi la yang tshud dgos gsung pas/ khong tsho na re nyid dag mi la chud na dga' ste/ bla ma'i drung du zhu dgos zer nas zhus pas/ thos pa dga' la dbang khral ci 'dug gsung*/ sha khog cig dang mar gong cig gda' zhus pas/ de bzang khyer la shog gsung nas khyer phyin pas/ de rnams yon bdag che ge dang che ges nga la phul ba der 'dug gsung nas dbang ma gnang*/ yang lan cig mas ston la sogs pa kha cig gis gsang 'dus kyi dbang zhus pas/ jo mos zhu rogs byas nas zhus pas/ kho la dbang khral ci 'dug gsung*/ jo mos phag nor g.yu chen po cig gnang nas/ g.yu cig 'dug zhus pas khyer shog gsung ste/ khyer nas phyin pas kho la g.yu 'di gang nas byung ba yin gsung*/ jo mo na re mid la la g.yu'i yong sa ga na yod pa/ nga la mas mar pa'i mi rigs rnams mi ngan pa yin pas/ dus phyis (283)bkras pa byung na phag nor gyis zer nas byin pa yin zhus pas/

rje mar na re de yin g.yu las khyod rang yang nga dbang ba yin gsung*/ jo mo na re nga nyid cig dbang na yang*/ g.yu nyid mi dbang*/ dang po pha mas nyid cag la ster ba'i dus na/ dang po khong rang re'i 'bangs yin te/ da yon tan can byung 'dug pas khyod ster ba yin zer/ bla mas dbang mi gnang na g.yu 'di bskur nas gzhan du dbang zhur gtong ba yin zhus pas dbang la tshud do// rje btsun na re g.yu bzang po cig gzhan du do rang shor gsung*/ de man chad rgyud bshad tshad nyan du bcug go /de dus na mi la dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa yin gsung*/ skabs cig dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur nas/ rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa tshar bcu drug nyan gsung*/ man ngag ni ma gnang*/ jo mos phyag rgya chen po lhan skyes cig gnang bas an tsam nyams len la phan par byung gsung*/ yang lan cig lho la g.yag pas mar pa'i 'bul skyel bcom pa la/ ser ba phab dang gdam ngag sbyin gsung pa la/ da ser ba yang mi 'bebs/ gdams ngag yang gnang bar mi 'dug pas/ da bla ma gzhan cag gi drung du 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ jo mo na re da res ser ba phab dang*/ (284)rang re gnyis kas zhus pas gdams ngag gnang yong gsung nas/ ser ba phab pas/ nor khugs kyang gdams ngag ma gnang bas/ de nas jo mo dang mid la gnyis gros byas te/ mi la 'gro ba skad byas nas rje btsun la sku khams zhus nas phyin pas/ jo mo la khyod rang gi mid la ni 'gro bar 'dug sdod kyis gsung ba la/ mi las 'gro ba skad byas/ jo mos zlog pa ltar byas pas/ rje btsun thog kha nas nyag nyug rab rib gzigs cing 'dug /der zlog nas yongs te/ gdams ngag zhus pas ma gnang*/ yang yang zhus pas ga le sbyin gsung nas ma gnang bas/ jo mo'i zhal nas da khyod 'dir bsdad kyang don mi 'dug pas/ gdams ngag la ni bla ma 'di las lhag pa ga na yang med de khong gi ni mi gnang bar 'dug pas/ da khong gi bu chen cig can btang dgos par 'dug ste/

de yang zhang ston ni rje btsun gyi sku zhang yin pa dang*/ lar yang drung du phal cher sdod dgos pas ljabs mi bde/ shud kyi lba ba can ni mi chen po khyengs grags can dang lta spyod mi mthun/ rngog gzhung pa de byang chub sems dpa' cig yod pas der btang dgos gsung nas/ de'i (285)bar du sku mkhar dgu thog pa de la/ lo re re la ar po bcu gsum bcu gsum gyis thog re re btang ba'i thog bdun phub tshar ba dang*/ lo bdun sdad nas phyin pa yin/ lar lo dgu lhag tsam bzhugs gsung*/ dbang rdzogs pa lnga tsam thob/ mtshan rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ gsang mtshan dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje btags/ de nas jo mos bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi dbu skra la sogs rten byin rlabs can tshan cig bkur nas/ nga na ro dge bshes rngog la mid la gdams ngag thugs la thogs zer gyin 'dus gyis la song gsung nas/ rje btsun la sku khams zhus nas byon pas/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ jo mo la khyod rang gi mid la 'gro ba 'dug pas sdod gyis gsung ba dang*/ jo mo na re mid la 'dra ba'i las yong ba su yod/ zhabs tog dka' ba de 'dra spyad kyang gdams ngag ni mi ster bar 'dug pas/ nga sdod mi zer gsung nas 'gro ma nyan pa dang*/ rje btsun rang gis bdas nas kyang ma nyan pa dang*/ khyod ye mi sdod na nga rang gi rgyags phye zhogs gsung nas/ rgyags phye phrogs yang ma nyan par mid las gzhung gi ri bo sgang du phyin pa dang*/ rngog gis grwa pa tshan cig la brtag gnyis gsung gin 'dug pa sleb pas/ (286)dge bshes rngog gi spyan zur la phyag babs khyug khyug pa byung ste/ thang theb bteg nas ltas pas/ thos pa dga' 'dug nas/ bka' brgyud kyi dbu skra phyag du btang nas/ jo mo bdag med ma'i zhal nas/ nga la gdams ngag gnang bar zhu gsung gin gda' zhus pas/ rten la spyan ce re gzigs nas/ rten 'di khyod kyis khyer yongs ba min/ bla ma'i thugs rjes nga rang la byon pa yin gsung nas/

'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*/ zer ba'i chos thun gyi mtshams de la 'dug pa la/ shar ba cig klog nas de'i 'bru non nang par byed gsung ste/ nang du gshegs jo mo la phud yod dam gsung*/ nam dgos cha med pa des yod lags zer ba dang*/ bka' brgyud kyi rten byon pa shang len byed dgos pas mchod pa shoms gsung nas/ tshogs 'khor mdzad nas/ rngog gi zhal nas khyod yongs pa de go bcad/ khyod 'bod pa la thug yod pa yin te/ rje btsun ma gnyes dogs nas ma phod pa yin gsung*/ nged kyi gnag lug rnam dol gyi phal mo bas khyed bas ser ba cig gtong dgos gsung*/ der ser ba 'bebs pa mi dga' na yang*/ ngo gsar du song bas ngo ma chogs nas/ ser ba phab pas (287)phebs kyang da rung rngog gi mthu yin pa'i nges pa med zer nas/ yar skyar nas phab pas/ shing phung re re'i 'og na yang bya ro byi ro grangs med pa shi 'dug pas/ thu ba gang khyer yongs pa dang*/ jo mo na re don grub sam zer bas/ bya ro rnams mdun du spungs nas/ don grub so// mi tshe gang du mthu dang ser ba kho na byed dgos pa nga 'dra ba'i bsod nams ma bsags pa/ byas pa chos byas nas 'gro sa dmyal bar 'gro ba byas nas ngus pas/ rngog na re mi ste/ rje mar pas nā ro pa thebs gsum brten pa'i rjes la gnang ba'i man ngag gzhan su la yang ma gnang pa cig nga la yod/ de khyod la byin pas chog /lar yang rtsa khur ba la zer ba mi lci/ chos byas pas sdig pa 'dag pa la tshegs med pa yin/ chang 'thung me la spros kyis gsung yang ngu 'phro ma chod pa dang*/ jo mo na re gdams ngag gam de yod na da lta rang ston mdzod/ mi 'di shi bar 'dug pa/ shi tshar nas gdams ngag su la ston zer bas/ do nub rang la bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dbang gnang/ brtag pa gnyis pa'i rgyud gsungs/ thabs lam chos drug gi khrid gnang*/ khyad par gtum mo'i bsrangs su bcug nas/ phug cig (288)na 'dag char la bzhag nas/

jo mos rgyags dang tshogs 'khor byung tshad kyi skal ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi sku skal dang*/ mi la rang la skal ba re dang*/ jo mo rang gi lhag ma re dang gsum gsum phug sgor skyal/ bla ma rngog gi spong thag lan gsum byas pa la/ rje mar pas gdams ngag 'di dang 'di gnang gsung nas/ phug sgor byon nas chos rnams gsungs/ dol pas kyang nor dang rgyal kha byas nas/ sgrub pa lo gcig byas pas kyang gdams ngag la blo legs par khel te/ nyams myong tsam ni ma skyes par yod tsa na/ rje mar pas rngog la 'phrin btang nas/ ngas 'dir zhing chen po chod ste phyag sogs med pas lug tsher mo las mi rgan mi gzhon pa gang yod cig skyol cig bya ba byung bas/ rngog na re kha dmar po nor ram zad pa'i sems las sam/ gdams ngag de chos mkhas pa tsam las je zab je zab la 'gro dgos par 'dug pa la gsung nas/ lug tsher mo brgya dang gzhan yang cha rkyen mang rab dang*/ gsum rab dkon brtsegs cig dang*/ de rnams sdegs nas thos pa dga' la/ bla mas nga la 'di skad gsung byung bas drung du 'bul ba skyel du 'gro dgos (289)par 'dug pas/ khyod 'gro'am mi 'gro gsungs pas/ bdag kyang 'gro bar zhu zer na thon pas/ jo mo na re nga'i mid la'i mtshams sus bton zer ba dang*/ kho rang bla ma la mjal du 'gro ba yin byas pas/ 'o na thebs cig song la de nas tshur shog zer/ der rngog gi zhabs tog byas nas lho brag du phyin pa la/ bro bo lung slebs khar bla ma rngog gi bsu ba cig re nas/ mi la sngon la btang bas/ bla ma mar pa spang sko yin 'dug pa la/ phyag phul bas/ khyod slebs sam gsung*/ bla ma rngog pa gsung rab dkon brtsegs dang*/ lug dang bcas pa 'bul ba la byon gyin yod zhus pas/ de ka yin khyod rang nang du song la jo mo yod gsung*/ rngog la bsu ba cig mi 'tshal lam zhus pas/ ha ha ngas rgya gar nas nā ro mai tri'i chos khyer nas yongs pa la bsu ba byed mkhan med pa la/

rngog dud 'gro gdas nas yong ba la bsu ba byed du re ba 'khrul ba yin gsum pas/ mid las nang du byon pas/ jo mo mnyes nas khyod 'ongs sam gsung*/ bla ma rngog pa 'byon gyin yod zhus pas/ rje btsun dang mjal lam ci gsung zer 'di skad gsung zhus pas/ khong mi chen po 'byon pa la bsu ba cig byed dgos pa yin (290)te/ rang res zhus na ni bkyon du yang gsung nas/ jo mo dang mid las phyin pas/ jo mo'i drung du rngog gis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ jo mos phyag spyi sprod tsam cig mdzad cing 'dug /de nas mar pa spang sko sar rngog gis byon nas phyag 'tshal bas/ rje btsun zhal phar gzigs nas spang yab se yab se rko yin 'dug /yang mdun du phyin nas phyag 'tshal bas/ ci yin chos kyi rdo rje yongs sam/ nga ni zog po rdzun mkhan cig 'dug sam gsung nas nang du byon te/ de nas jo mo la phud yod dam gsung*/ nam dgos cha med pa des yod zhus pas/ 'o na rngog la sna len byed pa yin pas/ grwa pa rnams sogs gsung bas/ grwa pa thams cad tshogs nas mchod pa chen po gnang nas/ byin po gyes pa dang rje btsun rang dang*/ jo mo dang*/ rngog dang*/ mi la dang dpon slob bzhi las med pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas rngog la nga'i mid la la gdams ngag byin nam gsung pa dang*/ rngog na re bka' brgyud kyi dbu skra skur nas byung bas/ gdams ngag byin lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis dbyug pa tog blangs pa dang*/ jo mo rgod cing bros pa dang*/ yug nas rje btsun gyi jo (291)mo la shog gyis gsung nas/ jo mo nang du byon pa dang*/ rje btsun na re khyod jo mo la yang gyod med/ mi la la phan sems kyis bskur ba yin/ mi la la yang gyod med/ jo mos bskur ba de khyer nas 'gro ba las 'os med/ khyed ma smad kyi bar nas rngog 'tshengs pa yin te/ da ni gang thod thod du bzhag du mi nyan par 'dug gsung nas/ de man mchod rten sku lus la 'chang gin 'dug zer/

de nas rje btsun gyis rngog la khyod kyis nga la 'bul ba 'di dang 'di byas/ bsnyen bskur 'di byas/ de'i dus na ngas gdams ngag 'di dang 'di byin pa/ de rnams nga'i mid la la byin nam gsung*/ de rnams byin lags zhus pas/ 'o na thams cad ma lus par byin 'dug gsung pa dang*/ der mi la'i bsam pa la/ rje mar pas rgya gar du de tsam gyi dka' ba spyad pa'i gdams ngag rnams bla ma rngog la gnang 'dug la/ bla ma rngog gis de tsam gyi 'bul 'degs dang zhabs tog chen po byas nas zhus pa'i gdams ngag zab don rnams thams cad nga la gnang 'dug /bla ma gnyis kar sangs rgyas rang du 'dug bsam nas/ mos gus chen po skyes gsung*/ de nas bla ma'i drung du (292)rngog yug tsam cig sdod bsam par 'dug pa la/ mar pa'i zhal nas grwa pa rnams la chos bshad dgos pas song gsung nas sdod du ma bcug /bla ma rngog bzhugs dus na/ mi la la khyod da res 'gro 'am sdod gsung pas/ rngog gi jo mo na re shog zer bas lan cig 'gro lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'o na da res song la/ rngog la ma zer bar khyed rang la gdam ngag cig bstan rgyu yod pas/ nam yong snying 'dod tsa na shog gsung pas/ bla ma rngog pa skyel du phyin pa dang*/ rngog gi jo mo na re da khyod rang mtshams la sdod zer ba la/ rje btsun na re shog gsung byas pas/ thebs cig song la phyis shog zer/ der lho brag du phyin pa dang*/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ jo mo la khyod rang gi mid la la gdams ngag cig ston pa yin pas/ phud cig chos sha le sogs pa gzhan 'dra yang sta gon gyis gsung nas/ sa stegs dang yul gsal nas yar gshegs nas/ phu gro ba lung gi dgon par byon te/ 'khor thams cad la yang da khyed rnams su yang nga rang gi lan ma byung gi bar du ma yong cig /nged gsum mkhar lar cig gi tshes gcig la 'gro ba yin gsung nas/ (293)rje btsun dang jo mo dang mid la dang dpon slob gsum byon pa dang*/

rje lho brag pa'i mar ston chos kyi blo gros kyi zhal nas/ bu kho de mi la thos pa dga' mthu chen dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ khyed sems rtse gcig du gyis la nyon cig dang*/ de de yin te de nyid min/ bya ba yin te/ de de yin te bya ba rgyud dang 'brel ba'i thabs lam gyi gdams ngag bya ba/ khyod rang la sngar bstan pa de rnams yin te/ mar pa'i bu chen bzhi la sogs pa yang de las med do// de nyid min bya ba byin brlabs dang 'brel pa/ snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag bya ba cig yod te/ rje nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ 'khor lo sgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// rigs lnga bya 'phur chos nyid rlung*// gsungs pas/ gdams ngag 'di chig rgyud yin pas sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dang*/ longs sku lus med mas kyang*/ te lo pa min pa la gnang ba med la/ te lo pas kyang nā ro pa min pa gnang ba med la/ nā ro pas kyang nga min pa la gnang ba med la/ ngas kyang snod ldan cig yun ring por btsal ba yin te/ khyod las drag pa ma mthong la/ nga'i bu mdo sde dang khyod gnyis rgyud chod mnyam po tshod dam/ mdo sde khyod las en zhan nam tsam du 'dug na yang*/ dang po mdo sde la byin la de nas khyod la sbyin 'jug bsam pa yin te/ gang sa ci sgo lung bstan du ma dang bcas khyod drag par 'dug pas/ khyod (294)la ster ba yin pas/ ga le sbyin bsam pa yin te/ jo mo dang khyed ma smad kyis tug tug zer ba des/ sbyin en sngas tsam yin no// gdams ngag sbyin sngas pa des/ khyod la lo kha cig grub rtags 'gyang ba cig yong dogs yod do// da rung lo kha cig nas byin na phyis grub thag nye ba yin te/ da khyed kyi mdo sde las snod drag pa 'dug na de la byin/ de yang bla ma'i sras yin bsam nas zhen pa dang bcas pas byin na/ khyed rang la nyes pa yong ba yin no gsung nas/ snyan rgyud kyi dbang dang byin rlabs dang gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas rje nā ro'i zhal nas/

rigs lnga bya 'phur chos nyid rlung*// 'khor lo rgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// gsung nas/ gdams ngag ming gi grul grul 'dra ba lnga yod pa la/ de gang rnams yin zer na/ rig pa ye shes sgron me dang*/ rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo dang*/ ro snyoms phyi'i me long dang*/ rang grol phyag rgya chen po dang*/ bde chen gsung gi rin chen dang*/ lnga yod pa de dngos su ma gnang na yang*/ don gyis khyod rang gi gdams ngag gi khongs su yod gsung nas/ dngos su ma gnang bas/ da khyod kyi shes (295)rab dang snying rus gnyis kas yong bar 'dug pas/ da rung rje nā ro pa'i slob ma 'dra ba rgya gar na yod srid pas/ khyod song la chos lnga po de snyed dam ltos la khyer shog gsung ngo*// de dus na mid la ras chen dgung lo sum cu so dgu pa yin gsung*/ der rgya gar du 'gro bar chas pa la gser med pas re zhig ma thon/ der bla ma'i bka' gnyan par 'dug bsam nas/ yar gung thang du 'gro bar brtsams te/ phyi phyag gi tshogs 'khor bag tsam cig mchod par drangs nas/ de dus na rje btsun mar pa'i drung du mgur 'di skad zhus par 'dug /rje mi skyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang lan cig yul du gtong bar zhu// a ma lus kyi sgron bu de// da lta zhig gam ma zhig lta// sring mo pe ta mgon skyes de// khyo gnas cig rnyed dam ma rnyed lta// a khu rin rgyal pha spad rnams// da lta dar rgud cig 'dug lta// gsung rab mchod gnas dkon brtsegs de// thigs pas rul lam ma rul lta// khang pa ka bzhi gdung brgyad de// 'jag skyas chud dam ma chud lta// pha zhing 'or zer gru gsum de// sho rud kyis khyer ram ma khyer lta// zhang po dge bshes tsa pa de// da lta sku khams bzang ngam lta// spyir 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid 'ja' (296)sprin de// bden rtags 'dug gam mi 'dug lta/ zhus pas/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ lar snying nas rang chos gsha' ma cig byed na/

pha yul gyi zhen pa gcod dgos pa yin no// da res khyod ni nga rang gis yar gtong ba yin te/ 'on kyang der dgongs ngas rmi lam cig brtag dgos gsung nas/ de'i snga dro rje mar pas/ rnal lam brtags don ka chen bzhi ma zhes bya ba'i ma 'ongs lung bstan ma 'di skad gsungs so// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid/ sgo bsrungs nā ro'i zhabs la 'dud/ nga lho brag gi mar pa lo tsā des/ mdang gsum gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ nyi ma shar du ka chen cig btsugs pa rmis/ ka thog der seng chen cig 'gyings pa rmis/ seng g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis/ seng gangs dkar gyi rtse ru mchongs pa rmis/ seng rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs pa rmis/ shar gyi rmi lam de mi ngan rmi lam bzang*/ nyi ma lho ru ka chen cig btsugs pa rmis/ ka thog der rgya stag cig ngar ba rmis/ stag 'dzom drug phyi ru bkra ba rmis/ stag rtsal drug nang nas rdzogs pa rmis/ stag thang shing rgyud la 'brel ba rmis/ stag tsan dan gyi nags la mchongs pa rmis/ (297)rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs pa rmis/ lho rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*/ nyi ma nub du ka chen cig btsugs pa rmis/ ka thog der khyung chen cig 'gying ba rmis/ khyung bya mig dbral bar 'dzum pa rmis/ khyung sder dpon bzan la bkram pa rmis/ khyung bya spu gnam la ldings pa rmis/ khyung dgung sngon gyi dbyings su 'phur ba rmis/ nub rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*/ nyi ma byang du ka chen cig btsugs pa rmis/ ka thog der rgod po gcig 'gying ba rmis/ rgod tshang brag la byas pa rmis/ rgod phrug gi bar snang gang ba rmis/ rgod rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs pa rmis// rgod gshog drug mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis/ byang rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*/ gsungs pa dang*/ yang mid la ras pas/ rje btsun lags rnal lam de'i brda' grol cig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ yang rje mar pas 'di skad gsungs so// nyi ma shar du ka chen btsugs pa de/

dol gyi tshur ston dbang rdor yin/ khong mi gzhi seng ge 'dra ba yin/ g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa de/ zag med kyi bde chen rgyas pa yin/ gangs dkar gyi rtse la mchongs pa de/ snyan rgyud kyi stan pa dar ba yin/ rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs pa de// chos (298)nyid zad sar skyol ba yin/ nyi ma lho ru ka chen btsugs pa de/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor yin/ khong mig gzhi stag dang 'dra ba yin/ 'dzum drug phyi ru bkra ba de/ bshad rgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin/ kho 'dzum nang du rgyas pa de/ bsgrub pa mtha' ru skyol ba yin/ thang shing rgyud du 'brel ba de mi rgyud dang chos rgyud dar ba yin/ tsan dan gyi nags la mchongs pa de/ nor zang zing la 'dzin chags med pa yin/ nyi ma nub du ka chen btsugs pa de/ gtsang rong gi me ston tshon po yin/ khong mi gzhi khyung dang 'dra ba yin/ bya mig dpral bar 'dzum pa de/ bsre 'pho'i bstan pa dar ba yin/ bya spu gnam la gzing ba de/ srog rtsol dbu mar chud pa yin// sder sen bzan la bkram pa de// 'khor ba la phyi phyag byed pa yin// dgung sngon gyi dbyings su 'phur ba de// tshe gcig la sangs chung rgya ba yin// nyi ma byang du ka chen btsugs pa de// gung thang gi mid la ras pa yin// khyod mi gzhi rgod dang 'dra ba yin// rgod tshang bral la byas pa de// tshe tshad mtha' ru skyol ba yin// bu 'gran gyi do med cig yong ba yin// rgod phrug gi bar snang gang ba de// bsgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin// byang rmi lam (299)mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// rje mar pas de skad gsungs pa dang*// de nas bla ma rngog la phyi phyag la byon pa dang*/ jo mo na re rgyags ni nged kyis ster/ chos ni khyod rang gis byed la/ khyod 'dir yod na nged kyang kha drag pa la phan pa 'dug zer ba dang*/ blo 'gyur nas 'o na rje btsun gyi drung du zhal ta cig zhur 'gro ba dang*/

de bzhin byed dgos bsam nas bsdad pas/ bla ma rngog yang mnyes nas 'dug la/ 'tsho ba yang sla bar byung bas/ mi rnams mos nas blo phab nas bsdad/ yar phyis cig 'gro'i bsam tsa na/ yar 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan la brten pa ni 'og na gsal/ rngog gi jo mo la rje mar pas rgya gar du song gsung bas mi sdod byas nas phyi phyag gi tshogs 'khor gcig byas nas/ tshur res gnyan ston dang rta nag gi bon po gnyis ni grongs tshar gda'/ shul ma rnams la 'bul ba re byas nas mid las bshums pas thams cad yid rangs zer/ de nas la stod nas yar gung thang du slebs nas rgya gar du 'gro 'dod pa la gser med pas re zhig ma thon/ der yang yul gyi zhen pa legs par chod nas yod pa la/ lho brag du mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan byung ba ni/ bsgrub pa byed pa (300)la mi dang 'dres chod dgos pas gzhan gang du yang bsnyen bskur la mi thar bas/ rang yul du song cig dang*/ der khyod la mi rnams dad pa log nas yod pas/ bsnyen bskur mi yong bas rig pa dngas pa dang*/ skur 'debs mang bas sgrib pa zad pa rkyen zer bas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i byin rlabs 'jug grub thag nye zer nas/ dkar po yug cig yar rkyang song*/

dang po ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel ba nyams su myong ba'i yon tan la/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bco brgyad la sogs pa du ma rnams mdzad nas 'dug pa la/ kho bo zhi byed ri khrod pas/ brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi don bstan pa yin la/ de yang dang po 'khor ba la snying po med par gzigs pa'i yon tan ni/ kho rang gi yul gung thang rgyal lnga yul gyi tsa mkhar sgo thang na byon pas/ sngar gyi rgan pa thams cad ni shi/ gzhon pa thams cad ni chen por song nas ngo mi shes su song 'dug la/ ma ni snga mo nas shi/ sring mo ni sprang ba la song nas mi 'dug pas/ sngar gyi slob dpon rnying ma ban dhe dang mjal nas/ phyag 'tshal bas yug ni ngo ma shes/ de nas zhal la sme ba yod pa dang*/ dang po pha spun rnams kyi brdungs nas (301)mgo bcag pa'i rma sgro yod pa dang*/ so bcag pa'i so tshab yod pa rnams mthong nas/ sring po la sogs pa za rgyu byin nas do re 'dir nyol gsung ba la/ khong rang gi khang par phyin pas thog kun rdibs rtsa skya skyes/ gsung rabs dkon brtsegs yod pa yang mid la'i 'dre yod zer nas/ khong rang gi bang bar skyal nas thigs pas rul/ zhing la rtsa skya phung por song 'dug /la la na re de dus na ma yod zer te mi bden no// ma khong pa yar lungs dang rta nag na bzhugs dus na shi gsung ngo*// de nas spyir 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med cing dgos mid la'i 'khor ba la snying po med par dgongs nas/ mgur gsungs pa/ kye ma sngon nor yod tsa na mi yang med// da mi yod tsa na nor yang med// sngon ma yod tsa na bu yang med// da bu yod tsa na ma yang med// sngon khu bo yod dus tsha bo med// da tsha bo yod dus khu bo med// lar gnyis ka 'dzoms yang snying po med// thams cad 'dzoms yang snying po med// spyir 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// dgos mid la'i 'khor ba la snying po med// snying po med pa'i dus 'di ru// rnal 'byor snying po cis mi btsal// ces gsungs so// a ne cig khang gog gi zur na (302)bsdad nas 'dug pa'i rtsar byon nas/

nga thos pa dga' yin byas pas/ mi shi ba kun la yong*/ snying tshim ma sgrub/ sdug pa sdug chug zer/ de nas yug cig nas ngo shes nas gnyis kas ngus shing*/ khyim mtshes gcig la yu bla nas phul dod blangs nas zos gsung*/ la la na re de dus na pe ta yang 'dug zer te mi bden/ ku thang du sprang ba la song 'dug gsung*/ gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin shar ba'i yon tan ni/ slob dpon de na re da khyod mthu can du grags pas khyod kyi zhing la sus kyang reg ma phod par yod/ khu bo'i gzhis phas chod nya ra byas pas chog pa yod gsung ba la mi las mgur gsungs pa/ phu stong nyid kyi lung pa yangs dang gcig /mda' gnad kyi sa 'phrang dam dang gnyis// bar nyams myong gi rtsi thog rgyas dang gsum// nga rnal 'byor gyi pha yul de la nyan// tshul khrims kyi rtsa ba brtan dang gcig /lta ba'i bya rkang bzang dang gnyis// yon tan gyi ba gam ma tho dang gsum// nga rnal 'byor gyi pha wang de la nyan/ dad pa'i zhing sa gshin dang gcig /brtson 'grus kyi chu lud 'dzoms dang gnyis// dge sbyor gyi rmo rko legs dang gsum// nga rnal 'byor gyi pha zhing (303)de la nyan// bka' brgyud kyi cho ris bzang dang gcig /snyan rgyud kyi nor thang che dang gnyis// gdams ngag gi bsri sogs mkhas dang gsum// nga rnal 'byor gyi chung ma de la nyan// zhen log gi mig rtsa drung dang gcig /nyams myong gi phar bskyed che dang gnyis// don gnyis kyi rgyal sa zin dang gsum// nga rnal 'byor gyi bu tsha de la nyan// gsungs nas zhing byin so slob dpon de la phul/ zhing drag pa cig a ne de la gtad nas rgyags skyel bar byas nas dbyar de kho rang gi yul gyi phu na brag nag bya ba la bsgoms pas/ rmi lam na tha ba sra se ba cig la chu bcus nas rmos pas pha yod pa rmis pas/ 'bad pa dang snying rus bskyed dgos pa'i bdar go nas/ mgur gsung pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi sa gzhi la// dad pa sngon 'gro'i chu blugs nas// bdud rtsi lnga'i rlan gyis sbangs// 'khrul rtog med pa'i sa bon btab// gnyis med glang chen zung stobs nas// thabs dang shes rab mthong shol rtags// blo dang ldan pa'i thong mkhan gyis// brtson 'grus myur ba'i lcag gis gzhur// tha ba sra yang phed de mchi// 'bras bu dus su smin te mchi/

zhing pa'i dpe dang sbyar ba 'di/ rnal 'byor pa yi rmi lam lags/ (304)tshig tsam don la skyes pa med/ slad kyi byang chub sgrub pa rnams/ nyams su len nas de bzhin mdzod// gsungs te/ de nas rkang tseg phug tu zla ba gsum bzhugs/ rtse gsum phug tu zla ba gsum bzhugs pas/ sngar rje mar pas sgom chen pa mal cig na yun ring na skye rgyu'i yon tan mi skye bar ma skyes na rung ba'i 'dzin chags skye gsung pa de dran nas/ da yang gar shed 'gro dgos bsam tsa na/ a ne dang sring mo gnyis kyis chang cig khyer nas byung ba de 'thungs pas/ khong gnyis na re da mi rabs 'chad du ma bcug par/ rang yul du sdod la khyim thab gyis zer ba la/ mgur gsungs pa/ pha yul 'di dang po rta rgod kyi shul thog 'dra/ bar du bsha' lug gi ra ba yin/ tha ma dug sbrul gyi shun lpags 'dra/ nga yul med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde/ blo bde bas sprang po nyam re dga'/ nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ nor 'di dang po 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi 'dra/ bar du sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ tha mar srin bu'i kha chu 'dra/ nga nor med kyi sprang po blo re bde/ blo bde bas rnal 'byor nyams re dga'/ nyams dga' ba bla ma'i sku drin yin/ bag ma 'di dang po lha (305)mo'i 'dzum shes ma/ bar du srin mo rag sha gdong*/ tha mar ba rgan 'khyog med ma/ nga bag ma med pa'i rnal 'byor blo re bde/ blo bde bas sprang po nyams re dga'/ nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ bu 'di chung tshe nor bu rin po che/ bar du bu lon sdos drag po/ tha mar khyim tshes snying ring bod/ nga bu med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde/ blo bde bas sprang po nyams re dga'/ nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ ces gsungs so// gsum pa dka' bas gtum mo bde drod 'phrod pa'i yon tan ni/ a ne la mi rnams kyis ming po nas de mkhan gyi rgyags skyel ba byas pas/

dgun smad du song ba dang nas zho cig khyer byung nas*/ sprang po khyod kyi zhing rin 'dis khor ro zer nas song ba dang*/ de sngon thag byas slob dpon des rtsam pa dum cig dang mar dum cig byin pa dang*/ mdze po sprang rgan gcig shi ba'i thul rul cig gon nas brag dkar spo na yar phyin pas/ gro chen gro chung zer ba'i mi ngan gnyis byung nas/ sgom chen bya ba sa kar la sa 'dra ba la zer ba yin/ khyod 'dra ba la sgom ni med nges/ gzhi mal cig na sdod ni mi tshugs zer nas rtsam dang mar phrogs pa dang*/ mid la (306)na re khong mi gzhan gyis ni sgom chen pa la 'bul 'degs byed pa yang yod pa la/ khyed gnyis kyis nga la 'phrog pa zhan gsungs pas/ len 'degs dgos zer nas/ rje btsun gyi sku lus bteg cing sa la brdabs pas do gsad gsung*/ de jo bos gsan nas gro chen gyi mig bton/ gro chung bros par g.yang la 'dril nas shi ba la/ rje btsun na re ngas ni ci yang ma byas te/ chos skyong gi bka' chad yin nam gsung*/ la la na re gro chen long ba chos sgor zhugs nas/ dus phyis rje btsun la dug drangs mkhan gyi dmu long btsag phug pa yin nam zer te/ de la the tshom za te/ de'i bar lo grangs kyang sum cu so lnga tsam song 'dug pa dang*/ gro chen ni rje btsun rkyang 'phan nam mkha' rdzong na bzhugs dus zhabs la gtugs te/ sgom bzang po skyes nas yod zer la/ rtsag phug pa'i mig ni pha drug gi jo bos bton pa yin cing*/ dang po rang nas mkhan rgyud yin la/ rje khyung tshang ba dang*/ lnga rig shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa chos rje lo tsā ba'i zhal gsal yang mi 'dug la/ 'di rang mi 'thad la 'on kyang mkhas grub rnams kyis legs par brtags par zhu/ nga zhi byed ri byed pas ni med pa byed do// (307)de nas brag dkar du rdo yis skyor ba'i mal chung gcig rtsās bkang nas der ro smad bcug ste/ ro stod la slog rul de bkab nas/

stod zad pa dang smad nas bcad cing stod la rlan pa gcig gon nas zwa'i tshod ma la thal ba btab nas gsol zhing brtson 'grus dang*/ snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms pas/ lus kyi zungs legs par zad la/ lag pa'i rkang thur bye nas yod tsa na/ nyin gcig sgro 'thu mkhan byung pa la zhungs bstan pas/ rtsam pa bag tsam cig byin nas yon bdag byed par khas blangs pa la/ yang mi la las de mal gcig tu sdod kyang mi tshugs pa cig 'dug pas/ de la sgom ni med zer bas/ sgom chen pa bya ba sa dkar la sa 'dra ba la zer ba yin/ dgon par sdad chang gtsag snyal slang gsum rgyun mi 'chad/ yon bdag pho mo 'du zer bas/ kho blo 'gyur nas yong ma nyan/ dus phyis 'gyod pa dang bcas nas bshags pa byas zer te/ de ni rag ma'i sku rim lha 'bar yin gsung*/ 'o nan ltar rgyal ba zwa tsha med sdor med/ rdza chung rugs pa'i dang*/ dge bshes bka' gdams pa la rdza ma g.yar ba'i gtam rgyud kyang yod do// de'i dus su dgung lo bzhi cu pa yin gsung*/ yang nyin gcig (308)skad cig grag nas ltas pas/ khyi ra ba 'dug pa'i rtsar byon pas/ khyod mi rgod yin nam mi gzhung ma yin nam ci yin zer/ mi rang yin te bza' rgyu ma rnyed nas 'di 'drar song ba yin/ nga mid la sher rgyal gyi bu yin pa la/ khu bo pha bu rnams kyis sdang po byas/ der ngas kyang sdig pa mang rab bsags pas/ da ni skye shis 'jigs pas chos byas pa yin byas pas/ de rnams thos/ dang po rang khu bo mi bden te ring nas khyod kyang de tsam rang grags tsam yin/ 'o na yang da ngo mtshar che zer nas/ sha dang tsam pa byin nas yon bdag byed par khas blangs gsung*/ des zhag kha gcig 'bol song gsungs/ phyis ni brjed pa yin nam yong rgyu ma byung*/ mi gzhan gyis bsgyur yin nam gsung*/ de nas sring mo pe ta rgyal khams su sprang du song bas kyang*/ ming po brag dkar na 'dug zer ba thos nas mos lta ru yongs pa dang*/

ming po rid par song bas ngo ma shes nas/ phug pa'i sgo rtsar khor khor sdad pas/ mi las khyod su yin ci 'dod gsungs pas/ skad ngo shes nas ngu yin de nub sdad nas sla bo 'dra byas/ gzhan ni ci yang med zwa thug blud pas ni mos ma 'dod nas/ nang par (309)yang ngu yin song ba la/ yang zhag kha gcig tsam nas sprang zan dang gtor zan zo ba gang rnyed nas khyer byung ba zos la/ de nas kyang sprang zan yang yang bskyal byung gsung*/ nyin gcig ni/ nya ma kha gcig gis rtsam pa dang za rgyu 'dra khyer byung nas/ zhal lta ba yin pas phug sgo 'dir byon dang zer ba la/ gos ngan gyis phyi hrul/ zas ngan gyis nang hrul/ der yongs kyang skyug logs pa las lta rin chog pa med/ de ka nas mthong ba de yin byas pas/ skyabs su mchi ba skad zer nas song gsung*/ yang nyin gcig klong 'dar 'brog pa kha gcig byung ba la slong du phyin pas/ sngar gyi a ne der 'dug nas sbra'i tshugs shing cig khyer byung nas/ sprang po bla 'tshong ngo khyod 'dir shog gcig zer nas ded pa la/ bros nas phyin pas skrad dug rdo la 'thogs nas 'gyel bas/ yun ring rab gcig dran med du song gsung*/ yang lan gcig pe tas zhag nyi shu tsam ldang ba'i za rgyu rnyed nas byung ste/ mo na re khong mi gzhan gyis chos lugs ni lus bde la sems kyang skyid pa cig yong gin 'dug pa la/ ming po'i phung chos sdug chos 'di 'dra cig yong ba ang*/ lus mnar sems mnar ba'i phung chos gcig zer nas ngu yin song*/ der mi la'i thugs (310)dgongs la/ mo yang bden te chos kyi dag ma lan te/ nga rang snying rus chung bas lan pa yin bsam nas/ de'i dus na mkha' 'gro mas sku mnye byas/ gnad kyi 'khrul 'khor nyi shu pa slabs/ tsog bu'i lus kyi bde ba sngon med rtsal/ rgya mdud 'ching gi ngog gi steng rlung gi bde ba rtsal/ sbrul mdud kyi lhod kyis lus cha mnyam gyi bde ba rtsal/

don la shi ma shi med par sgom pas/ phyi nang gi rtsa rlung thams cad legs par 'khrugs nas/ shi rtags rnams tshang nas shi bar thag chod pa la/ yar tshes bdun gyi nyi ma dmar thag en ma chod pa de la/ pe tas gtor zan zo ba gang rnyed nas slebs pas/ gtor zan la chang 'dres pas gtor sha dang gtor mar dang de rnams gsol bas/ rlung khams non pas/ rtsa rlung rang sar rnyed nas song gsung ngo*// a la la pe ta mgon skyid bya ba'i sems can la sku drin can cig byon 'dug go /de nas zhag bcu gcig nas bde ba rang 'bar la song nas/ zas gos mi dgos pa'i ting nge 'dzin la song ste/ sngar gyi mal nas thon te/ brag dkar rta so dbu ma'i nub ngos kyi sgang zur der rlog gos de skyur nas bzhugs pas na/ bla ma mid la ras (311)chen gyis/ ma myang za dkar legs kyi chu lam nas byon nas/ zhag gcig rtsis gnyis rtsis bgrangs pa'i lo lnga bcu dang zhag bco brgyad kyi nyi ma shar 'dal de la/ rlung bcu po de gcig tu 'dres par 'dug pa la/ dus phyis ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i bzhed dgongs la/ rlung bcu gsum yin gsung ba'i 'bru non zhal las shes/ bla ma rje btsun rang gis sprul pa'i dpa' mo tshe dbang rig 'dzin ma la zhib par gsung zhing*/ jo mo tshe ring mas/ ras chung ngam slong ston pa bo te ra tsa la bshad la/ bho te ra tsas/ rje ras chung rdo rje grags pa la gsungs/ bla ma ras chung pas/ zangs ri rgya ras dang*/ ra shes snang dang*/ sgom chen chos rab dang*/ lha gcig ldem bu la sogs pa rnams la yang ci rigs su gsungs la/ khyad par du rje khyung pa ye shes bla ma la zhib rgyas su gsungs la/ drin can rnam gsum gyi zhal gdams khyad par can rnams la rgyal sras mi'i seng ge /lnga rig shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa/ zhang lo tsā ba grub pa dpal bzang pos kyang der bzhed cing*/ da ni bsod nams mchog tu gyur pa shākya'i dge slong g.yung ston zhi byed ri khrod pa ngas kyang de la kha don (312)bcad pa lags so// phyi rabs kyi chos mdzad rnam par dag pa rnams kyis kyang legs par brtag par zhu/

de nas zhag kha gcig tsam nas pe tas 'brog pa'i bal dug dang*/ khyi bal dang*/ ban bon gyi nam yas la byas pa'i snam bu sre mo cig dang*/ za rgyu zo ba gang khyer nas byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis da nga la mi dgos pa 'dug gis/ snam bu yang khyod rang gis gos gyis/ za rgyu yang khyod rang zo gsungs pas/ pe tas rje btsun gyi zhal la che re bltas nas/ sngar yan chad mo nam yong dus na/ rje btsun sha zad kyi zas rus mgo lpags pas g.yogs pa/ thal ba skya thul le ba shi la khad las med pa la/ de dus na rlung bcu dbang du 'dus pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sku sha bkrag mdangs 'od zer can du song ba mthong bas/ pe ta na re 'o na dag ming pos sangs rgyas sam der song ba min nam zer/ de'i dus su mgur bzhengs pa ni/ gnam brag dkar rta so dbu ma'i rdzong*/ dbu ma rdzong gi dkyil shed na/ steng na lho sprin smug po lding*/ 'og na thang dkar gshog pa rkyong*/ bar na gcan gzan rtsed mo rtse/ de lta bu'i dben gnas su/ nga nyal ba med pa'i 'dug lugs bde/ 'dzin (313)chags med pa'i 'gro 'dug bde/ zhum pa med pa'i rtul zhugs bde/ de tsam lus kyi 'khyer so yin/ gnyis su med pa'i lta ba bde/ thabs dang shes rab sgom pa bde/ zung du 'jug pa'i bsam gtan bde/ de tsam sems kyi 'khyer so yin/ lha bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi nang shed du/ lta ba thams cad 'dus na bde/ dbugs 'gro 'ong gnyis kyi nang shed du/ rnam rtog thams cad 'dus na bde/ thabs shes rab gnyis kyi nang shed du/ chos theg pa thams cad 'dus na bde/ lta spyod zung du sbrel nas bzhag /gdam ngag kha ru bton nas bzhag /nyams rtogs glu ru blangs nas bzhag /slad kyis byang chub bsgrub pa rnams// nyams su len na de ltar long*// gsungs so// de dus na dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa yin gsung*/ de nas pe ta la da khyod rang yang yul gzhan du sprang ba la song*/

nga yang grong yul du 'gro gsung nas/ rgya gar du 'gro bsam tsa na/ rnal 'byor pa cig dbus nas yongs pa la dris pas/ rje mar pa grongs nas lo gnyis song*/ de'i sngon la sras dar ma mdo sde grongs zer bas/ mid las spyan chab mang po byon nas/ gnam brag dkar rta so dbu ma'i rdzong*/ rigs bzhi (314)mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ gsung ba'i mgur de byon nas/ der rgya gar du 'gro ba'i spros pa bcad do// de nas mid la grub pa thob 'dug zer ba'i snyan pa thos nas/ gro chen long ba dang*/ rag ma'i sku rim lha 'bar gyis 'go byas rnams yong nas/ da mang yul du 'byon 'tshal zhus pas/ mi 'gro der nga'i rgyud pa 'dzin pa tsam mi yong gsung nas/ yar gung thang du byon pas/ pe ta na re ming po'i pho rtags bong bu'i tsam pa 'di ngo tsha bas snam bu 'di gon mdzod zer bas/ rje btsun gyis 'o khyod pe ta nga la drin che ba khyod kyi kha la nyan dgos gsung nas/ snam bu blangs nas dum bur btang ste/ snyan dang*/ shangs dang*/ phyag zhabs kyi mdzub gu rnams dang*/ gsang sdor dang*/ thams cad la shubs re mdzad nas 'dug pa dang*/ pe ta na re ngas dka' las de tsam byas nas btsal pa de/ phung po khyod kyis chud gsan zer nas 'thab pas/ rje btsun gyis ngo mi tsha ba la tsha zer/ 'di ni rang byung pho rtags yin// nga dang por skyes kyang gcer bur skyes// tha mar 'chi yang gcer bur 'chi// da lta gnas kyang gcer bur gnas// chos sku dri med gcer bu la// gzugs 'dzin ngo tsha spros dang (315)bral// chos brgyad gos kyis da mi g.yog /gsungs nas/ dpal ma na phar gshegs so//

bzhi pa zas gos kyi 'dun pa rang grol ba'i yon tan ni/ de nas snya nam phyogs su byon nas/ rgyags phu na jo mo 'od mo bas yon bdag byas nas bzhugs pa la/ slob ma re re tsam byung nas/ dgon pa byed dgos zer ba la/ sngar rje mar pas sgom chen pa mal gcig tu yun ring ba de mi dga' gsung ba de dran nas/ snya nam tsar ma la byon pas/ ston mo gcig 'dug pa la nang du ma tshud pas/ lud phung gcig gi khar bzhugs pas/ bud med gcig chu len du byung ba na re/ bla ma mi sru'am zer bas/ nga la skal ba cig 'dir yong ba men nam gsungs pas/ mo na re sgo ba la nga'i ngo shes yin byas pas chog lags/ nang du gshegs zer nas khrid de nang du tshud do// bud med de las dang skal bar ldan pa'i legs gsal 'bum me yin par 'dug gsung*/ de nas ston gral na mi rnams kyis/ mid la'i lo rgyus mang po gtong shing 'dug dang po mthu byas de nas chos snga 'gyur rnams zhus/ de nas mar pa lo tsā la chos zhus/ de nas brag dkar rta so na bzhugs nas bsgoms pas/ da (316)lta grub pa thob 'dug zer zhing 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la mdzo bdag gi rtsar mdzo rgyus sam bsam pa byung*/ der gcig gis ngo shes nas zhal la ce re ltas nas/ ngas mid la thos pa dga' de lan gcig mthong ba yin te/ de ni rnal 'byor pa 'di rang 'dra ba cig 'dug zer ba dang*/ mi rnams na re khyed yin nam zer ba la/ yin pa yang srid byas pas/ ngo mtshar che da ci nas ngo ma shes pa yin zer nas/ gral mgor bzhag phyag 'tshal/ thams cad kyis ston skal drangs nas/ mgur gsung par zhus pas/ snya nam pa thams cad mos nas/ de'i dgong kha tsam na/ sngags rdor mo bya ba des/ gos srab legs gcig g.yang lugs su byas pa cig byung nas mgur zhus pas/ nan ltar mos nas mchod gnas su bteg nas snya nam rtsar ma na bzhugs pa la/ dgun sgang chen lo gsar du song yang*/

snya nam pa rnams na re/ nged la 'brog sa dga' mo gcig yod de/ lha 'dre gdug pa can gcig gis bdag byas nas/ de la 'jigs zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ sa cha dang lung pa'i ming ji skad bya ba yin gsung pas/ khong rnams na re 'brog sa la phyi 'dre lung (317)bya ba lags zer ba dang*/ der mid la'i thugs la 'o na de ni/ rje mar pas nga la lung bstan pa'i gnas chen yin nges dgongs nas/ lung bstan rnams thugs la dran nas/ la phyi gangs kyi ra bar gshegs gsung ste/ thams cad kyis ji tsam bshol yang gsan du ma 'dod par/ ston pa shag 'gu dang*/ sngags rdor mos mgo byas pa'i/ ban skyes drug gis gshegs skyems byas nas/ rgyal gyi yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ la phyi ru phebs shing rtsam pa bre do/ 'bras bre gang*/ lug sha gzug phye dang gnyis/ mar rgya ma gang*/ de rnam dang rje btsun bdud brtugs dpal gyi phug mo cher bzhugs nas/ khong rnams kyang bzhag 'ga' nas rje btsun gyi dgun rgyags skyel ba dang*/ khong rnams yang dgun chos nyan pa la yong ba'i chad byas nas tshur yongs pas gangs la thog nas yul ngan 'khrigs/ pus gong nas tshur kha 'tshub chen po dang 'thab cing yongs pas/ mi nyal tsa na yul du slebs skad/ de'i tshe kha ba nyin mtshan bco brgyad babs/ ri klung thams cad bkang*/ der rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la 'di la re na ni shi ba las mi yong bar 'dug bsam nas/ rtse gcig tu dril nas bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin (318)gyi rgyun la 'byams nas gsol ma dgos/ de nas zla ba drug tu brin sna nam gnyis kyi 'brul chad de/ slob 'bangs rnams kyis rje btsun grongs par byas nas bdun tshigs dang*/ tshogs 'khor byas nas/ phyis le'u'i zla bar song tsa na/ yur ma byed dus rnal 'byor pa cig slong du byung ba la/ sngags rdor mo'i byan mos rje btsun dran nas ngus pas/ de na re ci la ngu zer/ nga'i bla ma mid la ras pa bya ba la phyi ru byon nas/

rgyags skyel bar byas tsa na/ kha ba chen po byung nas ma skyol bar grongs/ khyed mthong bas bla ma dran nas ngus pa yin byas pas/ de na re khong la ngas kyang chos gcig zhus pa'i bla ma yin/ khong yon tan can yin pas de rtsug mi 'grongs pas/ da rung ltar song nas yod zer der gtso bo la byas pas bden zer nas/ mi rnams kyang shi shul de yang mi lta bar zer yong zer te/ sngar gyi bu slob tshos gangs bshags nas/ rje btsun gyi gdung spyan 'dren du phyin pas/ ram ldings mar 'das nas glang ldings kyi gong 'phred lam ring mo'i mar zur sgang sna der ngal bsos pas/ stag 'phrod kyi mgo'i pha 'ong de'i kha na gsa' chen mo gcig 'dzegs nas bya ra snyeng nge yun ring du bltas nas (319)song skad/ der khong la la na re gsa' ma gis rje btsun gyi spur zos tshar zer/ da nam bza'i dum bu'am/ dbu skra 'dra yod dam gzhan med byas nas nan ltar nyams ma dga' nas ngu yin phyin pas gsa' babs pa'i shul na mi'i rkang rjes gcig 'dug pas/ de bas kyang ma dga' nas rtog pa skyes te/ lha 'dre yin nam bsam pas/ stag 'phred na slebs tsa na/ lam na phar stag cig phyi ltas byed cing song bas de bas kyang skrag cing phyin pas/ gzig 'phred na mar gzig cig phyi ltas byed cing song nas de bas kyang skrag cing phyin tsa na/ thang sprin pho brang gi chu 'gram der mi gcig song ba'i rjes cig 'dug /'dre yin par thag chod byas nas phyin te/ ra 'ug nas bltas pas gnas mthil na dud pa cig sngo 'khyug byung bas/ 'o na ci yin bsam gyin phyin pas/ tshar leb kyi chu 'gram der slebs tsa na/ rje btsun gyi mgur dbyangs lhang lhang bzhes pa thos pas/ 'o na khyi ra bas rgyags byin pa'am/ gcan gzan gyi thed 'dra rnyed pa des ma grongs pa srid dam bsam nas phyin tsa na/ pad phug dang phug chung gi bar de na tshur rje btsun byon nas byung bas/ glen pa kun da ci nas yong gin 'dug pas/

de'i (320)bar la mi slebs par de'i bar la khyed rnams kyis gang du bsdad/ du zan dang tshod ma yang drangs pa la phug tu myur du shog gsung ngo*// de nas bdud brtugs dpal gyi phug mdo cher phyin nas/ der dga' ches nas ngu bro bya ba der byung ste/ da lta de la bro mo che zer ba de yin/ la las rje btsun la 'o byas/ la las phyag la 'then/ la las nam bza' nas 'jus/ la las zhabs la mgo bos gtugs nas mang po ngus nas phyag byas snyun dris/ sngar gyi rgyags la phye bre do la bre gang las ma zad par/ bre gang la zan chang byas 'bras phul bzhi zan du btsos/ sha gzug phyed la tshod ma byas gda' ba la/ khong 'dre ban bkris/ sgom chen tsakra/ skyo ban khams gsum/ skyo stan dbang snying*/ shaka mgu pha bu gnyis/ sngags rdor mo dang bdun yod pas/ nged rnams yong ba rje btsun gyis ji ltar mkhyen zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ngas da ci pha 'ong gi steng nas bltas pas/ khyed tshos 'phred lam na tshur bsher byung nas 'go der ngal bos nas 'dug pa ngas mthong gsungs/ yang zhus pa/ bdag cag gis pha 'ong gi steng na gsa' cig 'dug par mthong lags/ de tsa na rje btsun gang na bzhugs (321)gyin yod zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ da ci gsa' cig bya ra snying byed cing 'dug pa dang*/ stag gzig la sogs pa 'dug pa de ka nga rang yin mod/ rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ lus mi snang bar sbed pa dang*/ lus sna tshogs su sprul ba dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i skye mched gzil gyis gnon nus par 'byung ste/ da res ngas khyed la bstan pa de rdzu 'phrul lus kyi bkod pa bya ba yin/ ngas de ltar byed shing 'dug zer ba'i gtam mi la ma zlos/ da res khyed rnams bsam pa dag nas mthong bar bshad gsung*/ yang sngags rdor mos zhus pas/ rje btsun lags na ning bas kyang sku mdangs shin tu bzang bar gda' ba la/ la sgo gnyis kyi lam ni kha bas chod/
