lha 'dre kun gyi zhabs tog byas pa lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ gzhi phal cher ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun la 'jam nas za ma dgos/ res 'ga' ni phye thur ma re tsam la skyo gal byas/ res 'ga' ni dus bzang ba'i tshe rgya gar gyi mkha' 'gro mas tshogs 'khor gyi skal ba skyal/ thang srin rgyal po 'dis kyang zla ba gsum tsam zhabs tog byas gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ kha sing nga 'dir (322)yongs pa'i zla ba'i smad de la/ khyed bu slob rnams kyi mtha' skor nas bza' btung rnam pa sna tshogs drangs pa snyam byed pa zhig nga'i nyams ma byung*/ de nas zhag nyi shu tsam du za snying yang mi 'dod pa gcig byung*/ de tsa na khyed kyis ci byas pa yin gsungs/ der khong rnams kyis zhag grangs rtsis pas/ bdun tshigs byas pa dang dus mtshungs par 'dug zer/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bar dor bdun tshig snyag pa gal che zer ba de mad par 'dug ste/ de bas kyang bar dor da lta bcad na rlabs che ste gsung ngo*// de nas khong rnams kyis rje btsun la nang par snya nam du gshegs par zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis zhal nas/ nga 'di rang na nyams dga' ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'dug /khyed rang song gsungs pa la/ yang khong rnams kyis bla ma da res phar ma gshegs na/ nged la snya nam pa kun na re khyed kyis rje btsun 'grongs su bcug pa yin zer nas/ gtam ngan chen po yang byung lags/ jo mo 'or mos kyang nga'i rje btsun khyer la shog zer nas phrin ngan yang yang byung bas/ bla ma mi gshegs na/ nged yang phar mi 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis khong tsho'i (323)nan ma theg par zhal gyis bzhes te/ de'i nang par byon pa las/ khong tshos sngon la 'ongs nas/ rje btsun byon nam ltas pas/ rje btsun ni gangs la rtsar me gtong gin bzhugs 'dug pas/ der khong rnams kyis rje btsun lags nam mkha' la 'phur nas byon pa lags sam zhus pas/

mid la'i zhal nas/ 'phur ba rang yang min te/ kha ba'i thog na phar rkang rjes ma dor tsam du 'ong gsung*/ de nub rdza ma phug na bsdad pas/ rje btsun gangs kyi thog na gzims pas/ gangs sbra mal tsam zhig bzhu nas 'dug /khong tsho ni 'dar phad de song zer/ 'di'i dus su rje btsun 'brog la phyir gshegs pa'i lo de stag lo yin zer ba dang*/ rje btsun gyi dgung lo'i grangs dang mi mthun par snang bas ngas the tsom cung zad cig za bas mkhas grub rnams kyis kyang brtag par zhu/ lar rnam thar la mthun na grub thob min bya ba yin no// yul nges med na gang zag nges med la/ spyod pa sna tshogs nges med gcig ston pa yin no/ de nas nang par gangs la byon pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ res 'ga' ni nga gangs la zug par 'dug gsungs nas zhabs gar bzhags pa na/ lcags sregs (324)bzhag pa dang khyad mi 'dug /res 'ga' ni nga gangs la 'dred cing 'dug gsung nas/ zhabs gangs la ma reg par 'byon zhing 'dug /res 'ga' ni ngas khyed tsho'i lhags bsrungs byed kyis yor mo byed gsung nas/ sku lus ni mkhar chen po tsam mdzad par snang*/ res 'ga' ni ngas khyed tsho'i nyi ma sgrib par 'dug gsung nas/ sku lus ni nas 'bru tsam mdzad par snang*/ de nas mar byon pas/ gdu bu'i bcu bdun la snya nam du phebs pas/ de nas chu mig mgo mangs na mar byon nas/ ting gung du 'gro byas pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga rnal 'byor pa gangs kyi seng ge 'dra ba slebs pa la/ bsu ba la shog gyis gsung bas/ ston pa shag 'gu'i bu sngon la btang bas/ yul pa rnams la rje btsun 'byon shing yod pas/ bsu ba la shog byas pas rdzun yin zer nas yid ma ches/ gtso bo'i bu rta zhon nas ltar song bas/ sna nam tsar ma'i pho med mo med bu tsha tshun chod kyis rje btsun ma grongs par 'byon shing 'dug zer ba thos nas/ khong thams cad shin tu dga' nas/ sngon bsu ru yongs te/

pha 'ong dka' leb kyi rtsar 'tshogs te (325)bskor ba byas/ phyag dgu phrug 'tshal phyag rten byas/ snyun dris gsol bas/ de'i dus su bla ma rje btsun la phyag 'khar sba'i ber ma lcag gcig yod pa de/ pha 'ong dka' leb kyi steng du oṃ rtsugs su byas nas/ khong lha mi rnams la snyun lan mgur du gsungs pa 'di skad do// dpal de ring bkra shis khri gdugs la// khyed phyag mjal gyi yon bdag pho mo rnams// 'o skol ma shi bar 'phrad pa blo re dga'// nga mi rgan glu'i skor mdzod yin// snyun dri med kyi lan kyang glu yis 'jal// snyan lhen gsan cig bu slob rnams// yong stag gi lo'i lo bzhugs la// yos bu lo'i lo mgo la// wa rgyal zla ba'i nyer drug la// 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar phyin// gnam sa gnyis po gros byas nas// 'byung ba chu rlung g.yos g.yos nas// lho sprin smug pos 'dun ma sdus// nyi zla gnyis po brtson du bzung*// rgyu skar nyi shu stod la rgyus// khrims kyi gza' brgyad lcags su bcug /dgu tshigs skya mo stod la gnan// skar chen yongs la bud kyis btab// bud kyi thang lo g.yos pa'i tha ma la// kha ba nyin dgu mtshan dgu babs// babs che ste che la bal 'dab tsam// 'dab chags lta bur lding zhing (326)babs// chung ste chung la 'phang lo tsam// bung ba lta bur 'khor shing babs// yang chung sran ma nyungs dkar tsam// zhu 'phang lta bur 'dril zhing babs// lar kha ba che chung tshad las 'das// mtho gangs dkar gyi rtse mo dgung dang mnyam// dma' rtse shing nags tshal rgya zho gnon// mtsho chu rlabs can la dar chags btab// ri nag po rnams la sku dkar gsol// gtsang chab sngon mo sbugs su bcug /sa mtho dman med par thang du mnyam// kha ba de ltar che ba'i ngang nyid kyis// spyir sems can mi la bzang brtson byung*// dgos rkang bzhi'i phyugs la mu ge babs// dgos ri dwags dman pa'i lto skal bcad// steng 'dab chags bya la rgyags chad byung*// 'og bra ba byi ba'i ldem bu rdib// gcan gzan rnams la kha chings byung*// de 'dra'i skyin thang skal pa la// steng nas babs kyi dgung yabs dang*// lo gsar sgang gi ltag pa gnyis// nga rnal 'byor mi la'i ras gos gsum// gangs dkar stongs su 'khrug pa shor// kha ba babs rgyal chab du zhu// rlung 'ar 'ur che yang rang zhir thal// ras gos me ltar 'bar zhing gda'// dpa' la rdor gyi 'khrug pa de na rgyal// gyad des bzhi'i srog shing de rung snol// mtshon rtse rgyal gyi ral kha de ru sprad// spyir sgom chen rnams la tshad de bor// dgos gtum mo ras kyi che ba bton// nad 'du ba (327)rnam bzhi srang la mnyam// phyis nang 'khrugs med par gnya' brtan gyis// rlung tsha grang gnyis po bcud la btab// phyis ci zer nyan par kha yis blangs// kyin thang kha ba'i rdo sri mnan// phyis g.yo mgul med par rtsis la phab// spyir dmag tshogs bgyid yang ma dgos par// dus da res kyi 'khrug pa de rgyal nas gda'// nga mes kyi tsha bo stag lag can// sngar wa lag gon nas 'bros ma myong*// nga pha la bu skyes gyad kyi rigs// ldang dgra la lta zur shor ma myong*// nga gcan gzan rgyal po seng ge'i rigs// gnas gangs kongs men par sdod ma myong*// sho mad kyang ku re byas pa lags// nga mi rgan kha la gtad yod na// phyin chad sgrub brgyud dar te mchi// grub thob kyang 'ga' re 'byung ste mchi// cha la rnal 'byor ras pa 'di// bod rgyal khams tsam la grags su mtho// khyed bu slob bsam gyin mos par mchi// sho gtam snyan yod pa phyis nas zlo// nga rnal 'byor dbyar khams snyoms par gda'// khyed yon bdag pa sku khams bzang lags sam// ces gsungs nas/

pha 'ong dkar leb de sbra tsam zhig 'dug pa de/ zhabs kyis rdzis nas jar jir la btang nas 'dug /zhabs (328)rjes nyi shu tsam 'dug /da lta de la byin rlabs chen po 'dug go /de nas mar byon nas yang 'phur nas byon/ he byams kyi stod kyi ri rtsa der sbra dkar phub nas bzhugs pa dang*/ de'i nub mo sngags rdor mos byon skyems drangs nas/ da lo'i kyin thang chen po 'dra la rje btsun sku khams bzang por byon pa dang*/ nged bu slob rnams kyang shi chad med par mjal ba shin tu dga' bas/ rje btsun gyis thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i gdam ngag tshig bzhi pa cig gnang 'tshal zhus pas/ gnad kyi mdo drug mgur du bzhes/ de nas bkra shis sgang gi dkar leb phug na zhag bdun bzhugs skad/ de nas 'phur nas byon te 'brug gi phug mo cher bzhugs skad/ de nas ston gung thang du phyin pas tsas ma byed dus su/ ston mo gcig la srus pa'i sar/ mi gcig gi ngo shes te mchod gnas byed zer ba la bros nas mon gyi rol la gshegs so// yang rje btsun mon yul 'bro kha bzhir byon dus na/ ltad mo ba mang po byung nas/ snyad pa ti si re zer nas log song*/ mon skad shes pa cig la ci zer dris pas/ mi la ras pa zer ba'i dge bshes chen po gcig yod zer tsa (329)na/ gzugs kyang chung se ba cig las mi 'dug /ltad mo ba la gser kyang mi ster ba 'dug /de 'dra la dgos pa ci yod/ dge bshes bya ba ba ri lo ts+tsha ba la zer ba yin/ ltad mo ba la gser yang ster bar 'dug /khong rang la yang zangs dung dang*/ cha lang dang*/ ca sa yang 'dug zer skad/ phyi res kyang mon yul la byon/ bsnyen bkur drangs pas rje btsun na re/ na ning ni khyed tsho nga la ma dad/ da res bsnyen bkur byed pa ci yin gsungs pas/ da res khyed seng ge la chibs nas nam mkha' la byon byung ba lags zer skad/ 'bro kha bzhi yang mid la'i yon bdag yin gsungs so//

lnga pa nyams myong bde bar shar ba'i yon tan ni/ ku thang gi rkang mthil phug gi shel phug nam mkha' rdzong na bzhugs dus su/ yon bdag kun gyis gdan 'dren pa la phyin pas/ g.yos cha la sogs gang yang med par bzhugs 'dug pas/ gshegs par zhus pas ma gnang par mgur gsungs pa/ me tog sna tshogs skye ba'i gnas// shing rnams gar thabs bsgyur ba'i gnas// sprang sbrul g.yang rtsal sbyong ba'i gnas// de lta bu'i dben gnas na/ ji ltar (330)'dug kyang bde ba ste// 'du 'dzis dben na yongs kyang bde// ngag la gleng brjod med na bde// smra ba nyung na yongs kyang bde// ting 'dzin bying rgod med na bde// sems nyid gsal na yongs kyang bde// lus la gtum mo 'bar na bde// drang dro med na yongs kyang bde// dbugs la 'gro 'ong med na bde// 'gyu ba khegs na yongs kyang bde// gnyis su med pa'i lta ba bde// thabs dang shes rab sgom pa bde// nor la 'dzin chags med na bde// zhen pa thongs na yongs kyang bde// theg pa che chung med na bde// gcig tu rtogs na yongs kyang bde// sra ba'i 'bol stan thog na bde// bal po'i srin ras thog na bde// rang rig bde gsal sems la bde// 'di rnams rtogs pa'i spyod tshul yin// ces gsungs nas gshegs par ma gnang ngo*// drug pa rtogs pa lam mkhan du shar ba'i yon ton ni/ ku thang che yul gyi khu byug dben pa rdzong na bzhugs dus su mjal ba rnams kyis/ lam la ma thar nas nad pa 'dra yang byung nas/ sa cha bde sa gcig tu bzhugs par zhu zhus pas/ khyed tsho la lam mi bde yang*/ nga la lam mkhan (331)bzang po yod gsung*/ mgur bzhes pa/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa de// mun pa sel ba'i lam mkhan yin// skyo dub med pa'i dad pa de// bde 'gror 'dren pa'i lam mkhan yin// sku gsum 'bral med ting 'dzin de// rnam thar skyong ba'i lam mkhan yin// dbang po drug gi thug phrad de// rnam rtog sbyong ba'i lam mkhan yin// 'du 'dzis dben pa'i dben pa de// bsam gtan sbyong ba'i lam mkhan yin// grang dro med pa'i ras gos de// zhen pa spong ba'i lam mkhan yin// lam mkhan drug gi sna drangs nas// mkhar gyi rdzong la 'jug kyang 'tshal// 'jigs kyis dogs nas mkhar gcig brtsigs// mkhar ni chos nyid stong pa'i mkhar// da yong 'jigs snyam mi bgyid do// skyo yis dogs nas grogs cig btsal// grogs ni bde stong rgyun gyi grogs// da yong skyo snyam mi bgyid do// 'khyags kyis dogs nas gos cig btsal// gos ni gtum mo lhun grub gos// da yong 'khyags snyam mi bgyid do// nor gyis dogs nas lam gcig btsal// lam ni 'od gsal yangs pa'i lam// da yong nor snyam mi bgyid do// ces gsungs so//

bdun pa snang ba mthun rkyen du shar ba'i yon tan ni/ skyid pa nyi ma rdzong na bzhugs dus su/ (332)bu slob kun gyis 'dir mthun rkyen gang yang mi 'dzom pas/ 'dzom sa cig tu gshegs par zhu zhus pas/ mgur gsungs pa/ chu shing gang na yod tsa na// g.yog po zer ba rdzun du gda'// za rogs 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// skye 'gro sgyu mar rtogs tsa na// sgra tshad zer ba rdzun du gda'// tshogs sogs 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// sems kyi rin chen gter rnyed nas// nor rdzas zer ba rdzun du gda'// gser dngul 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// sgom pa rang byung shar tsa na// dug lnga bya ba rdzun du gda'// rnam rtog 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// gtum mo lus la 'bar tsa na// gos leg zer ba rdzun du gda'// snal gos 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// ces gsungs so// brgyad pa nye 'brel chos brgyad rang grol ba'i yon tan ni/ brod phug na zer te min/ brag dkar spo mtho rdo rje rdzong na bzhugs dus su/ grwa pa bco lnga tsam yod tsa na/ sngar gyi a ne des/ g.yag yu bo cig la sha mar thud gsum mang po bkal nas g.yog cig khrid nas/ mo rang bong bu cig la zhon nas mjal du byung ba la/ lcam mo pe ta na re ngas ma ki la 'thab du 'gro ba yin/ sngon ci yang med tsa na nye 'brel med pa la/ da mi dgos zer nas (333)mjal du ma ster ba la/ rje btsun gyis thabs mdzad nas/ yol bas bar mdzad nas/ phyir bzhag ste mgur gsungs pa/ sngon rgya lnga yul gyi rtsa don du// nye 'brel dgrar langs kyi sdug smad gsum// sran phung ber kas gtor ba bzhin// 'dris med yul du 'khyams dus su// a ne zhes pa cig kyang med// brag dkar spo mtho dgon pa ru// bkres skom lcag gis bskul ba'i tshe// a ne btsal yang ma rnyed par// sprang po bla tshong shog cig zer// tshugs shing ston nas ded du byung*// a ne'i ming can bdud mor 'dug

/gsungs pas/ mo na re bden zer nas ngu yin song skad/ a ne mjal ba de/ la las se shod man shing gi grod phug yin zer/ la las brag dkar rdo rje rdzong na yin zer te de yang med/ snya nam gser phug gis stag gi a ne med phug zer ba de yin gsung*/ gting nas kyang thugs rjes gzung ste yang yang mjal gsung*/// / ༈ dgu pa chos brgyad rang grol ba'i yon tan ni/ de'i dus su se ban ras pa la sogs pa bu slob rnams kyis dgon pa gcig gzung nas/ lo zhing dang ba re yang byed par zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis mgur gsung pa/ zhen pa med pa'i nags tshal du// sgyu ma lus kyi zhing po (334)cher// sems nyid rin chen ba mo bzho// ngo bsrungs med pa'i yon bdag skyongs// chos brgyad dgon pa'i rta mi rgyug /ces gsung nas ma gnang ngo*// der se ban ras pa la sogs pas 'o na ldom bu byed dam zhus pas/ rgyal khams ba zho bzhin du skrogs// skyid sdug srang kha mtho dman mnyam// mi spyod tshod ma'i tsha bzhin myangs// da yong ldom bu mi bgyid do// gsungs so// bcu pa pha ma'i drin lan bsabs pa'i yon tan ni/ rkyang 'phan nam mkha' rdzong na bzhugs dus su/ gung thang gi bon po mnga' thang can cig yod pa de/ bu smad kyis bkang kyang phag na yar gdams ngag zhu ba cig yod pa la/ lan gcig 'chi nad kyis btab nas kha smra mi 'dod pa la/ lcebs pa'i gtam du btang ba la/ kha chems zhog dang*/ khyod rang gang zer byed pa yin byas pas/ 'o na nga rang gi nor gang thob pa de/ mid la ras pa can du khyer la bdun tshigs zhus zer/ bu mo chen mo dpang por bzhag pas/ bu smad kyis kyang kho rang ma shi bar skal ba skyal bas/ shi ba dang bdun tshig byas pas/ phyi de nyin par bon po'i nye du rnams kyang bos ste/ rnam shes 'gugs pa'i dus su/ dngos su byung nas mtshan byang (335)'khrud pa'i dus na/ dngos su khrus byas lam bstan pa sogs zin pa dang*/

rje btsun la phyag 'tshal nas bka' drin che lags so zer nas song ba dang*/ bon pa'i bu smad la sogs pa ngo mtshar skyes pa dang*/ pe ta ngo nag ting song bas ci nyes byas pas/ ming po la khrel med/ rang re'i pha ma dmyal bar bzhag nas/ mi gzhan la 'di ltar mdzad pa zer ba'i lan du/ mgur gsungs pa/ 'chi bdag dbang po pha ma yi// lus kyi shing dor sems kyis byas// 'dris shes med pa'i rgyal khams su// cig bur gnyis med 'khyams gyur pas// ting nge 'dzin gyis dgug gzhug bgyis// sgyu ma lus kyi hoṃ khung du// 'gro drug skye ma'i bud shing la// skye ba med par me bcug nas// ro ni gsal stong ngang du sbyangs// bdun tshig snang stong nyid du byas// cha tsha skye ba med par btab// zas ni bde ba chen por gtad// lam ni gnyis su med par bstan// bsngo ba phyag rgya chen po byas// smon lam brjod du med par btab// pha ma'i drin lan 'khor te mchi// gsung ngo*// bcu gcig pa lha'i lhar gyur pa'i yon tan ni/ nyin cig 'gron po gcig byung nas rje btsun drin du sku khams gseng ba la gshegs pa de/ spyan 'dren (336)pa la byon pas/ ras ngo mtshar can cig sku la gsol/ a ru ra'i rgyal po cig phyag na bsnams 'dug pa la/ ras chung pas 'di rnams gang nas byung zhus pas/ mi'i bdag por rigs kyi rje// chos rgyal chos kyi spyan can gyis// shing bal 'jam gyi ras gos 'di// gtum mo lhun grub grogs su phul// gsung ste/ bal po'i rgyal po chos kyi spyan can gyis/ bal po mthil nas gzigs stangs kyis phul ba/ bla ma mid la ras pas gzigs stangs kyis bod nas blangs zer/ nga lha'i lha yin gsungs so// gzhan yang de'i dus na yongs su grags pa'i grub thob bzhi bya ba yin te rgya gar nas byon pa'i dam pa rgya gar/ bal po shi la bha ro/ stod mnga' ris na bu rangs tshem chen/ smad na mi la ras pa dang bzhi yod pa la/

shi la bha ro de/ rgya gar dharma bho dhir byas nas/ bod kyi mi la ras pa la phyag cig 'tshal dgos gsung nas/ bal po'i rdzong nas bod du 'gro zer 'dug pa la/ rgya bod thams cad zhal lta ba la bal po rdzong du 'tshogs pas/ yon bdag dang slob ma rnams kyis mi la ras pa la mi thams cad 'gro bar 'dug pas/ 'o skol yang gshegs pa zhu byas pas/ rje btsun gyis nga rgas (337)pas mi 'gro gsungs pas/ mi rnams na re mi la ras pa chos pa bzang zer te/ chags sdang byas par 'dug zer nas bskur ba btab pas/ se ban ras pa la sogs pa rnams kyis rje btsun la 'di skad zer bas/ rang re yang gshegs par zhu zhus pas/ mi la'i zhal nas/ rgya gar dharma bho de la phyag len du 'gro gsung*/ se ban ras pa la sogs pa bu slob rnams kyis/ 'o na zhag 'ga' bzhugs nas gser 'dra khyer nas byon nam zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ gser 'dod na nged gnyis ka grub thob min gsung nas bal por byon pas/ khrom rnams mi la byon zer ba dang 'ur nas byung ba dang*/ rje btsun pa 'khyogs nas rgya gar ngos su 'phur nas bzhud pa dang*/ dharma bho dhi khrom bseb nas 'phur nas mdun du byon pa dang*/ yang mid la ras pas bod ngos su 'phur nas byon pas shi la bha ro nam mkha' la 'phur nas/ mid la ras pa'i mdun du byon nas/ bar snang la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mi la ras pas phyag lan ma byas/ dharma bho de'i zhal nas/ mi la ras pa bzang bar 'dug bya bar grags so// der mi rnams kyis bsam pa la/ grub thob gnyis dang mjal bas da chos zhu tsam na/ dharma bo dhi 'phur nas rgya gar du gshegs/ mi la ras pa (338)'phur nas bod na phur byon pas/ rje btsun la mang chung gi yon bdag rnams kyis sna len byas nas/ mi la la dharma bo dhi'i lo rgyus dris nas/ phyag lan mi mdzad pa ci yin byas pas lan la re na grub thob min/ gsungs nas mgur bzhes pa/ yongs bal po yul kyi ljongs bseb tu/

bod kyi mi la ras pa la/ rgya gar dharma bho dhi yis/ sgyu ma lus kyi phyag byas nas/ zung 'jug thal sbyar pus btsugs te// sku khams phyag rgya chen po dris// brjod du med pa'i grong khyer na/ mi la dbyar khams snyoms par mchi// gnyis su med pa'i dgon pa na// rnal 'byor sku khams bde'am byas// gsungs pas/ de dus mi rnams med na/ dharma bho de khong ring thung gi zla ba cig gam phyed sdad pa yin te gsung ngo*// bcu gnyis pa rtsod pas mi brdzi ba'i yon tan ni/ rje btsun gung thang na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ grwa pa dang bsnyen bkur mang du byung ba la/ ston pa dar blo bya ba dang po mtshan nyid nyan/ de nas bka' gdams pa byas pa gcig yod pa la bag re gnod pa cig byung ste phra dog skyes nas sdig pa bag re sog pa cig yod pas/ nyin gcig sha mar khyer te/ phyag rten byas nas mjal du byung bas (339)rje btsun gyi phyag rnal du ma blangs pas/ khong na re/ khyed gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos rnams rang ji ltar 'dod/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu nyams su ji ltar len/ zer nas bgro gleng byed du byung ba la/ rje btsun gyi lan legs po ma thebs pa dang*/ khong na re thos bsam sgom gsum gang yang ma byas pa'i rmongs pa mgo bo re nag gi gtums pa cig /mi nag pa'i dad zas gshin zas thams cad chud gsan zer nas/ rje btsun brdungs zhal du sa btab pa la/ 'khor rnams na re/ brdung lan byed dgos zer ba la ma brdung bar ras chung pas nga'i ram bu 'then cig gsung nas mgur bzhes pa/ ser sna'i mdud pa ma khrol bar// sbyin pa btang bas ci la phan// rang sems g.yo sgyu ma spangs par// tshul khrims bsrungs pas ci la phan// tshig rtsub mtshon cha mi thub pa'i// bzod pa'i phub chung ci la tshugs// 'khor ba'i lam 'phrang mi chod pa'i// brtson 'grus rta pho ci la rgyug /gang snang chos su ma shes pa'i// bsam gtan bsgoms pas ci la phan// ngar 'dzin sdong po mi chod pa'i// shes rab ral gris ci zhig gcod// rang sems dug sbrul mi zin pa'i// thabs kyi lcags kyus ci zhig 'dzin// ngar (340)'dzin mgo bo ma thul ba'i// stobs kyi tho bas ci zhig brdung*// bya spyod tshogs su mi 'gyur ba'i// smon lam btab pas ci la phan// rang sems ngo bo mi 'phrod pa'i// ye shes skyes pas ci la phan// sgoms te sangs rgyas mi 'tshal bar// thos pa che bas ci la phan// cha la ma sgoms gyi nar 'khyams// gsungs pas dad nas/

mis zer ba yang mi bden pa 'dug zer nas/ chos zhus te bsgoms pas/ bsgom bzang po skyes te su la yang mi smra ba cig byung ngo*// bcu gsum pa ye shes sgron me bltams pa'i yon tan ni/ rje btsun grod phug na bzhugs dus su/ ras chung pa la chos ngo mtshar can lnga yod pa de khyod kyis rgya gar du len nus sam gsungs/ bla mas song gsungs na nus lags zhus pas/ 'o na khyod rang yang gser sog /ngas kyang bsag gis gsungs nas bsags pas/ rje btsun ni gser bzhes gyin 'dug zer nas/ gser 'bul ba mang po byung nas/ ras chung pa rgya gar du gtong byas pas/ mi rnams na re thos pa 'di yang bag re dgos pa ci yin tshod du 'dug /mi la yang ston pa dar blo'i rtsod pa ma thub pas/ da ras chung pa rgya gar du rig pa slob tu gtong (341)bar yod pa 'dug zer nas 'phya' ba la/ bu slob rnams kyis ras chung pa mi gtong bar zhus pas/ mgur gsungs pa/ thos chung rtsod pas pham pa dang*// nyams myong zhan cing the tshom skyes// rnal 'byor ldog pa'i 'phrang bzhi yin// nga dang po thug sa ma nor bas// nā ro pa yi rgyud pa btugs// bar du bsgom pa ma nor bas// brag dkar spo mtho'i rdzong la bsgoms// tha mar ldoms sa ma nor bas// 'dris med bshes med yul du ldoms// gcig tu gsang sngags thabs lam che// gnyis su bla ma'i byin rlabs che// gsum du nga rang sgom sran che// de la che ba rnams gsum mdzod// gcig tu mkhas la zhabs tog dgos// gnyis su bla ma'i gdams ngag dgos// gsum du rang la shes rab dgos// de la dgos pa rnam gsum mdzod// gcig tu yo byad sna tshogs 'du// gnyis su mched lcam sna tshogs 'du// gsum du mkha' 'gro sna tshogs 'du// de la 'du ba rnam gsum mdzod// gcig tu lung dang gdams ngag mthong*// gnyis su bde ba dngos med mthong*// gsum du snang ba had por mthong*// de la mthong ba rnams gsum mdzod// spyod pa glang chen thabs su gces// rang rig bde gsal sems la (342)gces// phyag rgya mtshan ldan grogs su gces// de la gces pa rnams gsum mdzod// cig tu chos nyid klong du chud// gnyis su srog rtsol gnad du chud// gsum du chos la byan po chud// de la chud pa rnam gsum mdzod// de nas rnal 'byor mi ldog kyang*// bla ma sangs rgyas 'di skad gsung*// rig pa ye shes sgron me gcig

/rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo gnyis// ro snyoms phyi'i me long gsum// rang grol phyag rgya chen po bzhi// bde chen gsung gi rin chen lnga// nā ro'i slob pa yod srid pas// nga na so rgas pas ma thon gyis// rang chung ma 'dug rgya gar song*// gsung nas chos rnam lnga blangs so//

bcu bzhi pa spyod pas che ba'i yon tan ni/ rje btsun gung thang na bzhugs dus na/ rdzing bu rgyan gyi chu mig pa bya ba'i sde pa cig gi sdig pa sogs/ ras pa byung tshad rdo kha la 'dod pa cig yod pa la/ nyin cig rje btsun der gshegs gsung ba la/ bshol btab kyang ma gsan par gshegs pas/ sgo rtsar slebs pa dang*/ gtor skyel dang 'phrad nas mi la 'dug byas pas/ thams cad kyis bos phul ba rdeg pa la sogs byas te/ khyod la za mi dgos na 'dir sdod gcig (343)zer te/ khyim cig du bzhag nas sgo la lcags bcug pas/ phyir byon 'dug pas/ yid ma ches nas/ khyim du gtsang khang gi ka ba la bcings nas/ lcags bcug bzhag pas/ bcing mkhan de rang ching gi bcings nas 'dug pas/ ngo mtshar skyes pa dang*/ nga rang ma dga' na khyed kyis 'phul bas mi 'phul gsung bas/ thams cad log nas phul bas ma 'phul bas/ ji ltar lags zhus pas/ shel sgong bar do'i sems bzhin du/ sgrib med thogs brtugs kun dang bral// bzung mi zin la btang mi thongs// skar mda' lta bu'i spyod 'gros kyis// ma dad sel phyir byas pa yin// da ni spyod pa mi byed do gsung*/ gzhan skabs gcig la/ mi rnams kyi snang ngo la nyi ma gcig la/ brin du sngon pas nags la me shor ba'i gseb na tshur byon pa dang*/ snya nam du zam sdings nas/ chu nang du 'phur ba dang*/ grod phug tu thag rings gi sgom chen pa la chos bshad pa la sogs pa mthong snang mi 'dra ba mang du byung ba la/ thams cad kyi ngo mtshar che nas chos ston cig zhus pas/ mes mi tshugs la chus mi khyer// spyod pa glang chen 'gros kyi gar// dag pa'i 'gro rnams thams cad la// tha dad sgra yang de nyid min// ces gsungs so// (344) bco lnga pa nus pa che ba'i yon tan ni/ drin gyi la so dgon pa der// nyin mo yang sus kyang 'gro mi 'phod pa'i brag phug cig tu gshegs gsungs pas/ 'dre gnyan pa'i lo rgyus zhus nas gros btab pa'i/

ma gsan par ras chung pa dang dpon slob gnyis gshegs song bas/ sa sros pa dang*/ bud med chen mo cig byung nas/ nga'i 'di na su yod pa zer ba dang*/ thugs dam gtad pas bros nas song*/ de nas brin gnya' nam gnyis kyi 'dre rnams bos nas byung bas kyang ma thub nas/ 'dzam bu gling gi 'dre rgyal po gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i/ rgyal po dang the rang zad med cig byung nas gros byas pas de gnyis na re/ dang po song bya/ de nas ma nyan na dam blangs la de la ma nyan na gzod dmag drongs zer ba la/ kha cig byung nas khyed 'dir ma bzhugs par bzhud/ mi bzhud na 'dre mo 'di la gnas cig blang zer bas/ rje btsun gyis ma gnang bar/ 'dre tshan gnyis 'dug sa'i/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyis dmag drangs pas ma tshugs/ dkar po'i rgyal po de yongs nas/ nged rnams la chos kyang zhu/ dam kyang blang bar zhu zhus pas/ gnang nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang chos (345)gsungs nas/ da phan chad la so 'di ru su byung yang gnod pa ma byed cig byas pas/ da lta sus phyin kyang gnod pa mi yong ngo*// zhag bdun bzhugs pa'i nang par/ brin pas chos ston byas pas/ 'dir sus kyang sdod mi phod pa lags na/ ci tsugs lags zhus pas/ brin gyi la so dgon pa ru// sgyu ma lus kyi skyil krung bcas// gnyis su med pa'i mnyam bzhag bcas// skye ba med pa'i dmigs pa la// yengs pa med pa'i blo bzhag nas// ma rung stong phrag brgyad cu yi// gdon gsal nad pa yo nas slang*// gsung ngo*// gzhan yang snya nam sa'i nad pa ci byas kyang ma drag pa la/ gnyis su med pa'i sman sbyor byas// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad pa la// dam chos sman gyi sman sbyor byas// gsan na nad kyang sol sol 'dra// gsungs so// bcu drug pa byin rlabs che ba'i yon tan ni/ shel phug nam mkha' rdzong na bzhugs dus su/ yon bdag gi bsnyen bkur skyel ba la yongs ba'i lam khar nags seb nas stag byung bas/

der bla ma bsgoms pas stag kha dang nge lus 'dug skad/ der rje btsun gyis mkhyen nas bzhad pas/ drung na yod pa rnams kyis ci lags zhus pas/ 'di ltar 'dug gsungs/ de nas yon bdag (346)na re/ rje btsun gyi byin rlabs min na/ stag gi do gsad zer pa la/ mi la'i zhal nas/ ri khrod 'grims kyi rnal 'byor gyis// mthun rkyen sgrub kyi yon bdag la// stag la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa yi// bar chad mkha' 'gro ma yis sel// gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyis shing la 'dzegs pas/ phyag gi mthil du shing zug pa la 'bras su song bas/ lo gnyis su yang 'drag tu ma 'dod pas/ ras chung bas mi sha btang yang 'drag tu ma 'dod pas/ ras chung ba blo ma bde bar yod pa la/ khyod blo ma bde'am gsung*/ ma bde lags zhus pas/ 'o na bcos dgos gsung tsa na/ nang par rjes med du song 'dug pas ci mdzad nas drag zhus pas/ rlung gis skyon gyis bskyed pa'i shing*// sems med shing gis gdon byas pa'i// 'bras kyi zug rngu mi bzad pa// sman sbyor mkha' 'gro ma yis byas// gsungs so// yang rkyang 'phan nam mkha' rdzong na bzhugs dus/ ngam rdzong ras pa dang*/ ras pa zhi ba 'od la sogs pa/ bcu tsam gyis rnal 'byor ma'i thang sku dang*/ tsa ka li 'dres pa tshan cig bzhengs nas/ rab gnas zhus pas/ me tog 'thor dus su/ mi la rgas nas me tog 'thor (347)mi nus pas/ dgos na lha khyod rang longs gsungs pas/ ras gzhi la gog langs nas byung ba'i dbu thog tu me tog dor ba dang phar thim pas/ ngo mtshar che zhus pas/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// me tog gzugs sku zhen med dag /len yang de nyid yin snyam med// gsungs so// yar ras chung pa dang ngam rdzong ras pa dang*/ legs gsal la sogs bcu tsam gyis bde mchog gi dbang zhus pas/ bum dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ mid la rgas nas yod pas/ dbang lha khyed rang gis dbang yang bskur gsung shing 'dug pa dang*/

bum pa nam mkha' la 'phur byung nas/ rim bzhin du mi rnams kyi spyi bo nas bum dbang bskur ba dang*/ mi rnams kyis ngo mtshar che zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis/ snyan rgyud dri med dkyil 'khor du// zhen pa med pa'i mchod bshams nas// sangs rgyas ye shes ngo sprod dag /chu dbang dri med bum pas bskur// bskur ba de nyid yin snyam med// ces gsungs so// bcu bdun pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal gyi che ba'i yon tan ni/ bka' gdams pa'i bla ma zhang sne zur pa dang rje btsun mi la gnyis ni/ dngos su zhal mjal ma byung ste/ yid kyis grogs po yin pas/ gsung yig dang skyes kha yar (348)skur mar skur re mos mdzad te/ bla ma sne zur pas/ ja shong zi sol par skur ba yin/ lar yang rje btsun ja dang sha skam la nan ltar mnyes pa yin zer/ rje btsun gyi rgyal mo ka ra dang*/ a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba bskur ba yin zer/ bla ma zhang sne zur ba de ka ra dang a ru ra la mnyes pa yin zer/ bla ma sne zur ba'i slob ma dad pa dang shes rab che ba/ khyad par du gsang sngags la mos pa gcig yod pa la/ bla ma sne zur ba'i zhal nas/ gtsang la stod kyi snya nam grod phug bya ba na/ mi la ras pa bya ba'i grub thob gcig yod par 'dug pas/ khyod rang der gdams ngag zhu ru 'gro'am gsungs pas/ 'o na 'gro lags zhus nas/ phyag rten dang lam rgyags skur nas yar chas pa dang*/ bla ma spyan snga ba'i slob ma cig bal por mchod cha nyor 'gro ba dang gnyis po dus gcig yong bas/ snya nam gyi pha 'ong grod phug na rje btsun bzhugs pa dang mjal bas/ rje btsun na re/ jo bo gnyis po ci la byon pa yin gsungs pas/ sne zur ba'i slob ma de na re/ bdag sne zur bas gdams ngag zhur btang ba lags zhus pa la/ mi la'i zhal nas jo bo'i gtam drang gsung*/ spyan mnga' ba'i slob ma des kyang*/ nga yang bla ma spyan (349)mnga' bas gdams ngag zhur btang ba lags zhus pas/

rje btsun gyi jo bo rdzun ma byed bal por mchod cha 'tshol du 'gro ba la lam na bar chad med par tshur bde mor sleb nas yong bar 'dug gis gsungs so// yang rje btsun na re khyed kyi yul dbus rig pa'i 'byung gnas de rnams su grub thob bam khyad par 'phags pa cig 'dra bzhugs gsungs pas/ sne zur ba de kha rog 'dug pa la/ spyan snga ba de sgo drags par 'dug pa na re/ bla ma spyan snga bas yid dam gyi zhal gzigs zer bas/ de 'dra yang grub thob byed dam/ 'o na grub thob med par 'dug gsungs pa dang*/ se ban ras pas bla mas kyang yi dam gyi zhal gzigs sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis/ sems kyi ngo bo mthong gyur cing*// ma rig mun pa sangs pa na// zhal dag mkha' 'gro mas kyang ston// chos nyid blo la lta bsam med// de yang grub thob yin snyam med gsung*/ yang rje btsun na re de men pa gzhan med dam gsungs pas/ spyan mnga' bas yi dam gyi lha dang*/ nā ga bho dhi la chos gsan pa de grub thob yin zer bas/ mi las/ dmigs med yid la mi byed cing*// drag pa rdul tsam med pa yi// rang rig rang gsal rang byung gi /chos (350)de mkha' 'gro mas kyang ston// de yang grub thob yin snyam med// gsungs/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bla ma'i bka' la gnyen pa med gsung so/ bla ma spyan snga bas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnang gang 'dod pa blang du yod zer bas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ mi zad mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa/ dgos pa thams cad sgrub ces mkha' 'gro mas kyang gsungs/ de la grub thob yin snyam med/ gsung*/ yang de na re/ nyan po slob dpon la lha thang lhas bshos 'dren lags/ de grub thob yin zer bas/ mid la na re/ 'dres zan ster ba la yang grub thob du byed dam 'o na grub thob mi 'dug ces gsungs/ se ban ras pas bla ma la yang de 'dra yod dam zhus pas/ mi la na re/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod lta bu// ting 'dzin sems kyi g.yo skul gyis// bkres skom sems zas kyi 'dun pa ni// bral bar mkhar 'gro mas kyang byed// de yang grub thob yin snyam med// gsung*/

gzhan yang brag dmar spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong na/ dpon slob kha gcig bzhugs dus na/ brag gi rtse mo na/ sku khams gseng ba la byon pas/ rje btsun rlung gis bskyod pa ltar du g.yengs la yar bas slob (351)ma rnams kyis ngu yin phyin pas/ rje btsun ma grongs sam zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ zung 'jug thang dkar gshog brkyang nas// 'phur ba brag dkar rtse nas 'phur// babs pa rong khung shod du babs// myong ba bde stong gnyis med myong*// grol ba 'khor 'das shugs las grol// da yong 'grongs snyam mi bgyid do// gsungs so// dus phyis brag de la dres thag gis 'jal bas/ 'dom pa dgu bcu tham pa 'dug zer te/ des tshad pa mi 'dug lags/ yang nyin gcig brag chung se ba gcig gi mdun du rje btsun bzhugs pa la/ bud med gsum byung nas khong gsum na re/ rje btsun der ma bzhugs zer nas byung la/ de'i phyi nyin de bas kyang mang ba cig byung la/ bzhi pa la de bas kyang mang gcig byung la/ lnga pa la de bas kyang mang bar thal nas/ nyin gcig mang rab cig byung nas/ rje btsun gyi nam bza' ras 'ga'i zur nas 'then byung nas/ brag zur cig na byon pa dang*/ brag de hrul zhig song bas/ sgom chen rnams ngu yin yongs nas bla ma ma 'das sam zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor lus kyi me tog gi// srog 'joms brag dmar gshed ma las// mkha' 'gro ma yis drangs nas yong*// da (352)ni bdud kyis khyer snyam med gsung*// gzhan yang gung thang gi ling pa brag dmar na// brag srin mo ming sring dam la btags pa dang*/ 'brol la phyi chu bzang du bdud mo la sogs pa mi ma yin rnams dam la btags pa dang*/ dben pa brin du tshe ring ma mched lnga la sogs pa snang srid kyi lha 'dre rnams dam la btags pa dang*/ mon 'gro'i yul na lha 'dre rnams dam la btags pa dang*/ bal por dur khrod kyi sha za dam la btags pa dang*/ ku thang na stag la kha chings mdzad pa dang*/

rag ma na klu bdud mo dam la btags pa dang*/ rkyang 'phan na grib btsan dam la btags pa dang*/ brag dkar rta so na the rang skya bo dam la btags pa dang*/ brag dkar spo mtho na klu btsan bram ze dam la btags pa dang*/ smin 'khyug grib ma rdzong na the rang sngon po dam la btags pa dang*/ ku thang gi brag skya rdo rje rdzong na klu rgyal rigs dam la btags pa dang*/ khra tshang srin po rdzong na dug sbrul la khrid btab pa dang*/ skyid pa nyi ma rdzong na nyi ma brtod la gnan pa dang*/ dben pa khu byug rdzong na bya kha ta la khrid btab pa dang*/ rtsig pa rkang mthil rdzong na 'phar ba la khrid btab pa dang*/ gangs ti se na bon po na ro ming (353)sring btul ba dang*/ ri bo ga dha li na brag btsan dam la btags pa dang*/ rgya gar lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sku la mjal ba la byon dus na/ ku mu da sbra ma'i jag sa me tog du sgyur ba dang*/ byang a 'dar tsha kha la byon dus na/ khrung khrung la chibs nas tsha mtsho la mar ston pa dang*/ shar tsong kha la byon dus tsong kha'i rgyal pos 'dam seng dkar mo zho drangs pa dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i pad ma'i rdzong drug du/ rje btsun mi la ras chen gyi bzhugs dus nas yang*/ rgya brag nam mkha' rdzong du nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud gzigs pa dang*/ sbas phug ma mo rdzong du ma mo 'dul ba'i rgyud gzigs pa dang*/ stag phug seng ge rdzong du stag mo kha 'thab kyi rgyud gzigs pa dang*/ la phug pad+ma rdzong du pad+ma dbang chen gyi zhal gzigs pa dang*/ khro rgyal rdo rje rdzong du rta mchog rol pa'i zhal gzigs pa dang*/ glang sgo klu'i rdzong na klu bdud nag po dngos su bton nas dam la btags pa dang*/ 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar gla ba la khrid btab pa dang*/ chu mig dngul 'bum na klu btsan ya med dam la btags pa dang*/ pha 'ong grod phug tu lha dkar po dam la btags pa dang*/

gangs (354)ti se'i lha btsan dkar po la ras khrid du btab pa la sogs bsam gyis mi khyab bo// bla ma mid la ras chen gyi bu chen yang*/ gung thang khyi ra ba'i gnyan ras chung rdo rje grags pa dang*/ slur pa'i sgom stag ras pa dang/ blo bo'i jo dor ras pa dang*/ rta mo'i 'bri sgom ras pa dang*/ snya nam mdo bkra'i se ban ras pa dang*/ rong nag mo'i rong chung ras pa dang*/ snya nam rtsar ma'i legs gsal 'bum me dang*/ brin gding ma'i legs gsal 'bum me dang*/ cung pa che chung gi legs gsal 'bum me dang*/ gung thang gi yon bdag mo lcam me dang*/ ras ma chos kyi byung chub dang*/ ras ma rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*/ ras ma ye shes byang chub dang*/ ras ma chos kyi sgron ma dang*/ brag rgya zhu'i ras chung zhi ba 'od dang*/ rib kyi khyi ra ras pa mgon po rdo rje dang*/ rta nag gi blan sgom ras pa dang*/ rong la'i gshin sgom ras pa dang*/ zar 'dzo'i ngam rdzong ras pa dang*/ snya nam rgyags phu'i ras ma 'or mo dang*/ de'i bu dam rgyags chung ba dang*/ snya nam rtsar ma'i sngags rdor mo dang*/ rtsar ma'i ston pa shag gu dang*/ gung thang gi dge bshes stong tshab dar ma blo gros dang*/ rtsar ma'i skyo dpag khams gsum rnam rgyal (355)dang*/ rtsar ma'i 'dre ban bkra shis 'bar dang*/ ku thang gi phug ron phyug mo klu lcam dang*/ mon yul 'bro kha stod kyi gtso bo chos skyabs dang*/ bar tshogs gi gtso bo don ne dang*/ kha smad kyi gtso bo 'phan rgyal dang*/ mon la'i gtso bo dkon mchog gzung nge dang*/ skyid grong rag ma'i ku rim lha 'bar dang*/ lcim lung gi ngam rdzong 'bar dang*/ gtsang chung ras pa dang*/ rdor dbang ras pa dang*/ mkhar chung ras pa dang*/ dgon pa rka kyog gi li khor khyur ru pa dang*/ snya nam gyi 'or stan dge 'dun skyabs dang*/ ras chung pa bla ma grags dang*/ se ba lung gi dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen dang*/ brin sding ma'i yon sgom 'bar ba seng ge dang*/

brin sding ma'i yon sgom dkon mchog 'bar dang*/ sding ma'i yon bdag mo rgyal mo skyid dang*/ snya nam dur sna'i ras chung sangs rgyas skyabs dang*/ bong shod kyi mer sgom ras pa dang*/ rkong po'i kong skur ras pa dang*/ sna bug gi ku rims dar ma rgyal mtshan dang*/ 'bring mtshams kyi ras ma mkha' spyod ma dang*/ snya nam gyi yon bsgoms brtsegs bkra shis dpal dang*/ snya nam gyi skyo ston dbang phyug snying po dang*/ bal po'i rgyal po dharma pha la (356)dang*/ brin rta rdzi phug gi yon sgom chos 'bar dang*/ cung pa'i yon sgom dbang phyug shes rab 'bum dang*/ ding ri sna dmar gyi lha rje g.yeng dang*/ brin sding ma'i yon sgom bkra shis rtse dang*/ mi nyag gi tshong pa a mgon dang*/ ngam rdzong phu'i yon sgom shes rab 'bar dang*/ rma shod kyi rgyal bu don grub dpal dang*/ zla shod kyi yon sgom 'phan bzang dang*/ tsong ka'i rgyal po dar ma 'bum dang*/ gung thang gi 'dzangs mo ras pa dang*/ la stod byang gi dge shing ras ma dang*/ tsa yul gyi ras pa shes rab tshul khrims dang*/ 'khar chu'i ras pa shag btson dang*/ mtha' bzhi 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang*/ pham ston grog ra ras pa dang*/ la g.yag gi jo sras tshul khrims rdo rje dang*/ de'i mched ye shes rab grags pa dang*/ dge lnga phug pa bzang po dpal dang*/ lung skam ras pa bde legs dpal dang*/ de la sogs pa mi las dang skal bar ldan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkod pa'o// chos phur zhu tshul mdzad pa'i sprul sku yang*/ la stod pha drug gi zha chung bsod rgyan dang*/ yung gi dge bshes me ston dar ma mgon po dang*/ pha (357)drug gi mnga' bdag rje khri ba dang*/ dge bshes 'brang la sa shākya 'bum dang*/ yang sngags pa ston pa dar ma 'bum dang*/ go lung gser khang pa sangs rgyas gzungs dang*/ phu 'gegs pa dge bshes 'phan bzang dang*/ g.ya' ma mkhar gyi zhu ston tshul khrims byang chub dang*/

pha drug gi jo mo jo lcam yul skyid dang*/ sgrig gi jo mo sgron ne dang*/ yon phyug ma'i legs skyid dang*/ yon phyug ma lu byug dang*/ yon phyug ma 'or mo dang*/ sgom mo rgya mtsho 'dren dang*/ ma cig zha ma lha rja ma dang*/ she mo rgya lcam ras pa dang*/ rgag mo ras pa dang*/ sor ma legs skyid dang*/ lha lcam 'od de ras ma dang*/ mdzangs mo skyid 'dren ras ma dang*/ dge mo btsun lcam ras ma dang*/ jo mo g.yang chung ras ma dang*/ sprul pa'i sku de rnams ni dag snang gi mched grogs yin la/ lar rje btsun gyi sku tshe gang po de rang la yang*/ las dang skal bar ldan pa du ma rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i nang nas/ rje btsun zhal bzhugs pa'i gong du yang*/ grub thob pho nyi shu/ mo lnga dang nyi shu rtsa lnga yong bar snya nam grod phug na bzhugs dus na/ mkha' 'gro ma yis lung bstan byung ba la/ lus khyer ba yang lnga byung ba la pho gsum ni/ (358)zhi ba 'od dang*/ rong chung ras pa dang*/ 'bri sgom ras pa dang gsum yin la/ kha cig ni ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs yin yang zer/ mo gnyis ni ras ma chos kyi byang chub dang*/ ras ma 'bring mtshams ma gnyis yin no// lo khor cha ru ba dang*/ dwags po lha rje la sogs pa kha gcig ni/ rje btsun grongs pa'i rjes na/ grub thob chen por byon par 'dug la/ yang rkyen ngan grogs su chod nas lam sna zin pa yang*/ rdzing bu rgyan gyi dge bshes chu mig pa dang*/ mang yul gyi gro chen long ba dang*/ brin u lung gi dge bshes lam ston dang*/ gung thang gi dge bshes stong tsho bdar lo dang*/ gangs te se'i na ro bon chung ming sring gnyis dang*/ 'dam shod kyi lug rdzi dang*/ byung tsha kha'i ri shing gi gcan gzan rnams dang*/ shar tsong kha'i bshan pa dang*/ dge bshes tsag phug pa dang*/ de la sogs pa rnams yin la/ gangs ti se na bon po bton pa la byon dus na rje btsun la sku 'khor ni/ gshen sgom ras pa dang*/

li khor phyag ru ba dang*/ cung pa'i kre phyag gi 'dzang mo ras ma cig dang*/ gung thang gyen lang gi dge bshes za ras ma bzhi dang*/ dpon slob brgyad byon pa la/ li khor ba dang (359)mdzangs mo gnyis blo bo na mar btang nas/ dpon slob drug yar byon nas/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyis rtsod pa mdzad nas bon po bton nas/ ti ses phrogs pa'i lo rgyus zur na gsal/ de nas ri bo ga dha lar ras chung rnams bzhag nas/ rje btsun chen pos rgya gar lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la 'gro mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sku la mjal du byon nas/ zhag bcu bzhi la tshur phebs nas mar res la stod byang dang lho nas byon te/ dpal he ru ka'i pho brang brin chu dbar du phebs pa la sogs pa rgyas par zur na gsal/ gzhan yang bla ma mid la rnal 'byor pas/ rgya gar gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la/ dngos grub kyi tug mo che phyag rten du blangs nas/ gnas mchog chen po 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba btab pa dang*/ la phyi na bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur bcom nas/ gtsong rong phug la stim pa dang*/ la phyi rna g.yon du sa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang*/ bdud brdugs dpal gyi phug mo cher/ chu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang*/ 'chong lung na me'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang*/ ri bon po gnyen gyi rtse mo na/ rlung gi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang*/ sman lung chu dbar gyi yang dben (360)du/ dpe bral nam mkha'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang*/ de la sogs pa'i mdzad pa dang 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams mnga' zhing*/ gzhan gyi blo ris dang bstun nas mgur gsungs pa rnams ni/ grangs las 'das kyang*/ yongs su grags pa rnams kyi thog ma de rje mar pa'i drung du/ rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang lan cig yul du gtong bar zhu// a ma lus kyi sgrom bu de// 'jig gam ma 'jig lta ru 'gro// zer ba de yin/

de'i dus na dgung lo sum bcu so dgu pa yin/ de nas sngon ma yod tsa na bu yang med// zer ba de yin/ de nas dge bshes tsa ba la gsungs pa'i stong nyid lung yangs ma de yin/ de nas rmi lam brda' ston ma tha ba sra yang phed de mchi/ zer ba de yin/ de nas kong rtse ma dang brag dkar du sprin dkar ma dang*/ lho sprin ma dang*/ yang brag dkar skor gsum/ de nas snya nam rgyags phur jo mo 'or ma la gnas kyi zhal gdams gsungs/ 'brog la phyi la shing bzang skor gsum/ ram lding skor gsum/ chu bzang skor gsum/ gangs 'gur skor gsum/ rtsar ma na sngags rdor mo la gnad kyi mdo drug /gung thang na (361)rdzing brgyan ma/ ling nga skor gsum/ rkyang 'phan bdun tshig ma/ rdzong bco brgyad ma rnams/ mon yul 'gro skor rnams/ sing kha nags su khyi ra bskor gsum/ se ban ras pa la shi brod thigs tshags ma/ zhi ba 'od la dngul 'bum ma/ lcim lung na byang 'bar ma sba 'gur skor gsum/ legs gsal 'bum me la long med lnga ma/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa la g.yag ru skor gsum/ rkyang mgur skor gsum/ gangs ti se na gangs mgur rnams/ tshe ring skor drug /mdor na 'bum tsho gcig dang khro tsho gcig dang*/ stong tsho cig dang brgya rtsa brgyad gsungs par grags te/ rje khyung tshang pa dang mnga' ris zhang lo ts+tsha ba'i lo rgyus la gsal zhing nga zhi byed ri khrod pas kyang*/ khri tsho gcig tsam mthong lags so// mgur zhabs ni/ sprul pa'i dpa' mo bkra shis tshe dbang rig 'dzin ma'i pho brang*/ 'brog sman lung chu dbar gyi yang dben du/ 'khor lo sgyur rgyal ma gsungs pa de lags so// yang rje btsun dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje dbang phyug mid la ras chen des/ bdag 'dzin gzhi dgon gyi 'khri ba bcad nas/ gnas nges med ri khrod pas mtha' 'grim pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ lho brag lung (362)pa phu mda' dang*/ gra dol gzhung gsum dang*/ ri bo sgang dang ce phu gur dkar dang/

tsa phu brag dang*/ tsa phu brag dmar dang*/ brag dkar spo mtho dang*/ rta so dbu ma dang*/ za 'og phug dang*/ 'od gsal phug dang*/ rkang tse phug dang*/ rtse nyang phug dang*/ ra gyang phug dang*/ ling nga brag dmar dang*/ smin 'khyug grib ma rdzong dang*/ rag ma byang chub rdzong dang*/ rkyang 'phan nam mkha' rdzong dang*/ ku thang na yang brag skya rdo rje rdzong dang*/ khra tshang srin po rdzong*/ shel phug nam mkha' rdzong*/ dben pa khu byug rdzong*/ skyid pa nyi ma rdzong*/ rkang mthil phug /rtsig pa phug /mon yul bro'i ri khrid rnams dang*/ sa dkar phug dang*/ pad ma'i rdzong drug rnams dang*/ bcung pa'i ri khrod rnams dang*/ snya nam rgyags phug dang*/ gnam phug dang*/ mkhar phug dang*/ chang rdza phug dang*/ ri sib/ si rib sing kha nags dang*/ la phyi gong dang*/ 'brug dang*/ skyid dang*/ bkra shis sgang gi dkar leb dang*/ he byams dkar leb dang*/ a ne med phug dang*/ pha 'ong grod phug dang*/ chu mig mgo mang*/ pus gong*/ rdza ma phug /dkar leb/ chu bzang phug /shing bzang phug chen/ ram sding (363)phug chen/ ra 'ug zhal dkar/ ra 'ug shar nub/ ra 'ug brag rtsa/ tshar leb gong 'og /sbas pa kun gsal/ bdud brtugs dpal gyi phug mo che/ dpa' le brag thog /pad+ma phug byang rta phug /zur phug /dam phug /lung bstan phug /dngos grub phug /dkar chung phug /gcong rong phug /pad pa yang dben/ rtsang gdong gong 'god// ras chen shar nub seng rdzong gong 'og /ze phug gong 'og /bsil ba 'tshal/ rna g.yon sum mdod/ dngos grub kyi rug pa gong 'og rnams dang*/ yang dben sa brin du yang*/ rga ru phug dang*/ dom phug /gnyug sdengs/ rgyab ri phug rnams dang*/ bon ri phug rnams dang*/ yang dben phug mo che/ spo mtho gong 'og /sngo rdor phub/ dur khrod dang*/ mgur chu phug rnams dang*/ 'om chung dang*/ skyed dkar phug dang*/ krong khri bkra shis sgang dang*/ shel phug dang*/ bla ma phug dang*/ brag mkhar dang*/ brag dmar spo mtho dang*/

rdo rje skyid phug /'chong lung dang*/ brin smad kyi bla ma phug /la so phug stod smad/ bal po'i ri khrod rnams dang*/ mdor na rgya gar dpal gyi ri tshun chod dang*/ smad kyi shar tsong kha yan chod dang*/ byang (364)a 'dar tsha kha tshun chod la/ yun ring thung ma gtogs pa/ bla ma mid la ras pas ma bzhugs pa tsam med la/ ri khrod 'grims pa'i zhabs ni/ sding ma brag mkhar nas tshur byon nas/ brin sman lung yang dben gyi chos khri dkar chung la sku rgyab btad nas bzhugs pa des bsdus pa lags so// pha mid la ras chen bdag ni khyed kyi zhabs dang skad cig kyang 'bral ba med do// gzhan yang bla ma mid la ras pa 'dis/ 'gro ba shin tu dman pa rnams kyang*/ smin grol la bkod pa ni grangs las 'das so// yon bdag dang slob ris kyang*/ rag ma'i sku rim lha 'bar ni/ rje btsun brag dkar spo mtho na bzhugs dus su lha 'bar skor thu ba la yongs ba dang mjal nas yon bdag byas pa yin zer/ jo mo 'or mo ni yul phyogs kyi zhen pa byas nas/ yon bdag byas pa yin zer/ sngags 'dor mo yang yul phyogs kyi zhen pas yon bdag byas pas yin gsung*/ snya nam rtsar ma la 'dre sngags shud gsum sho skong bkra shis rtse la sogs pa rnams ni/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rna ba g.yon pa go ta wa ri zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog chen po/ 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar (365)bzhugs dus na yon bdag yin gsungs/ dkon 'bar dang*/ 'bar sing la sogs ni/ bla ma rje btsun mid la ras chen la/ skyes mchog mar pas lung bstan pa'i/ brin sman lung chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang der bzhugs dus kyi yon bdag yin gsung*/ gzhan yang bu slob rnams 'di'i dus na mar mjal zer ba rnams/ kho bo lo rgyus ci rigs su yod te 'dir yi ge mangs nas ma bris pa yin la/ de yang skyes mchog mar pa lo ts+tsha zhes bya ba'i lho brag paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ bla ma mid la ras chen la/

rje nā ro mi tris thog drangs nas/ bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gdams ngag rnams ma lus par gnang nas/ 'di skad gsungs te/ 'o bu khyod sgrub pa byed pa la/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rna ba g.yon pa/ 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba zhes bya ba/ rigs gsum mgon po'i pho brang der song la sgrub pa gyis gsungs pa la sogs pa gnas kyi dkar chag rnams ni bdag gis sbyar ba'i zur na yod do// yang rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ nyi ma gtsang la stod kyi lho nub kyi sa cha na/ brin bya ba'i lung yod na/ 'brog rma shod sman lung chu bar zhes bya ba dben gnas cig yod la/ de yang rig pa ngang gis dwangs pa'i rtags su ra chu g.yas nas (366)'bab pa dang*/ 'chi med phyag rgya chen po yun mi ring bar thob pa'i rtags su smin chu g.yon nas 'bab pa dang*/ yum bcom ldan 'das ma'i pho brang yin pa'i rtags su/ 'og na chos 'byung zur brtsegs yod pa dang*/ sa'i rten phur la rdo pha bong khyung sgong lta bu yod pa dang*/ lung pa'i dbus steng na brag dmar po spre'u yi gdong ba 'dra ba la/ bya kha ta'i tshang yod pa dang*/ lung pa'i mda' na rtsi shing nags tshal sna tshogs yod la/ de rnams kyi shing lo re re'i steng na/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro bye ba rnams kyis/ rdo rje'i glu gar dang bcas nas/ gar stabs sna tshogs bsgyur ba/ don la he ru ka'i pho brang der gzhan yang yon tan du mas brgyan pa der khyod kyis song la sgrub pa gyis dang*/ yun mi ring bar mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa yin gsungs pa la sogs pa dkar chag rgyas par bdag gis sbyar ba rnams zur na gsal lo// yang bod yul gyi tsa ri dang*/ ti se dang*/ 'di pa gnyis ni/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rtsa mchog gi grong khyer na byon pa'i mdo dang*/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma bod nas rgya gar du byon pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/ jo bo chen po rje lha cig a ti sha mnga' (367)ris na byon pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/

paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shri dbus nas byon dus kyi gtam rgyud dang*/ rje mar pa lo ts+tsha bas lho dug mtsho khol ma'i 'gram na dpal zhi ba bzang po'i drung na mjal dus kyi gtam rgyud rnams la bltas na/ tsa 'dra dang*/ te 'dra yin nam bya ba 'dug la/ rje mar pa'i lung bstan ni mi 'dug la/ te se 'di bon po la phrogs pa la/ bla ma rje btsun ras chen de/ mnga' bdag rtse ldes gdan drangs nas/ zhag gcig te ser bzhugs nas te se phrogs/ bon po ming sring bton pa'i lo rgyus ni rnam thar chen mor gsal/ tsa ri la ni ye rang byon skad mi 'dug la/ shākya thub pa'i sprul pa'i chos rje sa skya paṇa chen la sogs pa'i/ bod kyi mkhas grub phal che yis ni/ bod yul gyi tsa ri te se 'di gnyis dngos min/ tsa 'dra te 'dra yin pas dngos kyi go ni chod gsung bar 'dug la/ rje btsun rgyal ba rten ne dang*/ chos rje nyi seng la sogs kyi zhi byed pa'i grub chen kha cig kyang*/ dwags po rin po che lha rje pa rang gi ni gsung sgros mi 'dug ste/ de man chod kyi dwags rgyud pa phal che yis ni/ gnas chen rang yin par bzhed do// 'on kyang rje mar pa dang*/ rje btsun mid la ras pa yab sras kyi zhal gsal yang mi 'dug la/ rje khyung (368)tshang dzña na gu ru dang*/ mnga' ris zhang lo ts+tsha ba'i zhal gsal yang mi 'dug kho bos kyang mdo rgyud du ma rnams la/ bya ngang pa chu la mar len pa lta bu cig byas pa la/ tsā ri ti se gnyis kyi gsal cha kha tshon chod pa rang ma mthong bas/ der kha tshon chod ma phod la/ chu bo si ta'i 'gram dang*/ ri bo gangs can na yod bya ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang*/ rma bya chen mo'i mdo na 'dug la/ byang phyogs sham bha la dang*/ lho phyogs tra zhes bya ba dang nye bya ba yang 'dug ste/ kho bos kha tshon rbad ma chod nas rang sor bzhag la/ bod yul gyi tsā ri te se 'di gnyis la dngos su ma phyin te/

lar 'di gnyis kyang sgrub gnas khyad par can re yin nges par 'dug pas/ phun sum tshogs bsam nas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros dang*/ te se'i nyi ma byang chub dang*/ tsā ri'i bya btang ras pa dang*/ de rnams kyi chos zhal yang mthong ba la brten nas/ kho bos kyang dkar chag re byas pa yod do// gzhan yang rje btsun mid la ras chen gyi bzhugs gnas rnams la/ bdag gis mi shes pa tsam med pas/ dkar chag re re byas yod do// lar (369)bla ma mid la ras pa 'di'i rjes su zhugs nas/ 'chi chos rang cig byed na gnas nges pa can byed du med do/ kho bo zhi byed ri khrod pas kyang gnas mal cig na nag sem me mi sdod pa de ltar lags so/ lar sgom chen pa rab de bar snang gi 'brug 'dra ba/ 'bring de gangs kyi seng ge 'dra ba/ tha ma de ri rtsi bas kyi spyang khu 'dra ba/ mtha' chad de 'gron khang gi gnas po 'dra ba cig dgos zer ro/ bla ma mid la'i zhal nas/ rang byung ye shes tshol 'dod na/ bya 'jol mo'i rnam thar mkhyen lags sam/ ces gsungs so/ yang mid la ras pa'i zhal nas/ nga la bar chad yong don med/ ngas mi zer kha la nyan ma myong*/ gsung skad do/ yang mid la ras pa'i zhal nas/ sgom chen pa sdod tshugs la snyad brtags nas/ dgon chung re brtsigs nas mi gsog dgu gsos byed tsa na/ sgom dang bral tshar ba yin gsung skad do/ yang mid la'i zhal nas/ ngas mtha' ru thon pas 'thil du sleb/ mi nas thon pas lha dang mjal/ sangs rgyas kun lag pa'i 'thil na 'dug gsung skad do/ yang mid la ras pa'i zhal nas/ ngas gzhi dgon ma bzung bas 'tshengs/ dgon chung khra cong nge(370)ba cig brtsigs na 'dzin chags shugs la skye/ gang zag blo chung rnams sgom dang bral gsungs so/ yang mid la ras pa'i zhal nas/ dwags po lha rje la gang zag rdo phug pa can dang*/ shing nya ga can phan chad phugs na yar bzhag pa'i mi dang ma 'grogs gsung ngo*/ yang rje btsun mid la'i zhal nas/

sgom chen pa rnam rtog chung la gtsang sbra che ba cig dgos pa yin pas/ spyod pa ma rtsing mdzod gsung*/ lta sgom bzang po rgyud la skyes na/ slar la spyod pa zhib tu 'gro ba yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sgom rgyu yod rung med rung gang sdod sa der tshugs dgos pa yin/ gnas la nges pa can byas na 'dzin chags skye bas yang yang mal spo zhing*/ gang sdod sa der gdan non 'tshal ces pa se ban ras pa la gsungs skad do/ yang mid la ras pa'i zhal nas/ dus phyis tsa na nga'i rgyud 'dzin yin zer nas/ ri khrod spangs te dgon chung re bzung nas/ mdun na chang bum re bzhag nas lag pas rnga khog re bzung*/ khas mi nag pa la chos nag sgrog de tsam na nga'i rgyud pa chad pa yin gsung skad/ yang mid la'i zhal nas/ ngas rje (371)mar pa'i drung na dka' ba spyad yun de thud par 'dug de bas kyang lo gcig bsdad na/ phyis kyi sdug bsngal de tsam byed mi dgos par 'dug ste/ nga rang 'dod pa ches pas lan 'dug gsungs so/ yang mid la'i zhal nas/ snying thag pa nas chos rang byed na/ bla ma mtshan ldan zhig gi bka' bzhin rang sgrub dgos gsung skad/ ngas rje mar pa'i gsung la tshad mar bzung bas nga re 'tshengs na ang gsung skad do/ lcam mo pe ta mgon skyid kyang*/ rje btsun mid la ma grongs pa'i lo lnga'i gong nas gar song 'dir song med ste lus khyer nas gshegs par 'dod pa'o/ de la ha las rgyu yang 'dug ge mi rgod de'i sring rgod ma yin la/ yang rje btsun brag dkar rta so dbu ma na bzhugs dus na/ mtshan mo rkun ma zhig yongs nas phug pa'i nang du lag nya byed cing 'dug pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ ngas 'dir lo bcu gnyis bsdad te bza' rgyu'i rigs nyin mo yang ma rnyed pas/ khyod kyis nam phyed btsal yang mi rnyed dam gsungs pas/ kho rgod sha byas nas bros song gsung*/ bla ma mid la ras pa'i zhal dang shangs nas rlung tshur mi rgyu ba'i rtags su/

spyi gtsug gi tshangs bug gi thad dkar/ rlung (372)bal 'khal ba'i 'phang tsam zhig 'ur sgra dang bcas pa dus rgyun du yod pa la/ de la gri ngar mas bcad kyang mi chod skad do/ yang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen kha cig na re/ mid la ras chen gyis lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa la grub pa thob pa yin zer la/ kha cig na re lnga bcu rtsa gcig la grub pa thob par 'dod pa la/ rje khyung tshang pa dang*/ mnga' ris zhang lo ts+tsha ba'i zhal gsal kha tshon chod pa mi 'dug ste/ 'on kyang rje btsun rang gi mgur la brtags na dgung lo lnga bcu dang zhag bco brgyad kyi nyi ma shar 'dal de la/ rlung bcu po gcig tu 'dres pa 'dra ste/ lnga bcu rtsa gsum na dpal chu dbar yang dben na/ sa dang po rab dga'i snga ltas rnams ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs par 'dug pas/ rje ras chung pa'i bzhed kyis ni/ rlung bcu gsum du mdzad 'dug gang ltar yin yang mkhas grub rnams kyis brtag par zhu/ mkhas pa kho nas ni 'di la glags mchi'o/ a la la mid la ras chen khyed kyi zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ dus phyis grub pa thob pa'i rjes na/ snya nam thog la'i sgyer so khang bu na/ rje dam pa sangs rgyas dang mjal nas/ yum bcom ldan 'das (373)ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i dbang bka' lung dang bcas pa zhus gsung*/ rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi gdams ngag 'di yang dam pa sangs rgyas kyi drung du/ rje btsun mid las zhus pa yin par 'dug pa la/ de min te 'di ni dam pa'i zhabs la/ dwags po lha rjes dngos su gtugs nas zhus pa yin te/ de yang rje btsun mid la snya nam grod phug na bzhugs pa'i drung na/ dwags po lha rje pa dbus nas bzhud pa'i tshur res ding ri'i rdza lung 'grar zhus pa yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun brag dmar na bzhugs dus nyin cig ni/ sngar med pa'i ri nag po bang rim gsum pa zhig la/ bskor ba mdzad cing 'dug pa dang*/ ras chung rnams yid ma ches nas/ 'di gang nas byung ba yin zhus pas/

mid la'i zhal nas/ skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ ri bo nag po 'bigs byed 'di/ bod kyi mid la ras pa la/ mchod pa'i rten du gnang ba lags/ gnang yang de nyid yin snyams med/ gsung*/ yang chu dbar na nyin cig sngar med pa'i pho shing mo shing gnyis la/ bskor ba mdzad gyin 'dug pas/ ras chung rnams yid ma ches pas/ shing 'di pa gang nas byung zhus(374)pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyis/ thabs shes zung 'jug tshe shing 'di/ bod kyi mid la ras pa la/ bskor ba'i rten gnang ba lags/ gnang yang de nyid yin snyam med/ ces gsungs so// yang chu dbar bzhugs dus/ nyin gcig rje btsun gyis 'khor rnams la chos gcig gsung shing yod tsa na/ bud med kha dog sngo nag la brjid can mi sdug pa'i rnam 'gyur can gang nas 'ongs cha med byung nas/ mchod rten nag po rtse mo thug la bstan pa gcig /rje btsun la phul nas phyag yang mi 'tshal bar nam mkha' la 'phur song ba dang*/ ras chung rnams yid ma ches nas/ rje btsun la mi mos pa'i bud med de pa su yin gang nas 'ongs pa yin/ rje btsun la mi mos pa'i rnam 'gyur du 'dug pa zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rgya gar yul gyi bsil ba tshal// dur khrod sha za mched bdun gyis// bod kyi mid la ras pa la// phyi rabs dur khrod dgos phyir phul// 'on kyang de nyid yin snyam med// gsungs nas/ glang ma lung gi brag la rgyab pas/ 'dam sag la 'dam 'byar ba ltar 'byar song bas/ dus phyis tsa na gnas 'dir (375)sgom chen shi tshad kyi dur khrod dgos pa yin gsung skad/ yang rje btsun gyi 'bri lce phug na sngar med pa'i rdo ba'i chos khri gcig la bzhugs gda' ba dang*/ ras chung rnams kyis 'di gang nas byung zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bod kyi mid la ras pa la/ sprul pa'i dpa' mo tshe ring mas// rang byung dkar chung rdo ba'i khri// sgyu ma tsam du phul ba lags// 'on kyang de nyid yin snyam med// gsung*/

yang brin gyi lam kha cig na/ sngar med pa'i rdo ba'i chos khri zhig la/ rje btsun bzhugs nas 'dug pa dang*/ ras chung rnams yid ma ches nas 'di gang nas byung zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ bod kyi mid la ras pa la/ sprul pa'i lha mo tshe ring mas/ rang byung rdo'i chos khri 'di/ rgyu ma tsam du phul pa lags/ 'on kyang de nyid yin snyam med gsung*/ yang la phyi na bzhugs dus na/ nyin gcig ni sngar med pa'i chos khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa gcig la bzhugs 'dug pas/ ras chung rnams yid ma ches nas 'di gang nas byung zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ bod kyi mi la ras pa la// sprul pa'i lha mo tshe ring mas// rang byung rdo rje'i chos khri rgyab yol can// sgyu ma tsam du (376)phul ba lags// 'on kyang de nyid yin snyam med// gsung*/ gzhan yang shar tsong kha'i rgyal pos gdan drangs nas/ tsong kha dang*/ rma shod dang*/ byang rgyab dang*/ a 'dar tshwa kha dang*/ rnam snang gong bu rnams su byon pa'i lo rgyus rnams zur na gsal/ rje btsun gyi drung du ras chung pas lo bcu gnyis bzhugs par 'dod pa la/ don dam 'chad pa lo bcu dgu bzhugs pa/ snga phyi dril bas mang rab song gda'/ la la na re rje btsun rgya gar du dngos su byon la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi byon pa yang 'dug ste/ des chog go mid la khos la lung 'bab 'dzeg dgos par mi 'dug go /kha gcig na re sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i sprul pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yin la/ de'i sprul pa rje btsun mid la yin bya ba yang 'dug /phal che bas ni sku tshe 'di rang la brtson 'grus kyis grub pa thob par 'dod pa mang ba 'dug /bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud dang sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu la sogs rnams na ni lung bstan kha yar 'dug lags/ rje nā ro pas kyang*/ lho brag paṇa chen la/ shar phyogs te los byin gyis rlobs/ lho phyogs klu (377)sgrub kyis byin gyis rlobs/

nub phyogs in dras byin gyis rlobs/ byang phyogs nā ros byin gyis rlobs/ rigs lnga bya 'phur chos nyid rlung*/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// mi rgyud nam mkha'i pad+mo 'dra/ sgrub rgyud chu bo'i gzhung dang mtshungs/ bod kyi mar ston lo ts+tsha ba/ khyod 'di ru ma 'dug bod du song*/ ljongs kha ba can gyi byang phyogs na/ thos pa la dga' ba'i snod ldan yod gsungs nas/ rje btsun mid la lung bstan gda' lags so// yang li 'khor phya ru ba dang*/ dwags po lha rje gnyis kyis/ gal te rje btsun zhal mi bzhugs pa srid na/ nged rnams la ma bde ba 'dra byung na su la 'dri lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ma bde ba tsam yang mi yong gis/ dam dum byung na ras chung rdo rje grags pa la 'dri ba las 'os 'dug gam gsung*/ yang li khor ba dang*/ dwags po lha rje dang gnyis pos/ nged gnyis bla ma bsten yun thungs pas/ gdams ngag mang po ma thob pas/ chos bka' dang gdams bskor rnams 'di dang 'di'i bskor yin bya ba re gsung par zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ de la mi shes (378)rgyu med na yang*/ skyes mchog mar pas bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad kyi zhabs la btugs nas/ chos bka' dang gdams ngag rnams gsan par 'dug pa la/ ngas ma thob pa med na yang*/ thams cad dril ba ras chung rdo rje grags pa kho las med la/ khyed bu slob gzhan ma rnams la yang*/ rang rang la gdams bskor rang re 'tsho ba re byin pa de yin mod gsung*/ yang zhus pa/ 'o na gdams bskor rnams gcig lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin pas 'dra yang*/ lam nyams su len lugs la khyad dum re yod pas/ thabs lam chos drug 'di/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud nas kyi gdams ngag yin pas/ chos sgo yang kye rdor dang bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dbang dang*/ byin brlabs kyis 'byed pa yin la/ bka' bgo ba'i bstan bsrung kyang gur mgon yin la/

rgyab chos kyang brtag gnyis bshad pa yin la/ ngas kyang rje mar pa'i drung na brtag gnyis tshar bcu drug nyan/ bla ma rngog gi drung du tshar gnyis nyan/ lar tshar bco brgyad thob gsung*/ yang zhus pas rje btsun chen pos/ bu chen gzhan su la yang ma gnang (379)ba gcig skyes bu ras chung pa la gnang pa 'dra ba de gang gnang ba lags zhus pas/ yug pa zhig zhal rog bzhugs pa dang*/ de la dri rgyu ci yod gsung*/ thos na dga' ba lags phyis kun khong gi drung du nged tsho yang zhu ba lags zhus pas/ de rang khos khyed rnams la mi ster ram gsung*/ de bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nas tshur grangs pa'i gdams ngag gcig yod de/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa bya ba gcig dang*/ sems khrid 'pho ba dang bcas pa kha tshang khyed rang la lha rje la byin pa de dang don gcig gsung*/ yang zhus pa de'i chos sgo gang gis 'byed zhus pas/ bde mchog dang*/ phag mo dang*/ rgyas bsdus kha gcig yod gsung*/ de'i khrid gang lags zhus pas/ de la 'og sgo bde chen gyin chos drug bya ba gcig yod de/ khrid lugs ni thabs lam chos drug dang don 'dra gsung*/ rgyab chos gang lags zhus pas/ rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu bya ba gcig yod gsung*/ bka' bgo ba'i chos bsrungs gang lags zhus pas/ gri gug can bya ba yin te/ gur mgon dang jo bo chen po rje lha gcig a ti sha'i bka' gdams pa gri gug can dang ngo bo gcig (380)bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje khros pa yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ dbus pa ston pa khyod dang po dbus nas yar la yong kha der sprang rgan gsum dang 'phrad dam gsung*/ 'phrad lags zhus pas/ de rnams kyis khyod la ji skad zer gsung*/ rang re gsum 'dra ba'i bsod nams ma bsags pa yong ba/ rtsol ba mi dgos par zan ldog mgo tsam re dang*/ lo tshod tshwa khag pa rdza ma gang yod na zer shing 'dug lags zhus pas/ de min ci zer gsung*/

gcig na re de 'dra las de bas kyang mnga' bdag rtse lte yin dga' zer shing 'dug pa dang*/ gcig na re de 'dra la smon rin mi chog /lo tshod dang zan sprangs pas rnyed 'gro la/ mnga' bdag la yang 'chi ba yong bas smon rgyu med do// smon pa byed na/ rje btsun mid la ras pa 'dra ba re yin na dga'/ gos na ras rkyang gis dros pa/ 'tsho ba ni mkha' 'gro mas 'dren pa/ seng ge la 'chibs nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i sku du mar sprul pa byed nus pa zer bas/ de rnams thos pas nga ba spu zing byung nas/ bla ma de da lta gang na (381)bzhugs de'i bla ma su yin/ chos gang gsung byas pas/ bla ma de da ltar brin snya nam gnyis kyi ri khrod la bzhugs/ de'i bla ma mar pa lo tsā bya ba yin/ mar pa'i bla ma nā ro pa bya ba yin/ chos ni kye rdor gyi gdams ngag nā ro chos drug bya ba gcig gsung*/ zer lags zhus pas/ sprang po de rnams su yin shes sam gsung*/ ma shes lags zhus pas ci yang mi gsung*/ sprang po de rnams rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa yin par 'dug skad/ yang jo mo lha sman rgyal mo mched lngas/ gal te rje btsun zhal dngos su mi bzhugs pa byung na/ nged kyi spyod lam ji 'dra byed lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyed rnams la gzhan ci yang byed rgyu med/ khyed rang rnams yang skyabs 'gro dang ma bral bar gyis la/ spyir yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs tog la 'bad pa thon gcig /dgos su nga'i sgrub rgyud rnams la mas bu skyong ba ltar gyis shig /gsung pa dang*/ dge sbyor le lo byed pa rnams la drag bskul bag re byed lags sam zhus pas/ drag bskul rang ma byed zhi bas bskul cig gsungs so// yang li khor ba dang*/ dwags po lha rje pa gnyis kyis/ rje btsun (382)chen po lags/ 'o na rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu de rgyas pa gcig gsung par zhu zhus pas/

khar tsang nas ci rigs su bshad pa de yin gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma rje btsun mi la ras chen de/ brag dkar rta so dbu ma na bzhugs dus na/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes sher seng bya ba de/ bal por rten mchod sgrub pa la 'ongs pas/ klong mda' nas bltas pas/ brag dkar na dud pa sngo khyug byung ba mthong nas lam 'grim la dris nas/ ya kir su yod pa yin byas pas/ ya gi na gung thang tsā ba mi la shes rgyal gyi bu thos pa dga' bya ba/ khu bo dang yul pa thams cad phung la gtong mkhan de yod pa yin zer/ dge bshes kyis yang dris pa/ 'o na kho da lta der ci byed pa yin byas pas/ lam 'grim na re/ la la na re sdig bshags byed pa yin zer/ la la na re da rung mthu sgrub pa yin zer/ tshod longs pa mi 'dug zer/ der dge bshes bal por 'gro ba bshol nas brag dkar na phyin pas/ phug pa'i nang na mi gcer bu lus thal skya thul le ba gcig 'dug pas/ dge bshes kyis khyed 'dir ci byed pa yin/ 'dir bsdad nas ci tsam song byas pas/ mid la na re nga skye (383)shis 'jigs pas chos byed pa yin/ 'dir bsdad nas lo bcu gcig tsam song zer bas/ dge bshes kyi bsam pa la/ 'o na khong gis nga'i sna len gcig byed yong bsam nas yug bsdad pas/ mid la na re khyed rang brag rtsa pha gir song la bzhugs mdzod zer bas/ dge bshes kyis brag rtsar phyin nas bsdad pas/ mi la'i bsam pa la/ dge bshes de la khur bo chen po 'dug pas/ nga la yang bza' rgyu 'dra ster ram bsam nas yod tsa na/ nyin gcig ni dge bshes na re sgom chen pa 'dir shog dang*/ nga'i mig la rdul ma song ba len rogs gyis zer bas/ mid las phyin nas khong gi rdul bsal nas phug na yar bltas pas/ dge bshes kyi rdza ma la zan g.yos pa dang*/ skyo tsha bskol ba'i zan khal le 'dug pa dang*/ gzhan yang rtsam pa dang*/ mar dang*/ bu ram yang 'dug pa la/ mid la'i bsam pa la/ dge bshes 'dis nga la bza' rgyu byin pa'i rigs su mi 'dug pas/

rdza ma de g.yar nas bkrus la 'thung dgos/ yug gcig gi bcud du 'gro ba 'dug bsam nas/ nga'i rdza ma chags pas dge bshes kyi rdza ma de thebs gcig g.yar dgos gsungs pas/ khong pa'i bsam pa la/ (384)sgom chen pa ri khar yun ring bsdad pa gtsang sbra che ba yin pas/ rdza ma bkrus nas gtad dgos bsam nas/ nyid cag yug phar bzhud dang*/ de nas ngas skad cig btang tsam na rdza ma len byon zer bas/ mid la'i bsam pa la rdza ma g.yar byas pa de legs/ nga la zan mar gcig dang skyo tsha gcig ster bar 'dug /de yang zan dang skyo tsha dpags nas za/ bu ram la bcud byed/ mar la sku mnyed byed bsam ste dga' nas yod tsa na/ dge bshes kyis rdza ma len byon zer bas phyin tsa na/ rdza ma bkrus nas gtsang sing nge gtad byung bas/ der mid la ngo nag thing byas nas rdza ma mi dgos zer nas song*/ 'di la ni bla ma rje btsun chen po la dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ dus phyis kyang mang yang de'i nyin mo las yi mug pa ma byung gsung skad/ de nas dge bshes rgyags zad nas yul du phyin ste/ gleng langs zhor 'phros byung bas/ rka kyog mkhan po ba na re/ sgom chen de rgyags med 'phongs pa gcig yod pa med nam/ khyed kyi rdza ma len shog byas dus lag na ci 'dug gsung*/ lag na phor gog stong pa gcig 'dug zhus pas/ 'o de ka yin sgrub pa po rgyags med gcig yin par 'dug (385)pas/ da myur por bsnyen bkur mang po khyer la song*/ chos kyang zhus gsung nas yang brag dkar du cha rkyen mang po khyer nas phyin pa dang*/ khong rnams sleb pa'i zla ba gcig gi sngon tsam na/ rje btsun grub pa thob nas snya nam phyogs su gshegs tshar 'dug zer/ dus phyis zhabs la gtugs chos zhus pas/ grub thob chen po khor phya ru ba yin skad/ gtam rgyud 'di rnams gsan dus ni/ kyu ra rin po che 'bri khung pas spyan chab dpag tu med pa byon skad do// dus phyis kyang 'bri khung pa'i zhal nas/

ri pa rnams la khyed tsho ri la 'gro ba rnams kyis/ phug ston re gyis la 'tsho ba mnyam por zo gcig /la la phyug po/ la la dbul po ma byed gcig gsung nan chen por mdzad pa yin zer/ da lta yang ri pa chos phug ston re byed pa gtam rgyud 'di'i rjes 'breng nas byed pa lags so// yang bya gcig gis lug gi sre long ba gcig phug sgor skyur nas song ba des kyang zla ba gsum tsam chu dpal bsad pas lus po mnyen lcug song gsung skad do// grub pa thob pa'i zhag bco brgyad kyi gong du ni/ rlung stod 'tshangs thun po de phog nas/ grongs pa rang la thag bcad pa la nyi ma zer thag en ma chad pa la/ pe ta mgon skyid kyis yas (386)zas zo ba gang rnyed pa de khyer nas sleb pas/ gtor ma'i zhabs la chang 'byar ba dang*/ gtor sha dang gtor mar dang*/ de rnams gsol bas ma grongs par 'dug go /gtam rgyud 'di la ni dwags po rin po che lha rje pas/ chos tshig bzhi pa gcig gsung na yang*/ 'di yang yang gsung shing*/ nga'i bla ma rin po che dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje gsung nas/ spyan chab mang po 'byon par 'dug skad do// yang mi blun po la la'i smyo gtam la la/ bla ma rje btsun chen pos mang gung bar du ar jag byas zer ba yang yod par 'dug ste/ de bsod zad kyi smyo gtam yin no// rje btsun gyis yab grongs dus na/ lo gsum dang zla ba bzhi pa yin/ de nas yum gyi rtsar lo bdun gyi bar bzhugs/ dge bshes rtswa pa'i drung du lo bdun bzhugs/ yang yum rtsar lo gsum bzhugs/ lo bco brgyad pa la rta nag dang yar lungs su byon nas mthu mdzad tshe lo brgyad bzhugs/ 'dre ston lha dga' dang gzhan bla ma rnams kyi drung du lo gcig bzhugs/ lho brag na lo dgu bzhugs/ gzhung na lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs/ de nas tswa na dgun gcig bzhugs/ de nas brag dkar na lo bcu (387)gnyis bzhugs/ dgung lo lnga bcu nas 'gro don mdzad nas/

brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi la dag pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa yin no// de'i bar la jag khram mdzad long ga na byung ba/ mid la ras chen gyi rnam thar gyi sa bcad 'di ni/ dge slong zhi byed ri khrod pas yi ger bris pa'o// yang rje btsun brag dkar rta so dbu ma na bzhugs dus su/ rkun ma gsum byung bas/ rje btsun zwa tshod bskol gyin yod tsa na/ khong gsum na re/ thal dang tshwa rdor thob la nged la yang blud zer bas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ rtsam pa zer ba'i mngar po/ tshwa zer ba'i drod can/ rdor zer ba'i bcud can gcig yod par 'dug ste/ ngas kyang ma myong nas lo bcu gnyis tsam song gsung skad/ yang mid la'i zhal nas/ zwa tshod la zwa'i thal btab pa de rang zhim par 'dug gsung skad do// yang mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/ nga la dal yang dal te brel yang brel/ mi gzhan tshos bltas pas nga dal bar mthong*/ nga la dal ba skad cig med gsung ba ni/ dus 'di nas bzung ste rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob bar du skad gcig kyang le lo mi byed pa'i brda ru gsungs pa lags so// yang rje btsun gyi sngags rdor mo'i tsha ba ma gsol nas/ (388)stod thang na ra rdzi ma bu la bsrus pa'i gtam rgyud yang yod do// yang mid la'i zhal nas/ yon bdag brin snya nam pas go bcad/ g.yeng ba la yang ma bskur/ sgrub rgyags yang ma bcad gsung skad do// yang rje btsun mi la ras pa'i drung na/ dgas po lha rje dang po mjal dus na/ ja dang gser phul ba la/ mid la'i zhal nas/ gser dang ban rgan lo mi mthun/ ja yo mar bskol ba'i zangs dkar med gsung nas ma bzhes zer/ la la na re ja de gsol zer bas brtag 'tshal/ yang lha rje pa'i sman sgrom de mid las gzigs nas ci 'dug gsung ba la/ lha rje pas nad pa snying rje ba 'dug pas sman sgrom 'di bzung ba lags zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ de bar chad kyi sgro ba bdud kyi lag cha yin gsung nas/ sman sgro dbral nas sman tsho gtor skad/

yang rje btsun 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba na bzhugs dus na/ mgon po bya rog gdong can yang yang byung bas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ khyod 'dir ci la yong ba yin/ nga so ma gsod pas song gsungs pa dang*/ kho na re/ nga chos skyong yin zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ ngas tshe stod la mthu kho na (389)la las ka byed dgos pa gcig byung dus na/ khyod mi 'dug pas da khyod kyis dgos pa ci yod gsung nas/ glang ber gcig gis brdungs pas/ kho na re de dus rje btsun chos pa min pas nga 'khor sa med pa lags/ da lta ni rje btsun chos kho na mdzad pas yang yang 'khor dgos pa yin gsung nas/ mid las khyod rang bden gsung skad do// yang rje btsun chu dbar na bzhugs dus su/ nor lha thams cad drung du byung bas mid las glang ber gyi khong tsho brdungs nas/ ngas tshe stod la zan kham re mi rnyed pa byung dus khyed tsho mi 'dug pas/ da khyed kyis dgos pa med gsungs pas/ de dus na rje btsun 'dod pas gdungs pas/ nged tsho 'khor sa ma byung ba lags/ da lta ni rje btsan 'dod pa zad pas nged tsho rang dbang med par 'khor ba lags zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas khyed bden gsung*/ bla ma ba ri lo ts+tsha bas brin sding ma na 'bum mo tshe bzhengs pa'i rab gnas mdzad dus na/ bla ma ba ri bas/ rje btsun mid la khri thog tu bzhugs dgos gsung bas/ mi la na re/ de mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nga rten rnal 'byor pa yin cing ldom bu ba yin pas des mi yong ba lags/ khyed rten rab byung yin (390)cing*/ dge bshes chen po yin pas lo ts+tsha ba bzhugs dgos gsung pa la/ tsag phugs pas khri thog tu lo ts+tsha ba chen po bzhugs par zhu/ mi la ras pa rgyal khams ldom bu ba gcig gis tshogs pa 'di tsam gyi gral mgo mi yong zer ba dang*/ bla ma ba ri bas rje btsun la grub rtags gcig ston par zhu/ dge bshes tsag phug pa ma dad pa bzlog pa yin gsung bas/ rje btsun gyis mid la rgas pas grub rtags ston mi nus kyis/

khyed ras chung gcig gis bla ma lo ts+tsha ba'i drung du maṇ+ḍal gcig phul gsungs pa dang*/ ras chung zhi ba 'od kyis/ skad cig yud tsam la sku lus kyi bkod pa bdun tsam mdzad nas/ grub rtags rnams bstan pas/ tsa phug pa dad pa ma skyes/ ba ri bas dbu mdzad pa'i khrom thams cad ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab par mos nas/ ye shes babs nas 'ur ba dang*/ pe ta na re ming po la khrel dang phyi thag med/ ngas mo mtshan khyis grad grad yas blangs nas sgrub rgyags bskyel ba la/ da ming pos grub pa thob nas/ nga la grub thob mi byed nas/ mi gzhan la grub thob byed pa zer nas/ 'doms khyis phug pa'i rma sgro khrom thams cad la bstan pas/ rje btsan mid las (391)pe ta la khyod drin che ba bden no// 'on kyang ngas gdams ngag ma bstan pa ma yin/ sring mo rang snying rus chung bas lan pa yin/ ngas kyang 'phongs 'di 'drar song song bsgoms pa yin/ khyod rang yang snying rus bskyed la bsgoms dang yon tan skye gsung nas/ zhabs bstan pas/ zhabs ni spre'u'i 'phongs bzhin song 'dug skad do// der pe tas kyang snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms pas/ yon ton chen po skyes te lus khyer bar bzhed pa yin no// bla ma ba ri lo ts+tsha ba'i drung du yang rje btsun mid la ras pas/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa zhus/ yang mi thams cad kyi smyo gtam la/ khyi'u chung zhi ba 'od kyi bong chu brgal ba la/ rje btsun mid las rta 'phongs g.yar zer ba ni/ mi tsho smyo ba yin no/ chu mig dngul bum nas shar rtogs su 'gro ba la bong chu brgal don ci yod/ ra chu brgal dgos pa lags so// brtag zhig ma byas pa'i myo gtam byed pa dgod bro bar 'dug go /maṃ ga lam bha wan tu/

༈ yang bla ma mid la ras chen pas/ be ri ru ba la srus pas/ mi tshang dbul po gcig gis tshod ma phor gog gang khyer byung ba'i (392)nang du/ shing thur bco brgyad 'dug pas/ rje btsun gyis shing thur 'di rnams bcug pas/ tshod ma 'bongs su re ba yin nam gsungs pas/ yon bdag na re tshod ma mang du re ba lags te/ nged bza' tsho bco brgyad yod pa'i 'thung 'phro rnams bsdus pa yin zer ba dang*/ rje btsun nan ltar mnyes nas/ 'or che rang gi khar za mi bra nas gzhan la sbyin nus pa gsung nas gdams ngag gnang bas mi tshang de grol skad do// gtam rgyud 'di la brten nas mi khor phya ru ba dang*/ dwags po lha rje pa grub pa thob pa myur ba yin cing*/ kyu ra rin po 'bri gung pa yang 'di la thugs brtsis nan tar che skad do// lo rgyus rgyas par zhal las shes so// yang rje btsun 'dam na hu ba la bsod snyoms la byon pas/ bud med gcig gis bsod snyoms ma phul bar tshig ngan mang po zlos pa dang*/ phyi nyan bka' gdams pa la ras cham gcig g.yar nas byon pas/ bsod snyoms mang po phul skad/ 'di la rten nas 'bri sgom ras pa grub pa thob pa myur ba yin cing*/ rje khyung tshang pa ye shes bla ma dang*/ dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po yang 'di la thugs brtsi nan tar che skad/ lo (393)rgyus rgyas par zhal las shes so// snya nam gyi bla ma gzi brjid rgyal mtshan pa yang 'di la nan tar mnyes par mdzad par 'dug /yang mid la ras pa'i zhal nas/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa la 'di skad gsungs so// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la// lus sha khrag gi phung po sdig po che// lto gos gyi zhen pa sgrub sgrub nas// 'jig rten gyi bya ba thongs dus med// bya ba blo yis thong dang ras chung ba// sgyu ma lus kyi grong khyer du// rang sengs dngos med sdig po che// sems chags sdang gi rjes su 'breng 'breng nas// gnyis med kyi don la rtogs dus med// sems glod la zhog dang ras chung pa// skye 'chi gnyis kyi so 'tshams na// bar do'i rig pa sdig po che// lus med kyi lus gcig btsal btsal nas// sems 'khor bar 'khyams pa ma tshor bar// sgyu ma ngo yis bzung cig ras chung pa// mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings shed na// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas zhal rdzun mkhan// chos drang don gyi blo drid byed byed nas// nges pa'i don la rtogs dus med// sems kyi rtsa ba chod dang ras chung pa// chos lta ba dang sgom pa spyod pa gsum// don cig tu sres la nyams su long*// tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/

(394)don cig tu bsres la 'dris su chug /don de ka las med do ras chung pa// ces gsungs so// dge 'dis 'gro drug sangs rgyas shog /skyes mchog mid las ras chung rdo rje grags la gsungs so// yang mid la'i zhal/ ras chung pa dam chos thams cad gsang sngags rigs las byung*// 'on kyang rang rdo rje 'chang dang ma mnyam par// mi nag la dbang skur ma byed cig /ces gsungs so// snya nam thog la na gsungs pa'i sde tshan yin no// yang ras chung ba la/ rdo rje sems dpa' rigs lnga'i bum dbang dngos su gnang dus na/ ras chung pas rje btsun gyis rgya gar du lan du byed zhus pas/ thebs drug phyin gsung*/ de'i dus na sangs rgyas sam grub thob ci 'dra dang mjal zhus pas/ dang po re la slob dpon 'phags pa klu grub dang dag snang gis mjal/ dbu ma la sogs chos mang po thob gsung*/ lan gnyis pa'i dus su/ rgya gar seng ga la na 'phags pa ar+ya de ba dang mjal nas/ phar phyin gnang gsung*/ lan gsum pa'i dus na/ rgya gar gang gā'i 'gram na slob dpon chen po la ba pa dang mjal nas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i chos gnang gsung*/ lan bzhi pa'i dus na/ zla ba grags pa (395)dang mjal nas/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs gsungs/ lan lnga pa'i dus na ma tang gi dang mjal nas don zhags gnang gsung*/ lan drug pa la/ ḍom bhi pa dang mjal nas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir wa pa'i lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag rnams gnang gsungs/ der ras chung bas rje btsun chen pos rdzu 'phrul gyis byon pa lags sam/ dngos su byon pa lags zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas de ci yin 'o na yang khyod rang gang dga' ba byas pas chog pa mi 'dug gam gsungs/ yang ras chung brgyad kyis/ rje btsun chen po lags/ mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud 'di gnyan grags pa dang*/ cig rgyud len pa ni gnang sa med par 'dug pa la/ nged ras chung brgyad la gdams skor re re lags sam/ zhus pas de bzhin rang yin/
