lar ngas khyed tsho mi slu nyen yod la/ gzhan su la yang ma zer cig /snyan rgyud tshang ba ras chung bzhin legs po kho men pa la sbyin dbang med pa yin gsung*/ snyan rgyud 'di la thams cad tshang na gdams skor du yod zhus pas/ de rnams ras chung bzhin legs po kho la dris pas yong ngam/ 'o na yang bshad pas chog /rtsa ba'i chings gsum bya ba yin te/ (396)phyi sprul sku'i gdams ngag la brten nas/ rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu'i sgro 'dogs bcad pa gal che ba dang*/ nang long sku'i gdams ngag la brten nas/ rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i sgro 'dogs bcad pa dang*/ gsang ba ngo sprod yid bzhin nor bu'i chos sku'i gdams ngag la brten nas/ lam gyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid la sgro 'dogs bcad pa gal che gsung*/ de'i rgyud pa gang lags zhus pas/ rdo rje 'chang*/ lus med la/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mar pa/ mid la nga rang dang de rnams yin gsung*/ yang ras chung rnams kyis zhus pa/ rje btsun gyi slob ma gzhan la ni snyan rgyud ma snang ba de rtags can de lags/ nged ras chung bdun po la gdams ngag skor re re las ma gnang bar 'dug lags so// gdams ngag gi rkang grangs du bzhugs cig gsungs na dga' ste zhus pas/ de 'dra ba dgos pa yod na bshad pas chog gsung nas/ mi la dbang skur ba dang lha la rab gnas byed pa dang gshin po la bdun tshigs byed pa yin te/ he ru ka la brten nas shes rab gtso bor byas nas byin rlabs byed pa dang*/ rdul tshon la brten nas thabs gtso bor byas nas dbang bskur byed pa yin gsung*/ de las gzhan yod (397)dam zhus pas/ gdams ngag skor gsum la yang*/ man ngag gsum yod gsung*/ de gang lags zhus pas mthun mong yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu'i gdams ngag bya ba yod gsung*/ de la man ngag yod dam zhus pas/ gnyis yod gsung*/ de gang lags zhus pas yab bka' dang yum bka' bya ba yin gsung*/

'o na de la skor du yod zhus pas gsum yod gsung*/ gang gang lags zhus pas/ rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba dang*/ blon po rigs gsum las byed dang*/ dmangs phrin las sgrub byed mthun sbyor bya ba yin gsung*/ de las yod dam zhus pas/ yum skor ltar na rnal 'byor bcu bya ba yod gsung*/ de yang gsung bar zhu dang zhus pas/ zhal 'dzum pa cig mdzad nas/ tshad med sems bskyed lha sku sems bskyed dang*/ sems can don byed dpa' bo dpa' mo 'dul bar byed/ yid kyis rdo rje bzlas pa ngag gi rdo rje bzlas pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa sre ba ro snyoms dang*/ 'phrin las gtor ma'i rnal 'byor yin gsung*/ de las yod dam zhus pas/ gnyis pa la yang gsum yin te/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs (398)ting 'dzin dbang bskur dang*/ he ru ka'i yig brgyas sdig pa sbyang thabs yin gsung*/ de las yod dam zhus pas/ gsum pa la yang bdun yin te/ rnal 'byor kha zas gos dang ni/ 'gro drug spyod lam nyal ba dang*/ chos spyod khrus kyis rnal 'byor yin gsung*// de las yod dam zhus pas/ yab skor sngon 'gro rnal 'byor gsum/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor dang ni 'jug gi rnal 'byor gsum/ kun tu 'gro ba sre ba ro snyoms rnal 'byor dang*/ gnyis pa gsum la tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ sbyin bsags skyed rim brtan par bya/ gsum pa rnal 'byor bdun la/ za ba zas dang 'thung ba skom/ bgo ba gos dang 'dug pa gnas/ 'gro 'dug spyod lam dag byed khrus/ bsod nams spel byed tsha tsha'i rnal 'byor ro gsung*/ de las yod dam zhus pas/ gnyis pa dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu la yang brgyad/ bag yod dran pas bzung dang sgom zhing ngo sprad dang*/ rten par bya dang gsang bar bya ba dang*/ mi bsags bya dang mi bral bya ba dang*/ bza' bar bya dang srung bar bya ba'i dam tshig yin gsung*/ de las yod dam zhus pas/ dang po la yang drug yin te/ gtum mo bde drod ngo sprod dang*/

'pho ba gser (399)'gyur rtsi sbyor dang*/ grong 'jug sbrul pags 'dor byed dang*/ rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs dang*/ sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol dang*// 'od gsal ma rig mun bral dang gsung*// de las yod dam zhus pas/ gnyis pa 'og sgo bde chen la yang lnga yin te/ rten gyi gang zag dang ni/ yul du dgos byed dang*/ thabs kyis nyams su blang ba'o gsung*/ de las yod dam zhus pas/ gsum pa rang byung gnyis med la yang gnyis yin te/ bar do ye shes gsal 'debs dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod yin gsung*/ de las yod dam zhus pas/ yang gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu la yang gnyis yin te/ thabs kyi lam dang grol lam dang*/ dang po la yang gnyis yin te/ lam gyi gtso dang yan lag go /dang po la yang gnyis su byed/ steng sgo rnam par grol ba dang*/ 'og sgo bde ba chen po'o// lam gyi yan lag la yang lnga yin te/ 'pho ba 'gro 'jug dang ni rmi lam sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal dang lnga'o// grol lam la yang gnyis yin te/ bar do'i ye shes gsol 'debs dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod do// lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu la yang tho tsa re gsungs pa dang*/ der (400)tshang ba ras chung rdo rje grags pa men pa/ ras chung gzhan rnams la mi bzhugs par gsal lags so// yang ngam blong ras pas/ snyan brgyud rnams nga la tshang ba yod dam zhus/ khyod la yang dga' rab ni yod de/ bzhin legs po'i 'dra ba en med gsung skad do// yang ras chung rnams kyis rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu 'di la rgyas pa gcig mdzad na dga' zhus pas/ dus re zhig nas byed mi cig yong ba yin gsungs nas ma gnang bar 'dug /yang rje btsun snya nam gyi gser phug stod na bzhugs dus/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa dang*/ 'bri sgom ras pa dang*/ ngam rdzong ras pa dang*/ se ban ras pa dang*/ zhi ba 'od dang*/ bshen ras dang*/ sangs rgyas skyabs dang*/ bla ma grags dang*/

slob dpon rnam pa bzhugs nas yod tsa na/ sngar gyi a ne des bsnyen bkur mang po khyer nas mjal du byung ba dang*/ se ban ras pas zhu sna byas pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ mo'i bza' rgyu de sa med kyang mid la sdug nas mi 'chi/ lar sgom chen pa bya ba de nyams myong yod rung med rung*/ mal du sdod chugs dgos pa yin/ sgo 'gram nas bya ra byed na ni mi nyan gsungs pa (401)dang*/ der thams cad kyis zhu ba phul ba la gsan nas/ 'o na shog gyis gsung ba dang*/ sring mo pe ta khros to/ a ne mjal du bcug na/ nga sngar yang sprangs pas/ tshe phyid pa yin/ da yang sprang 'gro bas chog zer nas khres po dril ba dang*/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga la pha ma gnyis kas kyang pe ta 'di drin che ba yin pas/ da res a ne 'phrad pa mi yong ngam gsungs pa dang*/ ras chung rnams kyis pe ta la khyod kyis rje btsun gyi zhabs 'dren byed dam/ da lan a ne la mjal kha ma gnang na ga na yong byas 'thabs nas/ thugs la btags dgos zhus pas/ 'o na shig gyis gsung nas/ yol ba phyi nang byas te/ nang du rje btsun dang pe ta bzhugs/ a nes phyi nas bzod gsol byas nas ngus pas/ pe ta rgod cing 'dug pa dang*/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ da yol ba 'di phar sol la thong*/ lar nye 'brel la chags zhen byed mi nyan pa yin/ da nga dang 'grogs pas chog gsung nas/ mjal nas phyag dbang gnang la/ bsnyen bkur yang yang byas nas thugs rjes bzung bas sgom yang bzang po skyes so// yang mid la'i zhal nas/ nga dang po lho brag na sdod dus su/ rje mar pa'i drung du (402)dbang zhu ba la dbang yon med pa la yum bdag med mas nga la yab yum gyi phag nor g.yu 'di gnang nas phyis kun dgos pa srid gsung ba yin te da dgos nges kyang med la/ gal de dgos pa byung na yang*/ bu slob mi chen re re la zla rgyags re blangs pas chog pas/ g.yu 'di khyod kyi dbang yon gyis/ gsung nas gnang nas dbang thob/

de man chod rgyud mang rab thos pa lags so// lar yang yum bdag med mas tshe rabs mang po nas thugs rjes bzung ba yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs la/ chos pa bya ba de chos bya bsam gyis mi chog snying rus dgos/ srubs par gyur na shing la me yang thon/ btsal na ngang pas chu la mar yang rnyed/ bsgoms par gyur na mi la sangs rgyas yong*/ gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ dam pa rgyags chung ba la/ ngas lho brag nas yar yongs nas/ shing lcags bu tsam cig dang*/ rdo chab rdul tsam cig gi khang pa byed ma myong*/ chos pa'am sgom chen pas lung stong gi g.yeng ba 'di yang mtshar rgyu med gsung*/ yang rje btsun phyi zhal nas/ (403)mdzangs mo ras ma gnyis la khyed gnyis nga'i phyag rgya ma yin zer nas bu rdzun byed kyin yod par 'dug /ngas 'khor ba spel ma myong gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ lar yang chos pa dang*/ sgom chen pa bya ba de shis rgas thug tsam na 'dzin chags je chung la 'gro dgos pa yin pa la/ dus da lta'i chos pa dang sgom chen pa phal cher ni/ rgas kha shi khar song ba dang 'dzin chags je che je cher 'gro bar 'dug gsung*/ yang rje btsun cung pa na bzhugs dus su/ yon bdag mo legs gsal 'bam mes/ rje btsun la mdo rgyud rnams na lung bstan 'dra yod lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas lung bstan kun yod rung med rung spyir yang ngas bla ma slob dpon rnams kyi gsung la 'gong ma myong la/ khyad par du rje mar pa'i bka' bzhin sgrubs pas/ rang gzhan kun la phan par byung gsung*/ yang rje btsun la byang nas yon bdag da'u phyug pos rta cig phul bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ mid la sprang po la rtas dgos pa med de/ 'o na yang legs gsungs nas rta la khrid btab pas sgom rab cig skyes yod par 'dug /yang dus phyis rje btsun lho brag du rje mar pa'i gzims khang la phyag 'tshal ba la byon dus na/

spyan chab mang po byon (404)pa la/ ras chung rnams kyis mi shums par zhu zhus pas/ rje mar pa yab yum gyi bka' drin dran pa yin gsung ste/ de res zhag bdun bzhugs/ lar snga phyi lan bco lnga byon gda'/ yang rje btsun gyi gnyag g.yung ston khro rgyal dang*/ shangs rta nag gi bon po'i gdan sa na yar byon nas/ shul ma rnams la mgur mang rab gsung shing spyan mang po bsil ba la/ ras chung rnams kyis mi bshums par zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ jo sras dang mjal bas/ bla ma rngog mkha' spyod la gshegs pa'i lo rgyus rnams mdzad pas/ rje btsun gyi spyan chab mang po byon pas/ bla ma rngog gi sras kyang bshums pa la/ ras chung rnams kyis mi bshums par zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyed rnams kyis mid la rgas 'chal du song 'dug bsam pa yin te/ ngas nor zang zing gi zhabs tog ni nas 'bru gcig tsam yang byas pa med la/ rje lho brag pa'i chos skor la/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud dang*/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ 'khor sdig sdugs dang bcas pa de ma lags pa/ thams cad ni bla ma rngog gi sku drin yin gsung*/ gzhan yang (405)rong khu lung du bla ma ye shes gzungs kyi gdan sar byon pa dang*/ nyang stod kho re na bla ma byang chub rgyal po'i gdan sar byon pa dang*/ nyang stod rgyan mkhar na bla ma dgyer ston dbang phyug rgya mtsho'i gdan sar byon pa dang*/ yar 'brog glang bu do ru bla ma mar pa 'byung gnas ye shes kyi gdan sar byon pa dang*/ rong gi g.yung ston phug pa dang*/ nyang stod khu la na bla ma 'dre ston ha rga'i gdan sar byon pa la sogs/ spyan chab byon zhing mgur gsung ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod do// lar skyes mchog mid la khyed kyi mdzad pa dang phrin las dran pas/ sprang po zhi byed ri khrod pa khos tshe 'di blos mi gtong ba'i rang dbang mi gda' ang/ yang ras chung byang chub rgyal po de 'khrungs sa/

lcim lung phu'i ngam rdzong yin pa dang*/ dus phyis dbus kyi ngam rdzong cig gi brag la bzhugs pas/ ngam rdzong ras pa zer ba'i mtshan byung ba yin pa la/ da lta ni blun po bsod zad la las/ ngan song ras pa zer ba yi ge la btab dga'/ da man chad ni sgra log de 'dra ma byed cig /yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ mi ngan pa'i slob ma las/ mi ma yin gyi slob ris rnams phyi thag dang dam tshig che bar 'dug(406)tsa lung pa'i gur dkar dang*/ brag nag dang*/ brag dmar dang*/ brag sbal pa kha dgangs la sogs/ tsa ron gung gsum gyi gzhi bdag gis nga rang dga' a cang che ste/ nga'i slob ris rnams la yang phan ci thogs byed gyin 'dug gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi drung na/ 'bri sgom ras pas/ mi rnams ngan re/ rje mar pa'i jo mo yum bdag med ma dang*/ bla ma rngog gzhung ba'i jo mo dang*/ de bas rje btsun la sku lus kyi dkyil 'khor gnang ba yin zer ba yang 'dug ste/ de 'dra bden nam mi bden lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ mi ngan pa'i kha dang*/ nam zla dpyid ka'i rlung tshub la gtad sa med pa yin/ nga la de 'dra'i sems yod na mkha' 'gro ma'i bka' chad yong*/ gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi drung du/ ras chung zhi ba 'od kyis/ rje btsun gyis lho brag rje mar pa'i drung du ji tsam bzhugs zhus pas/ snga res lo ngo brgyad/ hril ba bdun tsam bsdad/ ting res dang bcas pa lo ngo dgu lhag pa cig tsam sdad/ de la rje mar pa'i phyag rdzas nas thebs lnga las za ma myong gsung*/ yang gshen sgom ras chung gis/ rje btsun chen po lags/ rje drung (407)na yod pa rnams la gsung tsam mi 'byon pa dang*/ zhal bzhad pa yang mi mdzad par 'dug pa de/ nged rnams la ma mnyes pa lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyed rnams rang la ma dga' ba yang min te/ lar snyigs dus kyi chos pa ci rigs la yang rgod rang mi 'bro la/ nga rang gi tshe stod kyi sdug bsngal rnams dran pa dang*/

spyir 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang*/ bsam spyod rnams mthong bas*/ nga rgod yang mi bro bar 'dug la/ don med kyi long gtam byed rang mi 'dod gsung*/ yang ras chung bla ma grags kyis/ rje btsun la da rnal yod dam med zhus pas/ gti mug rang rgyud pa de med pa yin/ 'od gsal dang sbyar ba'i gnyid dum re yod gsung*/ yang khyi ra ras pa mgon po rdo rje na re bdag cag 'dra ba'i sdig can la yang sgom thob pa/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rang lags zhus pas/ mi la'i zhal nas/ khyod rang sngar gyi sbyangs pa bag tsam yang yod pa cig 'dug /de min nga dang 'phrad pa yang dka' ba lags te/ 'phrad kyang rjes su zhugs pa dka' ba yin gsung*/ yang li khor phyan du bas/ nga dang po bra dkar na yongs dus na/ rje btsun gyi thugs la btags thang ba la zhus pas/ mi (408)la'i zhal nas/ nyid cig rang dang po nas kyang sbyangs pa can cig yin par 'dug pa dang*/ nga dang yang las 'brel bzang po yod pa yin te/ smon lam gyis mtshams yun ring thung dam dun yang yong ba yin gsung*/ yang rong chung ras pas/ rje btsun lags/ sgoms pa dang*/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pa bogs gang che lags zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ bla ma tshad ldan cig la slob ma gus ldan cig gis gsol ba btab na/ sgom zhor la yong gsung*/ yang tsang chung ras pas/ rje btsun gyi mthu'am gdams ngag su la yang ma gnang lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bstan pa la gnod pa byed pa rnams la/ ngas mthu ma byas kyang shugs kyi sdig par 'dug /ngas su la'ang byin pa med gsung*/ yang ras pa byang chub rgyan nas/ snying nang nas chos cig byed na lus skyes dman yin yang mi sto bar 'dug zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ri khrod 'grim pa dang*/ rgyal khams skor na khyad dum re yod/ de min byang chub kyi sems la pho mo med gsung*/ ras ma chos kyi byang chub kyis/ nga la drod skye bla bar byung lags/

snying rus (409)tsam yang ma byas te/ rje btsun gyi byin rlabs yin zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ skyes pa las bud med drod che ba yin/ nyon mongs che ba tsam gyi rtsa bzang ba yin/ de ye shes su 'gro ba yin gsung*/ yar ras ma ye shes byang chub kyis/ nga rje btsun dang ma mjal na 'khor bar 'khyams so// zhes zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ khyod rang rje btsun ma sgrol mas byin gyis rlabs par 'dug gsung*/ yang 'bring mtshams gyi ras ma mkha' spyod mas/ rje btsun lo drug brten nas mkha' spyod la gshegs par 'dug /yang jo mo 'or mos/ ngas sgom tsam ma byas pa la sems rgyud la ma rtogs rang bzhin pa mi skye bar 'dug zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs na/ rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas/ phyag rgya chen po la ngo sprad pa yang ci rigs yod gsung*/ yang brin pa mo legs gsal 'bum mos/ nga da 'khor bar 'khyam mam mi 'khyam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyod kyang da res las 'khor ba la phyi rnyog mi dgos pa 'dra/ 'on kyang da rung tshogs gnyis la 'bad pa thon gsung*/ snya nam tshar ma'i legs gsal 'bum mes/ ngas ni dang po rang yang mi nag (410)mor song yang tshe 'di la zhen pa che rgyu tsam med pas/ rang res dran pa'i khram zog mang po byas su ma tshor zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyod skye ba ci rigs kyi gong nas/ ma skal bzang mo dang las 'brel yod pa 'dra gsung*/ cung ba'i legs gsal 'bum mes/ nga ni yul 'brog mang rab kyi bdag por song bas/ sdig pa yang zhor la 'go bar 'dug ste/ dge ba yang dam dum 'bad nas byas/ rje btsun dang mjal bas/ 'khor ba na mi 'khyams lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sdig pa shes bzhin du byas na nan ltar lci ba yin ste/ khyod rang 'gyod sems skyes pas 'dags pa yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi drung du/ ras chung rdo rje grags kyis/ chos snga 'gyur 'di la/

la las 'thab cing 'dug pa/ 'di la sangs rgyas kyi ni gsung ngo shes sam zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas ma gsung pa'i chos cig lo paṇa sprul sku rnams kyis khyer nas ga na yod ste/ bar du chos rgyud 'dzin par rdzus pa'i gang zag ci rigs pas/ go ma chod nas gdams ngag nyams su len ma shes nas/ ra chod (411)chor zu lums byas shing slad pas/ bka' brgyud gong ma phan chod kyi zhabs 'dren byas pa yin gsung*/ der ras chung pas/ 'o na rje btsun gyis/ chos snga 'gyur zhus tshad dang*/ de'i bla ma brgyud rim dang bcas pa nga la gnang 'tshal zhus pas/ lar khyod shes rgya mang po bas/ gcig la dril na de dga' ba yin te/ cis kyang 'dod na yang chos rgyud mi nub pa dang*/ chos rgyud kyi phyogs cha dang*/ kha 'dzin la brten nas de la sdig pa mi gsog pa la phan pa yin pas bshad dgos na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas ma gsungs pa'i chos ni gang yang med pa de yin la/ gdul bya'i snang ngo dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi bye brag la bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig yod pas/ de tsho brjod kyi mi lang la/ ngas chos snga 'gyur thob pa'i bla ma rgyud rim dang*/ gdams ngag gi don rnams la/ bka' brgyud ni spyi dang 'dra ste/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ long sku zhi khro rab 'byams/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ bsdud pa phyag na rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ bla ma 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ rigs 'dzin shri ri sing ha/ de nas rgyal ba ye shes 'od zer dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung (412)gnas dang*/ mkhas pa bi ma la mi tra dang*/ de rnams mched grogs yin la/ khong gsum dang mkhan chen bodhi sa twa dang*/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi sprul sku mang rab kyis/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan la gnang zhing*/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan la yang mang rab gnang yod la/

chos rgyal gyis gnas brtan ldan ma lhun grub la gnang*/ yang nyang sha'i spyan can gyis rgyal po la gnang*/ yang bai ro tsa na dang*/ ska cog rnam gnyis dang*/ gnya' na ku mā ra dang*/ rma rin chen mchog dang*/ rgyal bu g.yu sgra snying po dang*/ snubs rnams gnyis dang*/ de rnams kyis rgyal po la bshad nas/ chos kyi rgyal pos/ lha sras mi tig rtsad po dang*/ gnas brtan ldan ma la sogs pa la gnang ba yin/ gnas brtan ldan mas/ grub thob seng ge dbang phyug la gnang*/ de nas lha rje ye shes gzungs dang*/ ba mi byang rgyal dang*/ dgyer ston dbang nge dang*/ mar pa 'byung ye dang*/ 'dre ston lha rga dang*/ bla ma de rnams kyi drung du ngas zhus pa yin pas ngas khyod la bshad pa yin/ khyod kyis kyang rgyud pa ma bcad cig gsung nas snga 'gyur rnams gnang ngo*// (413)rje ras chung pas ngam shod btsan po yab sras dang*/ shes snang ba dang*/ sgoms chen chos rab dang*/ zangs ri rgya ras dang*/ byar so ba rgan rgon gnyis dang*/ rgyal ba lo dang*/ mang rab la gnang bar 'dug la/ de rnams nas rim gyis rgyud pa la/ zhi byed ri khrod pas kyang ma thob pa tsam med te/ gtam rgyud rgyas par zur na gsal/ gnyag g.yung ston khro rgyal dang*/ shangs rta nag gi bon po la zhus pa'i drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag dang*/ mu stegs bong wa khrag 'dzul yang zhus pas ma gnang gda'/ yang ras chung pas dbu ma dang tshad ma'i rgyud pa gang lags/ de yang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas bstan gtso/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ klu grub yab sras/ phyogs glang chos grags/ yon tan 'od dang shākya 'od la sogs nas/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig a ti sha dang*/ nag tsho paṇa chen dang*/ dge bshes 'brom dang*/ de nas byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ dge bshes tsa ba grags pa bsod nams/ des nga la gnang ba yin la/ ngas khyod la bshad pa lags pas/ spyir rang re bshad brgyud pa min yang rgyud pa ma chad tsam gyis gsung*/

(414)yang ras chung pas/ thabs lam dang snyan rgyud kyi chos bsrungs ni shes par 'dug la/ phyag bzhi pa gter ma dang bka' ma gnyis yin pa'i/ gsar ma 'di la khong la la na re/ ye shes pa ma yin/ nor lha gnod sbyin cig yin bya ba yang 'dug pa de gang ltar lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'di yang mgon po sngon 'byung nas yang ye shes par gsung 'dug la/ rje mar pas nga la yang gnang gsung*/ 'o na ye shes pa gang 'khros pa yin zhus pas/ bde mchog 'khros pa yin gsung*/ yang ras chung pas/ rje btsun gyi dbu skra dkar por 'gro ba dang*/ nga'i chos 'byon pa de mi thang ste zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'o na ni nga las yon tan du mas lhag pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la yang nga'i chos 'byon pa dang dbu skra dkar por song ba 'dug pa de ma tshar ram gsung*/ nged rnams kyang gdul bya'i snang ngo dang*/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las yin par mi 'dug gam gsung*/ yang ras chung pas/ rje btsun gyis chos gsung ba dang gsung gang 'byon pa yang*/ thugs 'khros thabs su gsung ba de ci la dgongs pa lags zhus pas/ mid la'i (415)zhal nas/ de cig tu na khams rigs kyang yin la/ gnyis su na nga dang mi phal cher spyod pa ye rang mi mthun la 'dug pa des lan pa yin nam gsung*/ yang ras chung pas/ spyir yang rje btsun sangs rgyas rang yin la/ khyad par du gsar rnying thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ dgos su rje mar pa'i chos skor rnams thugs su chud pas/ gang yang mi mkhyen pa med pas/ de rnams ma lus par nga la gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ khyod cig pu min pa nga'i slob ma gzhan rnams dga' ba med pa yin nam gsung*/ khong rnams la yang snyan pa dag yod te/ kho la las ni/ rje btsun gyis gang gnang ba des chog zer nas 'dug zhus pas/ gcig shes kun grol bya ba de dga' ba yin/ 'o na yang nga rang gi gang shes rnams khyod la ston pa yin gsung*/ bka' snga 'gyur gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/

gsar ma'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las dang*/ gang zag gi dbang po'i rim pa yin don la khyad med gsung*/ gsar ma'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'am/ rgyud rims gyi bla ma ni/ thabs lam gyi de lags (416)snga 'gyur de gang nas rgyud pa lags zhus pas/ sngar lan kha yar bshad pa yin te/ rjed pa yin nam gsung*/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rabs rdo rje/ bla ma 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ ting 'dzin shri ri sing ha/ mkhas pa bi ma la mi tra/ lo ts+tsha ba dzñā na ku ma ra/ nyang sha'i spyan can/ chos rgyal khri song lde btsan/ rma blo gros dbang phyug /ye shes 'bar/ ldan ma lhun grub rgyal/ seng ge dbang phyug /zla ba rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ grub pa rgyal mtshan/ dge bshes tsa pas nga la gnang*/ ngas khyod la bshad pa de yin pas/ rgyud pa ma chad pa gyis gsung*/ yang ras chung pas/ rje mar pa de la las kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa yin zer/ la las kyai rdor gyi sprul pa yin zer ba gangs lags zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ rang rang gang mos yin la/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje rang yin par 'dug gsung*/ yum bdag med ma ni shes par 'dug zhus pas/ de yin gsung*/ yang ras chung bas/ gnyan g.yung ston khro rgyal gyi chos bsrungs 'dzin mgon (417)po de gang 'khros pa lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bcom ldan 'das sngon rdzogs gshin rje khros par 'dug gsung*/ yang ras chung pas/ snyan rgyud gyi rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu de la/ 'di las gsal ba rgyas pa cig thugs la btags na zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ de da lta ngas bshad nas khyed rnams kyis byas pa ji lta ba bzhin don du 'dril bar dka'/ dus phyis kun de rang la smon lam btab pa'i gdams ngag 'di'i rjes su 'jug pa 'dra yong nyen yod gsung*/ gdams ngag 'di snod ldan kha yar la bstan du yod na dga' bar 'dug pa la zhus pas/

rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ gdams ngag zab mo bya ba de dang po rang gi myong dgos pa yin/ de nas gzhan la ston dgos pa la/ dus da lta'i chos pa ci rigs pas rang gis ma mthong bar gzhan la ston 'dod pa mang po 'dug gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ras chung pa la/ dam chos thams cad gsang sngags rigs las 'byung*/ gsang sngags brda yis mtshon pa la/ brda dang brda lan ma byed na/ rang rdo rje 'chang dang ma mnyam par/ mi nag pa la dbang bskur ma byed cig /gsungs pa dang*/ ras chung pas/ rang res sems bzang (418)po dang*/ cho ga tshang bar byas na nyes pa tsam mi yong ngam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis zhal nas/ sems bskyed bzang po dang*/ cho ga tshang ba dang*/ bskyed rim gsal ba brtan pa dang*/ lha skon tshad du skyol ba dang*/ de rnams yod na dag des chog ste/ lar dbang bya ba 'di la rnam pa mang ste/ snang ba dang bslu khrid kyi dbang dang*/ btags pa ming gi dbang dang*/ bsam pa rdzas kyi dbang dang*/ cho ga tshang tsam gyi dbang dang bzhi tshang dgos gsung*/ de ni dbang bskur la thob pa dang*/ bskur yang ma thob pa dang*/ bskur yang bskur la thob yang thob pa dang*/ bskur yang ma thob pa dang*/ gang zag dbang po tha ma la rdzas dbang mig la bskur ba dang*/ dbang po 'bring la tshig dbang rna bar skur ba dang*/ dbang po rab la lha dbang lus la bskur ba dang*/ dbang po yang rab la chos dbang sems la bskur ba dgos pa yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ snying rang nas chos gcig byed na/ tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ gshed ma yis bslu bar byed pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho thams cad ni/ bdag med kyi ye shes bde ba chen po mnyam nyid kyi don phyin ci (419)ma log par ston pa'i bla ma dam pa mkhas shing grub pa thob pa cig dang mjal dgos la/ bla ma dam pa des gnyis 'dzin gyi mdud pa thams cad rang sar bcad nas/ bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams pham par mdzad nas/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i gral du tshud nas/

sgyu ma rig pa'i ling tog rang sar dag nas/ ye shes kyi mdangs dang ldan par the tshom med pa yin te/ snyigs dus kyi rmongs pa rnams la dka' bar 'dug gsung*/ yang mid la'i zhal nas/ ngas sngar rje mar pa'i drung na bsdad dus na/ mched grogs gong ma rnams la gdams ngag kyi dri ba mang rab bcad pas/ da lta yang gdams ngag la the tshom med pa de'i byin rlabs yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ dwags po lha rje la dbus pa khyod dang po yar yong dus na/ bla ma dang slob dpon thams cad la zhal ta zhus sam gsung pas/ zhal ta zhus lags/ bla ma snyug rum pa'i zhal nas/ nga yang da na so rgas pa dang*/ ci drag ltos la gyis gsung lags/ bla ma sha ba gling pas mi 'thad mi gsung lags/ bla ma blo ldan shes rab pas kyang song la gdams ngag brtsad chos gsung lags/ mkhas btsun chen po rgya ston pas kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa (420)yin yang mi sto gdams ngag zab mo 'dug na des chog pa yin/ ser kha la phan na khyi tshil bya ba yin pas song la gdams ngag zhus gsung lags zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ dbus pa ston pa lar ni khyod sngar gyi sbyangs pa can cig yin par 'dug ste/ 'on yang da res nga dang ma 'phrad na lha cig tu skye bar 'dug /de nas mi skyed nas rims kyis lam rdzogs 'gro bar 'dug gsung*/ dwags po rin chen pa dbus nas yar byon dus/ sa chen kun dga' snying po'i drung du/ brtag gnyis chos 'byung phyi ma gsum gsan pa dang*/ phyis rje btsun gyi drung du gsan pa dang khyad mi 'dug gsung*/ yar rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ se ban ras pa la/ khyod kyang skye bo ci rigs gong nas gsang pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i dbang dang byin rlabs thob pa cig 'dug ste/ gnas skabs su bag chags ngan pa cig gi 'phro slang nas/ tshe 'dir yang khyi ra byed dgos par byung 'dug pa da res nga dang 'phrad pas go chod pa yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/

dge bshes lam ston pa nyid cig skye ba snga ma yang dge slong khrims gtsang mar bsrungs pa'i bag chags bzang pos/ (421)tshe 'dir yang mkhas btsun du skyes par 'dug lags/ de bzhin yin yang dkar po'i las 'phro nga dang 'phrad pas slang ba yin gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ stong tsha dar blo la nyid cag dang nga ma 'phrad na da rung ngag 'khyal bag re byed pas/ don med las rnams smin bag re sogs pa 'dug ste/ da khyod rang gis dag snang sbyangs pas tshe phyi ma la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams su skye bar 'dug gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ snya nam gyi dam pa rgyags chung ba la/ khyod sngar gyi sbyangs stobs chen po can cig yin pa 'dra la 'dir yang phyir mi ldog pa'i dngos grub thob par 'dug /khyod tsho'i dus byed dus kyang rten khyad par can mang rab 'byon par 'dug gsung*/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa la/ da ni nga yang zhing khams gzhan 'dra ru 'gro yang ran pas/ khyod bu slob rnams la yang*/ sa sa so sor gdams ngag dri ba ma chod pa yang med dam bsam/ dgos su khyod la nga rang gi shes pa'i chos skor rnams yang ma lus par bstan pa de yin la/ nga'i bu slob rnams la chos kyi dri ba dang rtsad bcad rgyu dam dum 'dug na/ khyod kyis sa sa so (422)sor ston gsung*/ yang ras chung pas/ rje btsun chen po lags lus med ma'i snyan rgyud chos skor dgu po de la/ da rung nan chags cig mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ de la nan chags byed rgyu ci yod sngar yang nas yang du bshad pa de yin/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ dam tshig rang sems me long ltos/ smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud shig /spyod pa chu la ral gri rgyob// dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'dis// rig pa ye shes sgron ma ltos// rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo bskor// ro snyoms phyi yi me long ltos// rang grol phyag rgya chen po chongs// bde chen gsung gi rin chen ltos// gsung*/

bco brgyad pa phyag rgya chen po ngo 'phrod pa'i yon tan ni/ rje btsan gyi zhal nas/ lha mo'i 'bri sgom ras pa la/ khyod gtam gleng drang ba rang yin pas/ nga shi tsa na ci 'dra yong gsung pas 'bri sgom ras pa na re/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rang lags pas/ 'grongs pa mi yong ngam bsam lags/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams la yang 'das grongs 'dra byung 'dug pas/ rje btsun la yang 'das grongs yong ngam yang bsam lags zhus (423)pas/ de la rje btsun mnyes nas/ khyod kyi gtam de drang gsung skad/ yang ras chung pas dbus nas rje btsun dran nas phyag mjal la byon pas/ de'i dus na rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rnal 'byor lus kyi me tog 'di/ 'chi bdag rkyen gyi ba mo yis// bcom ste pha rol 'gro dus su// bar do mthong med rnal 'byor bde// gsungs pa dang*/ chos rje ba ri lo ts+tsha ba chen po dang gsung gleng mdzad dus kyang*/ rnal 'byor mid la ras pas bar do mi mthong bar 'dug gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang dben pa brin gyi sman lung chu dbar gyi yang dben 'bri lci skyid phug na/ bu slob yon bdag la chos cig gsung dus na/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ mid la sprang po la/ yon tan rdzogs kyi bar do ru/ snyan rgyud zab mos mtshams sbyar nas/ bla ma yi dam 'od gsal gyis// bskyel bsu skyed med lam khrid nas// sems kyi ma'u mjal dus su// nga la mthong ba sna tshogs yong*/ gsung nas/ mid la sprang po shi tsa na cho 'phrul chen po yong gsungs so// sku 'das pa'i dus na yang*/ mi bcu gnyis drung na yod pa la/ snang ba dag pa dang snang ba ma dag pa'i lo rgyus gnyis yod pa la/ snang ba dag pa rnams kyi ni sku (424)'das zer ba'i dus na yang*/ ras dga' de gzims mal na 'dug pa las/ rje btsan gar gshegs cha med pa'i gshegs te/ sku lus khyer bar 'dug bya bar gsungs so// snang ba ma dag pa rnams ni 'og nas gsal bar ston pa'o// gzhan yang ras chung rnams kyis/

gal te rje btsun grongs na rjes kyi gshegs rdzongs ci 'dra byed la zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga rang nyal ba'i lho ngos 'di nas mar rkos dang*/ nor mang po yod pas de yang ma bzhag cig /khyed rnams kyis yang ma gtong cig khyed tshos nor btang na dam tshig nyams pa yin gsung pa dang*/ mi rnams na re 'o na rje btsun grub thob chen po yin pas/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs mdzad pas yon bdag mi chen dang*/ 'byor ba che ba dad pa can rnams kyis 'bul ba'i gser g.yu la sogs pa nor chen po mang rab yod par 'dug go /de tsho cig re yang re zer nas grongs pa'i dus na thams cad tshogs nas rkos nas ltas pas bu ram rdog ma gsum dang*/ mar 'gron bu tsam cig dang*/ gri gu sor bzhi pa cig bzhag nas 'dug pas/ mid la sprang po la nor gyi yong sa ci yod/ bu ram dang mar 'di la rtsa go ra gyis (425)la gri gug 'dis chod la zo zer ba cig g.yam pa cig la bris 'dug pas/ der thams cad kyis rje btsun shin tu spros med mdzad pa la nor yong sa ci yod/ rang re rnams tshod chung pa yin zer skad do// de la sogs pa'i gsung ngo mtshar can mang rab bzhugs pa zur na gsal/ de na sku tshe 'dir mdzad pa dang 'phrin las bsam gyi mi khyab pa rnams rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa dang tha dad med par mdzad na/ da ni ji ltar bsreg bya bud shing zad pas bsreg byed me'i rgyun chad pa ltar du/ mdzad pa pa mtha' ma'i tshul ston pa ni 'di ltar lags so// spyir du na dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyang*/ mdzad pa dang 'phrin las ma rdzogs kyi bar du dus min la mya ngan las 'da' bar mi mdzad cing*/ 'phrin las rdzogs nas bzhugs par mi gnang ba'i tshul bstan nas/ snying rus can gyi bla ma mid la ras pas kyang*/ gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyis sems can smin grol la yang dag par bkod nas/ da ni sems can le lo dang rtag par lta ba rnams sun phyung ba'i phyir du mdzad pa tha ma'i tshul ston pa las/

de yang rigs chad kyi gang zag ngan pa rang bzhin gyi rmu long tsag phug gi mkhan po de dang po nas kho rje (426)btsun la mi dad la bskur ba btab pa cig yod pa la/ kho'i 'khor rnams kyis nan ma theg par/ nyin cig dbang med sha mar 'dra khyer 'ong nas/ rje btsun la mjal du byung ba dang khos chos gtam lung ma bstan kha yar byas pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ long bas rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa phog pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten la rab gnas kyi cho ga byed pa ni/ bka' mdo rgyud nas ma gnang ba lags pas/ dge bshes pas de ltar ma mdzad na 'thad tsam yin pa dang*/ gsang sngags bla med kyi lugs kyis/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyud bshad pa dang*/ khrid 'debs pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ de rnams ni bkag pa tsam med na yang*/ rang re'i rgyud tshod dang sbyar 'tshal bas/ de ltar mdzad 'tshal gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyi gsung de thos pas/ kho la chags dang byed par go nas/ kho log lta chen po skyes nas/ slar kho rang gi khang par phyin te/ 'khor rnams bsdus nas dung btang ste thams cad nyon cig /brin snya nam yi sa cha na mdo sngags bshad gsum dang*/ cho gnyan btsun gsum thams cad kyis nga la gus pa mi 'dud pa med pa la/ mi la ras pa zer ba'i khyi skrog 'dis/ (427)nga la chags sdang byed par 'dug la/ dgos pa'i dgon chung cig bzung nas/ 'khor slob kyi skyong ran ni med/ mi dgos pa'i glu ma dbyangs bro ma gzhas cig rgyun mi 'chad pa 'dis/ nga so ma bsod par rna ba na bar 'dug pas/ nga la gtogs pa'i 'khor rnams song la/ mid la ras pa 'dra ba'i khyi skrog de la brdung btag cig gyis la spu sel la phar thon la thong zer bas/ 'khor rnams na re de 'dra byas na dge bshes tsag phug pas/ rje mid la ras chen brdung nas brin nas bton zer ba'i gtam ngan chen po yong ngo*// gcig du ni khong la ni rdzu 'phrul mnga' bas rang res brdung mi thub pas/

de las khong gi gang gsung byas pa drag byas pas/ khong bsam ngan skyes nas/ brdung btag byas na nga bshes gnyen chen po yin pas/ grags pa ngan par 'gro la/ nga'i grags pa nyams pas/ da 'di la dug gcig blud la bsad dgos bsam nas/ bya lo shing mo rta zla ba'i yar tshe drug gi mtshan mo ni/ khong rang gi khrim 'phrog byi mo cig la mdze byung ba cig yod pas/ de la shog byas nas/ bza' btung bzang po byin nas/ rang re gnyis sngar lus 'brel byas pas/ shang phobs pa'i snying gtam yin (428)pas/ da lta khyod la nad mdze byung na yang*/ nga khyod la sems brtse ba 'di seng yin pas da khyod kyis mi la ras pa la dug cig thong dang*/ ngas g.yu 'di ster byas nas g.yu chen po gcig bstan pas/ mdze mo bsod zad mas/ de los kyang byed zer te/ yar tshes bdun gyi snga dro do ba'i rtsa ba btags pa'i do khod bzhi shing leb gcig gi khar bzhag nas/ rje btsun krong ti bkra shis sgang na bzhugs pa'i drung du khyer byung ba dang*/ mdze mo na re nged kyi dge bshes pa rje btsun la ye mi mos pa lags te/ nged 'khor rnams mos par yod na yang*/ nga la drang rgyu gzhan ci yang med pas/ do ba 'di gsol ba zhu zer ba dang*/ rje btsun chen pos mo'i lag du g.yu ma sleb par mkhyen nas/ 'o khyod dad pa che ba de bzang*/ da nang ni yon bdag mo legs gsal 'bum mes tsha ba drangs byung ba de zos tshar/ nang par dang gnangs gnyis 'bar sing dang dkon 'bar gnyis kyi 'dren par yod pas/ khyod rang drang rgyu yod pa de bzhes snga dro khyer la shog gsungs pas/ mdze mo na re 'o na bzhes snga dro 'ong bar zhu/ rje btsun thugs mi 'gyur bar gsol bar zhu zer nas song skad/ de nas yar tshes (429)bcu'i snga dro mdzes mo'i lag du g.yu sleb par mkhyen nas/ rje btsun sding ma brag mkhar na byon pa dang*/ mdze mo dga' nas tsa phug pa can du phyin nas zho ja phor gang la dug btab pa cig blangs nas/

rje btsun la drangs pas/ rje btsun zhal 'dzum mdzad nas/ khyod kyi lag tu g.yu de sleb sam gsung pa dang*/ mdzes mo skrag nas 'o na rje btsun gyis mkhyen nas 'dug bsam nas/ gsang ma phod nas g.yu slebs lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ g.yu de khyod la phan pa'i phyir du byas pa yin/ khyod la nyes pa mi yong gsung nas/ phyag g.yas pas shangs de bkab nas/ phyag g.yon pas zho de gsol nas/ 'di skad gsungs nas mgur bzhes pa/ na bo cog ni na nas 'chi// bod kyi mid la ras pa nga*// da lan gyi nad 'dis 'chi 'chi 'dra/ gsung nas*/ bu slob rnams la nga khong du dug song ba'i nad pa yin pas/ 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar shir 'gro gsung nas/ lha bro na yar byon pas brin pa thams cad kyis gshegs skyems drangs nas sku khams zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi sku mdun na mar la/ bud med sma ra ser khyug se ba gcig byung nas/ dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyis sras// 'gro ba ma lus 'dren (430)pa'i dpal// de bod kyi mid la ras pa ma lags sam// brin sman lung chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang na phar song zer ba dang*/ yon bdag mo rgyal mo skyid kyis/ rje btsun gyi sku stod la phang pa gtad nas ngus pas/ bu slob gzhan rnams dang ngu shing*/ rje btsun 'grongs sa chu dbar na mdzad dgos zer nas gsol ba btab pas/ dmus long tsag phug pa yang byung nas/ mid la rnal 'byor pa khyed na shing 'dug gam zer ba dang*/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ en tsam ma bde gsung ba la/ khong na re 'o na rnal 'byor pa 'o rgyal bas/ khyed kyi nad de 'dir tshogs tshad la dum re dgod nyan na dga' ba la/ ngas kyang skal ba gcig len pa yin te zer bas/ rje btsun chen pos de bgo nyan pa byas pas chog gsung nas/ thams cad la bgo ba ltar mdzad pas/ tsag phug pa la nya bye tshan la yar ba lta bu'i zug gzer langs pa dang*/ kho 'gyod pa chen po skyes nas/ rje btsun chen po thugs rjes zung zhig

/nga las ngan pos ci yang gi las ngan bsags 'dug zer nas/ rje btsun gyi zhabs la mgo bstugs nas ngu shing nya bye tshan la yar ba 'dra ba'i ngu 'bod byas pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal (431)nas/ nga nam mkha' stong pa nang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa la dug gi gnod pas ga na tshugs/ dge bshes pa rang gis chos dang 'gal ba'i lam log rnams byed cing 'dug pa/ de 'dul ba'i phyir du byas pa yin no// da khyod rang 'gyod sems drag po skyes pa des/ las sgrib mang po 'dag pa yin no// da thams cad rang rang gi sar bzhud cig /nga yang chu dbar du lus po 'di bzhag nas 'gro gsung nas/ rje btsun chen po cang ri ra 'khrol shing nam mkha' la 'phur nas chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang du gshegs pa dang*/ bu slob rnams dang chu dbar du phyin la/ mkhan po tsag phug pa yang*/ 'khor g.yog rnams kyis khur nas/ ngu 'bod byed cing chu dbar du yong nas yod pa dang*/ dge bshes tsag phug pas/ bla ma rje btsun gyi rgyal po mid la ras chen la dug grangs nas yod par 'dug zer ba'i gtam ngan chen pos/ rgyal khams khyab pa byung bas/ thams cad dpal he ru ka'i pho brang brin sman lung chu dbar sprul sku'i dben gnas su 'tshogs pa dang*/ dge bshes tsag phug blo gros dbang phyug khong ngo tsha nas lcebs rtsis byas pas/ rje btsun chos kyi sku la snyung (432)ba mi mnga' bar mgur bzhes pa/ yong na bo cog ni mi 'chi ste// shi bo cog ni na nas 'chi// bod kyi mi la ras pa nga*// da res kyi nad 'dis 'chi 'chi 'dra// nga la pho gdon du gsang ba 'dus pa gnod// mo gdon du ma hā ma ya gnod// sri gdon du rdo rje 'chang chen gnod// rgyab rten du bla ma dkon mchog gnod// mgo bo de tshangs pa'i gzhung lam gsang*// ro stod de stong nyid kyi gzer gyis thebs// ro smad de phyag chen srin gyis gang*// srog rtsol de a thung me ru 'bar// nga da res kyi nad 'dis 'chi 'chi 'dra// gsung pa dang*/

yar tshes bcu dang bcu gnyis la bu slob dang yon bdag rnams 'tshogs nas/ sku'i rim 'gro cig byed par zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ mid la sprang po la rim 'gro dgos pa ci yang med kyang*/ khyed rang rnams 'tshogs rdzogs pa yin gsung nas bka' gnang ngo*// de nas dge bshes tsag phug pa gdong mchi mas g.yogs nas/ 'di skad zhus par 'dug ste/ rje btsun chen po lags/ da ngas ci 'dra byas na ngan song nas thar pa 'dra srid dam zhus pas/ mid la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug khong gis/ (433)mgur gsung pa/ yong skyes pho rab rnams kyis chos byed dgos// skyes pho rab kyis chos byed ma shes na// seng chen gang la 'gying ba 'dra// nyams rtsal che yang dgos rgyu chung*// skyes pho 'bring sgoms la chos byed dgos// skyes pho 'bring gi chos byed pa ma shes na// klag gis tshang rtsi sog dang 'dra// btsan phyug 'dzom yang dgos rgyu chung*// skyes pho tha rnams kyis chos byed dgos// skyes pho tha rnams kyis chos byed ma shes na// spyang khus ri stong 'grim pa 'dra// sdig sdug bsags kyang dgos rgyu chung*// za ma mo rab rnams kyis chos byed dgos// mo rab kyis chos byed ma shes na// rma bya mdongs la ltas pa 'dra// kha dog legs kyang dgos rgyu chung*// za ma mo 'bring rnams la chos byed dgos// mo 'bring gis chos byed ma shes na// sbrang mas sbrang rtsi bsags pa 'dra// bsi sogs mkhas kyang dgos rgyu chung*// za ma mo tha rnams kyis chos byed dgos// mo tha yis chos byed ma shes na// khyi mo tshang ma'i lus ngan 'dra// khrud phyir las ngan bsags yang dgos rgyu chung*// lar rang re shi bdud kyis zin tsa na// btsan pos ngar skad byed sa med// kha zhan gyis lkog nyal byed sa med// phyug pos nor gyis bslu sa med// dbul pos med kha (434)gdar sa med// dpa' bos ral kha 'gyed pa med// bsdar mas wa bros byed sa med// mdzangs mas gtam gyi bshad sa med// gyad pas shed kyis 'jug sa med// bzo cos gra srubs byed sa med// mgar bas lcags mkhar brtsigs sa med// 'tsho byed sman gyis gso sa med// ban bon gyi rim 'gro byed sa med// snang log par do'i 'jigs 'khrang der// dus gsum gyi rgyal bas kyang skyabs dka' bas// de bas dam pa'i lha chos mdzad do// ces gsungs so// de'i snga mo'i dus cig na/

rje btsun gyi zhal nas ri bon po gnyan gyi rtse mo der// rang re bya ba btang ba'i mi dgu yod// bu skyid du tshor ram ras chung rnams// pha nga ni nyams dga' shes pa bde// bu zhi ba 'od dang zhi bde ba skyong*// tshur shog pha yi ram bu theg /bod kyi mi la ras pa ngas// ri bo gdung mo gzhibs 'dra mthong*// nyi zla cha lang sdebs 'dra mthong*// ces gsungs pa ni/ bla ma rje btsun gyi rgyal po mid la ras chen gyis sa dang po rab dga'i snga bltas gzigs par 'dug go /de nas nyi ma phyed dang gsum song ba dang*/ dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhal nas/ nga la na ba med pas thams cad so sor (435)gyes gsungs pas/ gzhan la nyams song nas/ mi bcu gnyis drung na bsdad pa ni/ se ban ras pa dang zhi ba 'od dang*/ khyi ra ras pa dang*/ glan ras dang*/ bshes gnyen ras pa dang*/ ngam rdzong ras pa dang*/ 'bri sgom ras pa dang*/ ras chung rdo rje grags ni dbus na bzhugs pa zhag dga' ma sleb la/ yon bdag sding ma ba 'bar ba seng ge dang*/ tsham po che ba dkon mchog 'bar dang*/ yon bdag mo legs gsal 'bum me dang*/ yon bdag mo rgyal mo skyid dang*/ dge bshes tsag phug pas rje btsun gyi zhabs la mgo btugs nas phyir lang ma nyan pa dang mi bcu gnyis na yod pa la/ de nas yar tshes gsum gyi nyin par ni/ mid la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ skad cig yud tsam la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpar dngos su gyur nas/ dge bshes tsag phug pa la bum dbang bskur nas rgyud ngan pa'i sgrib pa dag par mdzad cing*/ yang skad cig yud tsam la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dngos su gyur nas/ nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims phog par mdzad/ yang skad cig yud tsam la bde dgyes gsang gsum la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi lha tshogs (436)bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul nas/ tsag phug pa la dbang byin brlabs dang bcas pa gnang ba yin te/

de dag yang cig tu na/ rkyen drag po dge ba'i bskul ma yin cing*/ bya ba ngan pa la 'gyod pa'i sems drag po skyes pa de/ sdig pa 'dag myur ba yin te/ chos kyi rgyal po ma skyes dgra lta bu yin la/ bya ba ngan pa rnams la 'gyod sems med la slar la rnyog pa bzhin byed pa ni/ dper na mi dge ba'i ston pa lha sbyin lta bu yin la/ da lta yang de bzhin byed pa mang rab yod do// de na nyi ma dgongs mor song ba dang*/ rje btsun chen po ni sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs mdzad cing 'dug pa dang*/ ngam rdzong ras pa la sogs pa rnams kyis/ rje btsun chen po la 'das grongs mi mnga' na yang*/ da lta rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs mdzad pa de la ltas na/ gzhan don la gshegs bzhed pa yin nam bsam pa lags pas gal te 'das grongs byung na/ nged rnams kyis rjes kyi bya ba ci 'dra byed lags zhus pas/ rje btsun zhal nas/ 'o khyed dge bshes tsag phug pas/ da res kyi mig long ba des mi chog par/ nam zhag gtan gyi long ba cig do zla byas pa yin te/ da res nga mid la sprang po dang 'phrad pas (437)'tshengs pa lags so// lar rang re shi ba'i lam rogs la chos min pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan la/ chos rang yang brgya shes pa las kyang gcig grub pa dga' ba yin pas/ thams cad kyis sgom cig /nga mid la sprang po nang par 'chi ba cig kyang do re yang sgoms byed pa 'di yin no// skal ldan kun re re la thams cad kyis bsgoms cig gsung nas/ mgur 'di skad gsungs so// lar btsan phyug 'dzoms pa'i pho rgod tso// 'chi khar 'gyod pa mang po mthong*// rang re 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na// lo brgya thub pa'i nor yod kyang*// 'chi ba'i nang par lag stong 'gro// lo brgya thub pa'i zas yod kyang*// shi ba'i nang par ltogs par 'gro// lo brgya thub pa'i gos yod kyang*// shi ba'i nang par gcer bur 'gro// lo brgya thub pa'i rta yod kyang*// shi ba'i nang par rkang thang 'gro// lo brgya 'grogs pa'i gnyen yod kyang*// shi ba'i nang par gcig pur 'gro// gsung zhing sku lus kyi bkod pa sna tshogs ston cing 'dug pa dang*/

yang ras chung rnams kyis/ rje btsun chen po la 'das grongs mi mnga' na yang*/ gal te 'grongs pa 'dra byung na spur gang du sbyang*/ rjes kyi gsheg rdzong ji 'dra byed lags zhus pas/ pha mid la (438)ras chen gyi mgur gsungs pa/ yong chu bdar sprul sku'i dben gnas su// bod kyi mid la ras pa kho// mi nga shi ba'i dus na 'di bzhin gyis// ma sru bu sring ma lags pa// grags stong brjod bral ngu dbyangs gyis// thag rul 'breng rul ma lags pa// rtsa a wa dhu tis ro tshur khyigs// pha cig srid sde ma lags pa// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros ro yang khur// pha mes kyi dur sa ma lags pa// rdo rje 'chang gi dur sar skyol// bu tsha snabs bshal ma lags pa// bsgrub rgyud chu bo'i gzhung dang snyoms// shing nags 'gal dum ma lags pa// 'od gsal zhun mes ro yang bsregs// khyengs grags ston 'gyod ma lags pa// sku gsum 'bral med dga' ston gyis// ras bris lugs sku ma lags pa// 'khor gzhi rtsad gcod kyi sku gdung thob gsung*/ yang ras chung rnams kyis rje btsun chen po lags/ 'di nas gshegs nas gang du sku 'khrungs lags/ nged tso gsol ba gang du 'debs lags zhus pas/ mi la ras chen gyis mgur gsungs pa/ yong chu dbar dpal gyi dben gnas su// bod kyi rnal 'byor ras pa ngas// ri bo mdung mo gshibs 'dra mthong*// nyi zla chab long gtor 'dra (439)mthong*// rigs lnga bya 'phur chos nyid rlung*// 'khor lo sgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// nga la zhing khams nges pa can med pas// khyed rang rnams gang mos sar gsol ba thob gsung*/ yang ras chung rnams kyis/ rje btsun chen po la sku nye ni med pas/ jo mo 'or mo dang*/ sngags rdor mo la skad re btang lags sam zhus pas/ pha mi la ras chen gyi zhal nas/ nga la gnyen dang yul phyogs dgos pa ci yang med do// lar rang re shi ba'i dus na chos min pa gang gis kyang mi phan pas/

nga'i 'di la nyon gsung nas mgur bzhes pa/ rang re shi ba'i dus su gyur pa na// rang dang 'dra ba'i pha mas kyang*// snga dro ngu 'bod g.yer mkhan byed// dgongs mo snying khu skyogs rgan 'thung*// rang dang 'dra ba'i spun zlas kyang*// snga dro ngu 'bod g.yer mkhan byed// dgongs mo nor la zhe sgom byed// rang dang 'dra ba'i chung mas kyang*// snga dro ngu 'bod g.yer ngan byed// dgongs mo sems kyi gtad rogs 'tshol// rang dang 'dra ba'i bu tshas kyang*// snga dro ngu 'bod g.yer ngan byed// dgongs mo khang bu khang rtsed byed// mid la sprang po la gnyen tshan med pa de legs pa yin gsungs so// de nas yar tshes bcu gsum gyi nyi ma la brgal la khad (440)pa dang*/ rje btsun dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal nas/ 'o thams cad kyis bsgoms cig /nga nang par snga dro 'chi bas kyang*// do re yang sgom byed pa yin no// gsungs nas/ nyung rtog gi kong bu chen po cig mdzad te/ de'i nang du snang gsal ltam nas/ dbu'i thog na bzhag ste/ sku lus rdo rje skyil krung la bzhugs cing*/ gser gyi dong rtse brtsegs pa ltar mdzad la/ sku'i brjid ni rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho dang tha dad mi mnga' la/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ nya rgyas gyi zla ba la sprin tshogs g.ya' dang bral ba ltar du/ 'od mdangs zer dang bcas par bzhugs la/ g.yo med rgya mtsho la pha 'ong skyur ba ltar du dgongs pa la bzhugs so/ drung na yod pa'i mi bcu gnyis po des mar ngos na yar ltas pas/ bla ma'i sku chos drug rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas g.yo 'gul mi mnga' zhing*/ nam skya gsal langs pa dang*/ dbu thog gi snang gsal de yang*/ je gsal je gsal la song nas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gsal ba byung ba dang*/ bla ma rje btsun ras chen yang*/ thugs dam la bzhengs nas/ shangs gnyis nas rlung (441)si ri ri mdzad te/

'o thams cad kyi sgoms cig /nga da nang 'chi ba cig gis yang mdang yang sgom byas pa yin gsung tsa na/ dbu thog gi snang gsal de nam mkha' la dpag chen gyi mdas kyang mgyogs par yar nas song ba dang*/ mid la rnal 'byor gyi zhal nas/ rje mar pa byon yod do// maṇ+ḍal phul gsung nas/ yongs chu dbar dpal gyi pho brang na// nga mi la ras pa na so rgas// tha mal gzu+ugs kyi phung po 'di// g.yar po yin gyis gang dgar zhog /'khor lo sgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// rigs lnga bya 'phur chos nyid rlung*// bu badz+ra kīr ti la de skad bzlos// nga rig pa chos kyi dbyings su 'pho// shes rgyud tshangs pa'i lam nas 'don// gsung tsa na/ spyi gtsug yar la 'od tshang rja tsam cig thon nas/ nam mkha' na yar song ba dang*/ bya'i lo rta pa zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma ri rtse la ser lhag shar ba dang*/ dus kha mnyam pa la/ bla ma rje btsun mid la rnal 'byor dbang phyug /dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje mtshan yongs su grags pa'i mi la ras chen de chos kyi dbyings su gshegs so// dgung lo brgya bcu rtsa bzhi pa yin no// de nas pur gang sbyang la brin pa dang*/ snya nam pa ma 'cham nas/ (442)gtso bo rnams gros byas te/ zhag gsum gyi nyin mo brin dang*/ la phyi gnyis kyi bar du sbyang bar byas nas/ so sor gyes pa la/ brin pas lam nas tshur log nas/ pur brin du gdan drangs nas song ba de/ snya nam pas tshor de dmag sogs chen po byas nas/ 'khrug pa chen po yong bar 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyi sku gsum du sprul te/ cig ni yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sna ba g.yon pa/ 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar gdan drangs nas/ bdud brtugs dpal gyi phug mo che'i khyung rang byon gyi gshog pa g.yon pa'i 'og rus sbal gyi khog pa'i mdun/ pha 'ong khyung sgong gi steng du sbyangs la/ gcig ni brin sding ma na gdan drangs nas/ gar sbyang gi kha tshon ma chod pa la/

klu bdud nag po mthong ba dug can gyi mgo thog na/ bu chung glen pa lo brgyad pa cig gis 'dir sbyongs zer ba'i mdzu gu btsugs pas/ der sbyangs la bu chung de yang de nas rang la mkha' spyod la song gda'o// gcig dpal he ru ka'i pho brang sman lung chu dbar gyi yang dben 'bri lce skyid phug tu sbyangs la/ pur gsum ga la me dus gcig phul bas/ brin sding ma bar khang du sbyangs pa de la me mched ma 'dod (443)pas/ rje btsun rang gi gsung bar snang la sgra byung nas/ snang ba dag pa rnams kyis pha tshad nas gsol ba thob pa dang gsungs nas/ de ltar byas pas me rang 'bar la song nas 'ja' tshon dang bkra shis g.yu drung 'khyil ba dang*/ de la sogs pa'i me stag 'phros pa ni mchod par me sgra ni rol mo'i sgra ldan du byung*/ lha'i bu dang bu mo dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams mngon sum du byung nas/ gdung bsdus nas song ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams na re/ yid bzhin nor bu gshegs dus su// la la brgyal te la la dag /ngu zhing mya ngan byed dus su// rang byung me ni 'bar gyur nas// du ba 'ja' tshon ltar 'khyil cing*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// bkra shis dpal be'u g.yu drung 'khyil// me'i sgra rnams cha lang sgra// gling bu pi wang ting ting shag /cang te'u sgra dang ḍa ma ru'i sgra 'khrol zhing*// me stag skar mda' ltar 'khrigs pas// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa byed// yid 'ong mkha' 'gro du ma yis// pur spyangs gdung ni khyer rnams nas// bla ma chos sku'i nam mkha' las// longs sku smon lam sprin gtibs te// sprul sku'i 'phrin las char rgyun gyis// gdul bya'i lo (444)tog smin par byed// gang la skye ba med pa yis// chos ni skye med stong pa nyid// stong nyid skye 'gag dang bral ba// the tshom yid gnyis ci byar yod// ces pa'i sgra don dang bcas pa byung ste/

phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'o// de ltar na phyis rje btsun chen po la 'das pa'i tshul yod par 'dod pa dang*/ 'das pa'i tshul med par mthong ba'i bye brag de ltar byung ba'i snang ba byung ste/ de ltar bla ma mkha' spyod la gshegs nas/ spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad cing rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan pas/ la las ni bla ma seng ge la chibs nas mkha' 'gro ma du ma dang bcas nas bzhud par mthong ba rnams ni dbang po rab kyi dag snang yin no// la las ni bla ma 'das tshul bstan nas mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa byon nas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med bshams nas/ gdung bzhus pas bkra shis pa'i rtags rol mo dang*/ 'ja' tshon gyi 'od dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa rnams byung ste/ gdung rus rnams thams cad ni ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur pa ni/ nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro mas gdan drangs par mthong ngo*// (445)de ltar bla ma chos sku mngon du gyur cing*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku shugs la shar nas/ sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs pas phyogs bcur khyab pas/ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i 'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa'o// a la la sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang sems can thams cad kyis thob par gyur cig /bla ma mid la ras pa rang gi zhal nas gsungs nges pa dang*/ bu chen ras chung rdo rje grags pa la sogs pa rnams kyi gsung sgros khyad par can rnams phra zhib tu mthong ba dang*/ spyir yang zhi byed ri khrod pa bdag gis/ bod gangs can khrod na 'gyur tshad kyi bka' mdo rgyud dang*/ lung man ngag rnams phal cher mthong zhing*/ thos pa dang*/ khyad par du zhi byed ni sa steng du 'gyur tshad dang*/ rje bla ma 'khon sa skya ba'i chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ skyes mchog mar pa lo ts+tsha ba'i gdams ngag rnams yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/

de la sogs pa'i bka' brgyud rnams la phyogs ris med par gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ shākya'i dge slong zhi byed ri khrod pa bdag gi las skal yin pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma mid la ras pa 'di'i (446)bka' srol gyi brgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dzin pa ni/ kho bo rang tsam mang po yang mi 'dug go /chos pa drag tu re ba rnams kyis yang rgyug thug tsam na ngo srung sems 'dzin re byed par 'dug la/ dgon chung rer shi nyal rtag tshams re byas nas stod par 'dug ste/ don la snying rul ba rang yin la/ pha mid la ras chen gyi brgyud pa btson pa yin no// don tig pa la rje mid la ras chen gyi rnam thar bzhin byas na/ bka' mdo rgyud dang yang de mthun pa yin no// spyir yang rgya dkar nag bod gsum na 'gyur tshad kyi bka' mdo rgyud dang*/ lung man ngag rnams phal cher kho bos mthong zhing thos pa dang*/ rang gi nyams len gyi mthil la lam 'bras dang zhi byed dang*/ rje kha rag sgom chung ba'i phyag len dang*/ skyes mchog lho brag pa'i gdam bskor rnams yongs su rdzogs par thob cing*/ dbang phyug mid la ras chen gyi rnam mgur yi ger bkod pa rang yang*/ brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam mthong shing*/ rtogs par bya ba'i don gyis na/ shākya'i dge slong g.yung ston zhi byed ri khrod pa nga'i las skal ni/ tshe 'di blos btang nas mi tshe ri khrod la skyal ba de rang yin pas na/ gang zag (447)tshe 'dir don du gnyer ba rnams dang*/ nga'i blo sna rtsa ba nas mthun pa rang med do// bla ma rje btsun chen po'i rnam thar 'di la/ 'di las rgyas pa cig byed bsam pa yin na'ang*/ yi ge mangs pas 'jigs nas 'di tsam la bzhag pa yin no// 'di ni da lta'i lo drangs mang rab kyi gong nas/ chos rje rin chen dpal ldan glang 'khor ba'i drung nas kyang zhal ta gnang ba dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul sku sa rje la shing gi mkhan chen dbang phyug shes rab pa'i drung nas kyang yang yang byon pa dang*/

bla ma mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i khyad par yang snyan rgyud kyi don la sbyangs pa'i gzi brjid rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis kyang yang yang du bskul ba dang*/ bla ma ri khrod dbang phyug skyes mchog chen po ma ṇi pa'i drung nas kyang*/ zhal ta yang yang byon pa dang*/ gzhan yang gnas gsum gyi ri pa rnams kyis yang bskul ba dang*/ khyad par du yang ti shri chen po rin chen grags pa dang*/ go shri chos blo'i dbon po sprul pa'i sku bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po des/ 'jig rten blos btang nas gnas chen dang ri khrod 'grims nas gangs ti se nas mar byon nas 'brog la phyi na tshur la byon te/ (448)rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la bzhugs pa yin gsungs nas dpal ding ri glang 'khor du khong gi phyag gis nga'i lag pa la bzung nas/ bla ma rje btsun mid la ras chen gyi rnam thar lo rgyus la/ khyed las rgyus che ba ni gangs ti si man chad/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga pa yan chad na mi 'dug pas/ 'di la yig cha rnam thar rgyas pa cig khyed shes gsung nan cher mdzad pa dang*/ yang dus phyis dbus nas kyang bla ma dam pa chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rjes gcig dang*/ bla ma kun rgyal ba dang rang gi gsung shog cig dang*/ dge slong byang skyabs 'phags pa shing kun gyi chus 'khor 'bul du yong ba la bskur byung nas de dus kyang gsung nan chen po mdzad 'dug pa dang*/ dpal he ru ka'i pho brang sman lung chu dbar gyi gdan sa la/ bla ma ri khrod dbang phyug byang sems sangs rgyas dpal gyis yang do dam cher mdzad pa dang*/ slob dpon ta'i si tu byang rgyal bas kyang gsung shog rten dang bcas pa thebs gsum bskur byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang mang rab kyi bskul cing*/ lar yang rje btsun mid la ras chen 'di'i sku drin dran nas/ rnam thar 'di byas pa yin cing*/ spyir mid la ras chen gyi rnam (449)thar la mdzad pa mi cig pa brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam mthong ba dang*/

khyad par du rje khyung tshang ba dzña na gu ru dang*/ lnga rig shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa/ chos rje zhang lo ts+tsha ba grub pa dpal bzang po dang*/ de rnams kyi gsung sgros la gzhi blangs nas byas pa lags cing*/ tshig la gong 'og nor ba 'dra ba dang 'dra min dum re snang ste/ grub thob kyi spyod yul la nges pa med pa lags pas/ da man chad rtog ge pas ma bcos cig /byin rlabs nyams pa yin no// gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros ma yin pa'i snyan ngag dang sdeb tshig ni byin rlabs nyams dogs ma byas pa yin no// rje btsun chen po grongs pa ni dpal sman lung chu dbar gyi yang dben 'bri lce skyid phug gi g.yon zur/ klu'i rgyal po dung sgra'i sna ba g.yon pa'i steng gi rdo ba'i chos khri dkar chung la sku rgyab gtad nas grongs pa yin la/ pur gsum bzhag pa'i gcig de he ru ka'i pho brang 'bri lce phug gi mdun der sbyangs pa yin la/ pur sbyangs pa gsum ga na/ gdung rus ni byon rgyu ma byung la/ gsum kha na rin po che kha dog sna lnga la grub pa'i/ gdung sha ri ram la sogs pa 'dus pa bya ma gsar gyi sgo nga tsam gsum byon pa ni/ yum sprul pa'i (450)dpa' mo bkra shis tsho'i dbang phyug mas 'ja' lam la gdan drangs nas/ gangs zur gsum dung gi gzhal yas kyi khyung mgo shel gyi zur phud na bzhugs pa'o// 'brog la phyi na sbyangs pa de la dbu skra dum gcig dang yig drug byon pa yin zer/ sding ma bar khang na sbyangs pa de la dung gi 'khor lo rtsibs lnga pa gcig la stod byang pa btsun ma cig gis rnyed dam zer/ chu dbar yang dben na sbyangs pa de la/ rdo ba la oṃ āḥhūm̐ byon pa ni da lta yang gnas chen chu dbar dpal gyi pho brang na bzhugs so// gdung thal cha bzhi ru bgos nas/ cha gcig la sku 'dra chung se ba gcig bzhengs nas/ la phyi gnas nang du bzhugs pa yin ste/ la phyi rlan ches pas snya nam bkra shis sgang na gdan drangs nas bzhugs pa de yin la/

cha gcig la sku 'dra gcig bzheng nas/ dpal he ru ka'i pho brang sman lung chu dbar na bzhugs cing*/ chu dbar gyi gser 'bum de ni/ dpal phag mo grub pa rdo rje rgyal pos zhal chems bzhag nas/ bla ma skyu ra rin po che 'bri khung pa rin chen dpal gyi bzhengs pa yin zer/ 'bri khung pa rang ni byon pa min/ ri pa rnams la cha rkyen bskur nas zhal ta mdzad pa yin no// cha gcig la dge bshes (451)tsag phug pas gzhi len byas nas/ yon bdag rnams kyis sding ma bar khang gi lha khang de bzhengs pa yin gsungs/ dge bshes tsag phug pa rang gi sdig gshags la sku 'bum chen mo gcig bzhengs 'dug /dum gnon 'dug pa la brin pa rnams kyis gsos 'dug /gdung thal cha gcig ni bu slob rnams kyis gdan drangs nas/ rang rang gi sar rten rnams bzhengs 'dug /rje btsun rta pa zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma ri rtse la lhag shar ba dang grongs tshul bstan pa dang*/ dus khad mnyam par/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa dbus kyi snyal lo ra'i mgo pa tshe spong gi dgon par bzhugs pa'i sar/ rje btsun mid la ras pa byon nas/ kho de ras chung pa mid la ras pa'i gzungs kyi phung po ni brin sman lung chu dbar na bzhag yod do// nga rang nyal ba'i rgyab kyi brag them der me lcags de yod pas/ de khyod rang len du song gsung ba dang*/ der ras chung pa thugs tshub ril song nas/ rlung bzung nas yar byon pas/ zla lam tsam yod pa la/ zhag gsum gyi snga dro brin chu dbar na sleb la khad pa'i sar/ yar tshes bcu bdun la pur sbyong dang 'jal ba la/ dang po chos khri dkar chung na/ rje btsun bzhugs pa (452)dang mjal nas phyag 'tshal bas/ rje btsun ni zhal 'dzum mi mdzad nas nga yang yong gis khyod rang en mgyogs par song gsung pa dang*/ ras chung spyan chab thon/ sku brang brdungs/ dbu skra bal/ zhal du sa gsol shing mar byon pa dang*/ bu slob rnams kyis ras chung pa la 'thab tu byung ste/

khrims med dam med po/ khyod la bla mas thugs rtsigs ci tsam cig mdzad na/ lar yang zhabs drung du mi sdod par/ kha sang yang snga se mi yong shing*/ da lta'i bar la mi sleb pa zer nas yong ma bcug pas/ ras chung pas pha mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ ces pa'i mgur de phul bas/ gdung khang gi steng na me lce pad+ma 'dab brgyad du gyes pa'i steng na/ rje btsun sku zil pa khrom me bzhugs nas 'dug pas/ khyed rnams de 'dra ma byed mched grogs la dam tshig nyams pa yin/ kho thag ring nas 'ong pa thang chad khams 'dus pa de la sems bsos byon skyems gyis gsungs pa dang*/ de nas ras chung pa byon nas gdung dbyangs ring mo phul bas/ me tog gi char pa yang babs so// gzhan yang dwags po lha rje pa dbus na bzhugs pas bla ma'i sku drin dran nas yar byon pas/ lam kha (453)nas gtam ngan gsan pas/ da rung thag ma chod nas yar byon pas/ yar lung mda' nas bden par thag chod pas/ yug cig thugs dran med du song*/ de nas brgyal ba sangs pa dang*/ sku brang brdungs/ dbu skra bral/ zhal du sa gsol nas bshums shing bzhugs pas/ nam mkha' la rje btsun gyi gsung gcig grags nas yar ltas pas/ rje btsun seng ge la chibs nas bar snang la bzhugs 'dug pas/ bu ston pa kho de/ de bzhin ma byed dran pas bzung gsung pa dang*/ der spyan chab ni ma thub ste/ gsol 'debs kyi gdung dbyangs 'di ltar phul/ na mo rat+na gu ru bh+yaḥ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// skur gyur mtshan ldan ras pa'i rje// pha nam mkha'i dbyings su gshegs tsam na// khyung chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// chu bo'i gting du gshegs tsa na// nya chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// gangs dkar gyi rtse la gshegs tsa na// seng chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// 'gro drug gi nang du gshegs tsa na// pad+ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// rje chos kyi dbyings su gshegs tsa na// sangs rgyas lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// rje sngar yang sku drin mi chung che// da rung dbang bskur byin gyis brlobs// ces gsungs nas/

yar la (454)phyi chu dbar du byon rtsis mdzad pas/ rje btsun gyi sku mi mngon par/ gsung bar snang la 'di skad byon te/ nga'i zhwa de khyod la skur byas yod/ da yar ma 'gro bar phar song gsung pa'i sgra byon nas/ de nas phar log nas byon pa la/ phyis ras chung pa'i drung du byon dus dbu zhwa yang snang ngo*// gzhan yang de'i dus su phyogs thams cad na bu slob dang yon bdag la sogs pa'i rgyal khams na/ 'gro ba mi dang mi ma yin pa'i sems can rnams la dag snang dang byin rlabs gnang ba la tshad med pa'o// khyad par du gdan sa dpal gyi sman lung chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang de yang*/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan du ma thob pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dang khyad par med pa gcig pur gnyis med sgom pa'i ldum ra lta bu/ nags tshal dben pa'i kun dga' ra ba/ kun tu bzang po'i tshal rab chen po/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro mas bsngags pa du ma brjod pa'i grub gnas rtags can/ sgo gsum mi dge ba'i phyogs mtha' dag dang bral ba'i sa phyogs dkar po dge ba'i bag chags rnams rang bzhin gyis 'thug pa/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga ma spangs (455)par/ ye shes lnga lhun gyis grub pa/ rang byung byang chub chen po sgrub pa'i 'od khang chen po/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs kyi bka' sdod byed pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi bsod nams dpag med las grub pa/ sman dang rtsi shing sna tshogs yid du 'ong zhing mdzes pa/ gtsang chab gnyis kyi sgra snyan yid du 'ong ba/ gangs ri mu tig gi phreng bas bskor ba/ sa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su/ chos 'byung rnol ma zur rtsegs su bris pa/ rgong la 'khor lo rtsibs dgu'i phyi rim du/ me ri dang rdo rje'i ra bas skor ba/ rgyab ri dung gi zla mtshan tshes pa 'dra pas rig pa'i dngas snyigs phyed cing*/

ma rig pa'i mun pa rang bzhin gyis sel ba/ mdun du bon ri mched gsum sgo gsum gus pas 'dud pas ngan song rtogs pas gnon pa/ g.yas na gnas so dge bsnyen rin chen byang chub seng ge'i 'gying tshul du 'dug pas/ mchog sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal ba/ 'og na klu'i rgyal po dung sgra'i pho brang yod pas/ 'dod pa'i log sred med pa/ yang dben 'bri lci skyed phug gi 'gram na/ klu'i rgyal po dung sgra'i rna ba g.yon pa yod pas/ sgrub pa po la phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung ba/ don la phyag rgya chen po'i (456)sgrub gnas der/ bla ma rje btsun chen po mid la ras chen gyis rdo rje'i gdan du byin gyis brlabs pa yin la/ gzhan yang bla ma mid la ras chen dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje des/ rgya gar lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo dang*/ bod dang*/ shar/ tsong kha dang*/ rma shod dang*/ bal po dang*/ mon dang*/ hor ser la sogs kyi gnas chen dang*/ ri khrod dang*/ bas mtha' rnams la zhabs kyis bcags nas/ 'gro ba mtha' dag la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub gnang ba byin pa ni tshad las 'das pa'o/ de rnams kyis ni sku tshe 'di dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa yan chad kyi mdzad pa dang phrin las rdzogs par bkod pa yin cing*/ da lta ni 'og min chos kyi pho brang na/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sems dpa' chen po kun dga'i blo gros zhes bya ba'i mtshan bzung nas chos sku dri bral rtogs pa dang ldan par dag pa ye shes kyi sa thob nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i drung du/ dam pa'i chos gsan cing bzhugs pa nyid yin te/ de yang sngon longs sku lus med ma dang*/ tai lo pa dang*/ na ro pa la sogs pa gong ma rnams kyi lung bstan dang*/ rje btsun lho brag mar pa paṇa chen (457)gyi zhal bzhes dang*/ rje btsun chen po mid la ras chen rang gi zhal nas gsung ngag khyad par 'phags pa rnams dang*/

thugs kyi sras mchog ras chung rdo rje grags pa la sogs pa'i bu chen rnams kyis kyang gsungs la/ khyad par du rje khyung tshang pa dzña na gu ru dang*/ lnga rig shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa/ chos rje zhang lo ts+tsha ba'i gsung la gsal bar bzhugs cing*/ dpal phag mo grub pa rdo rje rgyal po'i skyes rabs las kyang gsal bar bstan pa nyid do// longs sku sprul sku gnyis kyi sku ni bsam gyis mi khyab la/ da lta yang longs sku lus med mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin pa'i sprul sku rnams dang/ nā ro chos drug mgo rtsa ma log par 'dzin pa'i gang zag dam pa rnams ni/ bla ma mid la ras chen gyi sprul sku lags so// gzhan yang bla ma mid la ras pa'i rje btsun rang zhal bzhugs gong gi bu chen grub thob chen po pho mo nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ de yang pho nyi shu/ mo lnga yin/ thugs kyi sras bzhi ni/ khab gung thang ra ba'i gnyan chu ras pa rdo rje grags pa dang*/ lcim lung gi ngam rdzong ras pa dang*/ mdo bkra'i se paṇa ras pa dang*/ sta mo gling kha'i 'bri sgom ras pa dang bzhi ni thugs kyi sras bzhi yin no// nye ba'i sras brgyad ni/ ras (458)chung zhi ba 'od dang*/ ras chung sangs rgyas skyabs dang*/ ras chung rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ ras chung tsang yu ba dang*/ rong chung ras pa dang*/ glan sgom ras chung dang*/ bshen sgom ras chung dang*/ mkhar chung ras pa dang brgyad yin no// dam pa rgyags chung ba dang*/ li khor phyag ru ba dang*/ dwags po lha rje pa dang*/ skyo ston shag 'gu dang*/ 'o na ston dge 'dun dang*/ dre ban bkra shis dang drug ni/ sku bgres kha'i sras drug yin la/ de bzhin du zhal slob rnams dang*/ gzhan yang mkhas grub du ma rnams kyi gsung sgros nor bu rin po che'i thum bu'am/ za 'og gi ras ma'am/ mkhal ma dang snying gi dum bu 'dra ba/ don la skyur ma rgyu med pa rnams la/ lo grangs mang rab kyi gong nas/

dge slong g.yung ston zhi byed ri khrod pas/ brtags gzhig legs par byas pa ni/ dper na mda' mkhan gyi mig gam/ khab mig du skud pa 'dzud pa bzhin nam/ ri la bug pa rko ba'am/ shan pa tshil ba 'khrud pa'am/ rgya rtsis pa gab tshe bkram nas ju yag rtsi ba bzhin byas pa yin pas/ 'di la the tshom za mi dgos par yod pa'am/ spyir yang rgya gar nag bod gsum du 'gyur tshad (459)kyi rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag gi rigs la ngas ma mthong ba dang*/ ma thos pa tsam med la/ bla ma mid la ras chen gyi chos bskor la gsung tshig gcig tsam yang ma lus par thob cing*/ de yang thog mar skyes nas zla ba bcu gcig lon tsa na/ ma sku drin can de'i drung na rje btsun mid la ras chen gyi mgur rnams thob/ de nas lo ngo gsum pa'i dus na rim pa bzhin du bla ma ri pa dkon rgyal ba dang*/ bla ma ri pa pad+ma dbang po dang*/ bla ma ri pa byang bsod pa dang*/ ris sad ye ba dang*/ bla ma nam mkha' snying po dang*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje ye shes pa dang*/ bla ma chu ras pa dang*/ chu dbon pa dang*/ hor dkar reg bshes dang*/ lha rje bde ba dang*/ ri pa dbang bzang dang*/ bla ma bde mchog dpal dang*/ bla ma rgyal dgon pa dang*/ dge bshes stabs dgon pa dang*/ bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje dang*/ gdan sa dpal gyi sho dgon pa dang*/ de'i mkhan po pa dang*/ la sa mkhan chen pa dang*/ dge bshes gu ru mdo pa dang*/ stag lung pa'i bla ma 'de bde ba dang*/ bla ma kam tshang rgyal ba dpal dang*/ bla ma rgyu shal ba dang*/ bla ma nam dgod pa dang*/ sku drin can dpal sgra ras chen dang*/ sku drin can (460)bla ma gcod pa dang*/ karma pa'i ri pa dge 'dun gzhon nu dang*/ dge bshes ye 'bum dang*/ dge bshes sher bzang dang*/ rgu lung dge bshes dang*/ ras pa bzang rga ba dang*/ bla ma mgo ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ bla ma lha stong ri dbon pa dang*/ de la sogs pa rnams kyi drung du/

rje btsun mi la ras chen gyi chos bskor dang*/ rnam thar dang*/ mgur 'bum rnams zhus/ karma dang*/ lha sding dang*/ brag dkar dang*/ sga lung dang*/ spung ri dang*/ yul phug dang*/ rta rna dang*/ 'bri khung dang*/ 'tshal gung thang dang*/ mtshur phu dang*/ 'u ri dang*/ de rnams kyi rin po che rnams dang*/ mkhan slob ri dge la sogs dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang gsung gleng zhib mo rang byas pa lags te/ bdag cag rang zhib par 'dug la/ rje mar pa lo ts+tsha ba'i chos skor phal che ba ni/ chos rje rin po che dpal ldan glang 'khor ba sku mchod kyi drung du thob pa yin la/ rje la shing pa mkhan chen sha ri pradzña'i drung du yang mang rab thob lags/ rje la stod pa'i drung du yang mang rab thob/ rje rin chen zur khang pa'i drung du gdan bzhi'i 'pho ba thob/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi nyams khrid dang zhib rgyas rnams phal cher ni/ bla ma (461)ri khrod kyi dbang phyug skyes mchog ma ṇi ba'i drung du thob pa yin lags/ de rnams kyi thob yig dang*/ rgyud yig rnams zur na gsal/ don la rje mar pa lho brag paṇa chen gyi chos skor rnams la shākya'i dge slog g.yung ston zhi byed ri khrod pas/ ma thob pa rang med pa 'dra lags/ rje mar pa'i skor la/ snya nam 'brug gi bla ma gzi brjid rgyal mtshan pa las mkhas pa ni bod gangs can khrod na mi 'dug ste/ rten 'brel cig gi gnad kyis/ ngas zhu ba mang byung lags/ rje btsun mid la ras chen rang gi rnam thar la/ bla ma mkhas btsun gzi brjid rgyal mtshan pa las kyang*/ nga rgyus che che tsam 'dug lags/ don la rje mar pa'i rgyud pa 'dzin tshad la ga dar legs par bcad pa yin no// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ longs sku lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ tai lo pa dang*/ nā ro pa dang*/ mar pa/ mid la ras chen yab sras kyi chos skor la mos pa rnams kyis mid la'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa skad zer nas/

don la thugs tsam na rgyab log ma byed par 'bad pa thob pa thon cig /gnas nges med du 'dug pa yang yang spos cig /rang don yin no// chos dang gang zag brgyab log byed pa mang rab 'dug go /(462)re cig 'chi khar mi 'tsher ba re dgos so// de don thams cad hril gyis dril/ 'ub bsdus/ bcangs bcangs/ btsir btsir nas lag len du byed na/ spyir bka' mdo rgyud dang yang de mthun pa dang*/ dgos pa bla ma mid la ras pa'i rnam thar ni/ chos de rang 'jig rten ma 'dres par/ dngul chu'am/ rgun 'grum gyi chang bzhin du/ kho rang bzhin rjen pa rang bzhin du nyams su len dgos gsung pa'o// de bzhin du ya rabs rnams kyi thugs la bcangs par zhu/ de ni bla ma mid la ras pa'i rnam thar lo rgyus 'di mthong zhing thos pa'i dus na mchi ma rang dbang med par 'byung ba dang*/ lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba dang*/ mi rtag pa btsan thabs su skyes na/ bskal pa stong gi sdig pa 'dag cing*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yang*/ bla ma mid la ras chen gyi thugs kyi sras dam par 'gyur ba ni gdon mi za ba yin no// dus kyi mchod pa byed na/ rta pa zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi la yin no// mngon rtogs sgom par 'dod na/ sku lus gru bzhi la sku bong ring rgyu tsam med la/ zhal ras khyil le ba la shangs leb leb/ spyan dkyus phra seb la spyan rtsa dmar tshil le ba/ (463)dbu'i skra mtshams yar la zhur bag tsam yod pa/ tshems zur dum sngo rtsal dkar se ba/ zhal gyi g.yas g.yon steng na sme ba sran ma phyed tsam yod pa/ dbu skra ra tsa pa khrin bungs sa le ba nag la smug pa/ sku sha sngo smug la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ 'di rnams gsung lhad med yin pas/ da man chad yi ge la phri bsnan la sogs dang*/ tshul ma yin pa'i dpe rkun nam/ bka' lung med par ja chod dang gzu lums sam/ ma rabs pa'i bya ba byas na/ dpal ma hā kā la gri gug lcam dral 'khor bcas kyis snying khrag thon cig

/rang bzhin lta ba sus 'dras kyang skyon med na yang*/ bag yod par byos shig /chos 'di'i bskor bdag ni/ sprul pa'i dpa' mo bkra shis tshe ring ma sku mched 'khor bcas yin la/ bka' sdod pho nya las mkhan ni/ rtsa mkhar sgong gi brag sbal ba kha gdangs dang*/ rtsa'i brag dmar dang*/ shangs kyi gza' gdongs dmar nag dang*/ yar lung skyur po grong gi klu btsan dang/ lho brag gi chu mon khrod dang*/ gzhung ri bo sgang gi lha btsan dang*/ brag dkar gyi thol btsan dang*/ 'brog la phyi'i rgyal po thang srin dang*/ chu dbar gyi gnas po rin chen byang chub dang*/ klu rgyal dung (464)sgra dang*/ dur khrod kyi sha za spun bdun dang*/ chu mig dngul 'bum gyi klu mgon ya med dang*/ stong shod kyi klu dung sras dang/ pha wong grod phug gi lha rgyal btsan po dang*/ la phyi chu bzang ma dang*/ gangs te rtse'i lha btsan dkar po la sogs pa'i bka' sdod gnyan po rnams yod pas/ bag yod par gyis shig /bka' lung legs par zhu ba gal che'o// ras chung snyan rgyud kyi khrid dang bka' lung thob pa yin na/ 'di'i zur du lung ma thob kyang gzhan la lung byas pas chog pa yin no// dpe cha bzhengs na rin po ches bzhengs dgos so// sgom chen pa blos btang ri khrod 'grim pa cig yin na shog skya la snag tshas bris na yang rung bas 'bri bar zhu/ lar thams cad kyis bla ma mid la ras pa'i snying rus dang*/ dka' spyad la sems la chos phyir 'bad pa thon cig /bka' brgyud ma nor ba/ bla ma ma nor ba/ gdams ngag ma nor ba/ sgrub gnas ma nor ba/ nyams len ma nor ba/ 'phrin las ma nor ba/ gdul bya ma nor ba/ bsngo ba dang smon lam ma nor ba 'di rnams gal che ba yin no// lam tshang la ma nor ba lhun gyis grub par shog /de dag gis ni snying rus dang sdug sran can gyi (465)yar des yar rtser gyur pa'i bla ma rin po che skyes mchog mi la ras chen zhes bya ba'i dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rtsod zla thams cad bral ba/

sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu'i lo rgyus rnam par thar pa/ gsal byed nyi zla'i 'od zer gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun chos po mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo grangs gnyis brgya dang drug cu rtsa dgu/ chu mo glang gi lo 'dis 'gro bar 'dug cing*/ de'i dus na smon 'jug gnyis kyi sbyor ba nye bar bsgrub pa dang ni/ spyir bka' drin can gyi bla ma dang*/ slob dpon nyis brgya dang*/ bdun cu'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas gtugs nas/ rgya gar nag bod gsum na yongs su grags tshad kyi bka' mdo rgyud dang*/ lung man ngag phal cher mthong zhing thos la/ khyad par du yang chos kyi rje rin chen dpal ldan glang 'khor ba'i thugs la skyes nas/ lam dam pa'i chos yin pa dang*/ ma yin pa phyed par nus pa'i mig dang ldan pa/ shākya'i dge slong g.yung ston zhi byed ri khrod pas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs wa ti bzang po'i bzhugs gnas mang yul skyid grong gra'i rtse mo ngang pa'i ri khrod du/ chu mo glang lo rta pa zla ba'i yar tshes (466)brgyad kyi nyin mo nas/ yi ger bkod pa'i dge bas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis ni/ bag chags dri za'i grong khyer bcom/ gnyis snang mtshan ma rnam par dag /skye med 'od gsal chen por rtogs// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo de// ma spangs rang rig rnam par dag /ye shes dbang phyug cod pan can// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /drag po'i 'gal rkyen gser 'gyur cing*// zhe sdang chos dbyings 'ja' ltar yal// bsam gyis mi khyab sprul pa'i sku// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /lus srog yal dor chos phyir dka' ba spyad// 'jig rten skyon bral bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrubs// tshe gcig mngon par byang chub brnyes pa yi// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig

/rtag tshams 'dzin pa'i phyogs rnams dug can zas ltar spangs// sdod gnas nges med 'dzol mo'i rnam thar bzhin// gnas chen bas mthar sangs rgyas sems la rnyed// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob gyur par cig /mthong dang thos dang (467)dran dang regapa rnam pa rnams// yun ring mi thogs bde chen sa la 'god// dpal ldan yid 'ong skye dgu'i yum cig ltar// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /mdzad mchog rmad byung mthar phyin don dang ldan// snang dang mi snang srid pa'i dra ba rab tu 'joms// sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral yong mi mnga'// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skyes mchog 'ga' byon yang*// dka' thub mthar phyin yar dpe yongs kyi gnas// don ldan rgyal sras skyes bu mtshungs pa med// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /sdug bsngal ba'i gdangs rnams 'gag med par// thabs dang shes rab rnam par dag byed cing*// yon tan rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rab rdzogs pa'i// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /gang zhig bla ma'i bka' las mi 'da' zhing*// zhen dang bcas pa'i gdung sems dbyings su yal// theg mchog mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgyud bka' lung 'chang*// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /rim gnyis rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yongs bsdus nas// tshul min las rnams ring du rab spangs nas// sku gnyis mngon gyur chos spyan rnam par gzigs// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /'dod yon dug lo spangs nas zwa thug bdud rtsir gsol// dam chos rgyal (468)ba'i gsung rnams yongs su bsdus// snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i gsung mnga' ba// bla ma mid la ras pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /btsun pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'di btab pas// 'gro ba ma lus rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog

/kye ho rnal 'byor dbang phyug mid la rje// ras pa'i rgyal po snyan sgra can// dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje de// mi bzhugs chos dbyings gshegs shul du// rjes 'jug chu bran grangs mang yang*// yan lag brgyad ldan bdag nyid yin// shākya'i dge slong g.yung ston la// dus da lta zhi byed ri par grags// bdag 'di nas shi 'phos 'gro dus na// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi zhing khams mchog /dga' ldan yid byed pho brang dam pa der// mi dbang byams mgon rgyal ba'i drung du 'gro// der yang rang nyid zhi bde'i theg chung mi 'dzin par/ dri med theg chen rnam thar legs spyad nas/ zab yangs bstan pa'i snying po rab sgrags nas/ ma rgan 'gro ba ma lus mtha' yas rnams// bla med rdo rje 'chang gi sa la 'god par shog /rtsod bral nam mkha' chen po'i gha rje ra// mtshan don ldan skyes mchog glang 'khor ba// dpal kun mkhyen chos rje man chad nas// tshig (469)bzhi'i chos 'brel yan chad du// gus pas 'gro ba'i don du zhus// drin thob nyis brgya bdun cu yi// dri med pad zhabs gus pas blangs// rgyal dang de sras 'phags tshogs rgyud par bcas// bka' dang bstan bcos man ngag bod 'gyur rnams// yongs 'dzin g.yung ston zhi byed ri khrod pas// rgya chen rnam dag smon lam btab pa rnams// shi med pos dang gser 'gyur rtsi bzhin du// 'gro la phan phyir rnam mkhyen myur thob shog /na mo sangs rgyas bden cing chos kyang bden// de bzhin dge 'dun bden pa yis// ji ltar bsams bzhin 'grub par shog /gzhan yang phyogs dus thams cad na// mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// bde legs bkra shis phun tshogs zhing*// 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog /dang po rje btsun chen po grongs nas lo nyis brgya dang drug bcu rtsa dgu song ba'i dus dang*/ nyi zla 'od zer ma rgyas bsdus gnyis// mnga' ris mang yul skyid grong gi rtse mo ngang pa'i ri khrod du yi ger bkod pa yin la/
