yang rje btsun chen po grongs nas nyis brgya dang bdun cu rtsa bdun song dus na/ he ru ka'i pho brang sman lung chu dbar zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog chen po/ (470)bla ma mid la ras pa'i gdan sa yi// bla ma ri khrod pa rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rin chen pa dang*/ de'i yang sku drin can gyi bla ma ri khrod kyi dbang phyug rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa dang ldan pa'i mtshan rin chen gzhon nur grags pa'i skyes bu dam pa des kyang*/ thugs dgongs yongs su dag par mdzad pa dang*/ de bzhin du gnas gsum gyi ri pa rnams kyis drag tu bskul ba dang*/ khyad par du yang rigs rgyud can ta'i si tu chos kyi rin chen zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la gus pa dang ldan pa de'i chos skyong ba'i blon po rin po che lta bu'i dge slong gi byang sems dang ldan pa'i/ dpon bsod nams mgon pos kyang brtan pa'i zhabs tog dang*/ sems can gyi bde skyid la rgyud dkar po yongs su dag pa bzung nas/ 'bad pa chen pos bskul zhing*/ smon 'jug gi rnam par dkar ba la brten nas sngar bas kyang cung zad rgyas su btang ba yin la/ yang la la na re/ rje btsun chen po rgung rta stag lo pa yin pa la the tshom med la/ bya'i lo la grongs pa yang the tshom med la/ de'i bar lo brgyad bcu gya gnyis las mi 'gro'am zer ba la/ rje btsun chen po rang gi gsung dri ma med pa dang*/ (471)ras chung rdo rje grags pa la sogs pa'i bu chen rnams dang*/ khyad par du rje khyung tshang pa/ dzña na gu ru dang*/ de'i bu chen khams pa dar ma dpal dang*/ mnga' ris pa ye shes grags pa dang*/ ma cig ong co dang*/ mar ston tshul 'byung dang*/ stad sgom zhig po blo gros dang*/ de rnams gsung mthun la/ mnga' rigs shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa/ chos rje zhang lo ts+tsha ba grub pa dpal bzang po'i dgongs pa la/ rgya rtsis bod rtsis dang*/ snga shul phyi shul gyi khyad par yin la/

don la sku 'khrungs nas mya ngan las 'das kyi bar la/ zhag gcig rtsis gnyis grangs kyi dgung lo brgyad bcu bzhi byon pa la the tshom mi za bar byed do// da ni don hril gyis dril na/ bla ma mid la ras chen gyi sku tshe gang la/ zhabs kyi gom pa gang du byon pa dang*/ gsung tshig gcig gang du byon pa rnams la/ lhag lus skra'i rtse mo tsam cig kyang ma lus par g.yung ston zhi byed ri khrod pa bdag gis yi ger bkod nus pa yod do// dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can ngan pa sangs rgyas stong gis kyang ma thul ba rnams slar la las ngan ga nas sog mi shes pas 'di tsam la bsdus pa yin no// yang nyin gcig rje btsun chu dbar rgyab ri na yar gshegs song ba (472)dang*/ ras chung rnams kyis yang phyin pas/ ri gdong skam po gcig na/ sngar med pa'i chu mig sngo sil le ba cig 'dug pa dang*/ ras chung rnams yid ches nas/ chu mig 'di gang nas byung ba yin zhus pas/ mid la'i zhal nas/ bod kyi mid la ras pa la// dngos grub bdud rtsi'i chu mig 'di// zhing skyong sga rus phul ba yin// 'on kyang de nyid yin snyam med// gsung yang la la na re/ rje btsun chen pos/ rgya gar du rdzu 'phrul gyi byon pa ma gtogs pa/ dngos su ma byon zer ba yang 'dug ste/ rgod bro rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phur zhing gshegs pas ka chog nyen yod do// la lung kha cig rgal nas rdul tsa re 'gro dgos par mi 'dug go /yang la la na re/ rje btsun chen po grongs pa da lta sku 'bum bzhugs pa der yin bya ba 'dug ste/ de ni ma lags so// yang dben gyi g.yon phyogs kyi chos khri dkar chung la sku rgyab gtad nas/ der grong tshul bstan nas gdung gsum bzhag pa'i gdung cig po de yang dben gyi nang du gdan drangs nas/ sprul pa'i 'bri lce'i mdun der bzhus par 'dug go /rje btsun gyi tshems gcig 'bri khung pa'i bla ma lho pa rin po che rdo rje dpal ba'i (473)phyag na bzhugs cing 'dug zer la/

yang tshems gcig gar shed kyi dgon pa gcig na bzhugs cing 'dug zer te/ ngas rtsad ma chod la/ tshems de la dang po khu bo pha 'us brdungs nas bcag zer ba de kun yin nam/ yang na dus phyis sku sgres nas byon pa ni mi srid dam/ rje khyung tshang ba dang*/ chos rje zhang gi zhal gsal ni mi 'dug lags/ byang gi ra rdzis phul ba'i bal gra dkar po dang*/ rgya thul rang mgar nag gi phul ba'i me lcags dang*/ gsol zhal ba men gyi ra phor dang*/ a ban tshong pas phul ba'i rba'i ber lcag dang*/ bal po'i chos rgyal gyis phul ba'i nam bza' ras 'ga' dang*/ de rnams ni mdo khams kyi dpal gyi ri bo che'i dgon par bzhugs par 'dug zer te mthong ba ni med la/ rje khyung tshang ba dang*/ zhang lo tsha ba'i zhal gsal yang mi 'dug /shar tsong kha'i rgyal pos 'dam seng dkar mo'i 'o mas bkang nas phul ba'i/ gsol zhal la shing phor dang*/ phyag gshan gri chung sor bzhi pa dang*/ de nyis bdag cag gi lag du byon nas bzhugs pa'i byon tshul rgyud yid dang bcas pa yod do// yang bla ma kyu ra rin po che'i 'bri khung pa la sogs pa kha gcig ni/ bcom ldan (474)'das don yod grub pa'i sku'i skye ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu grub snying po yin la/ de'i sku'i skye ba rje btsun mid la ras chen yin gsung ba yang 'dug la/ rje khyung tshang ba dang*/ zhang lo ts+tsha ba'i zhal gsal ni mi 'dug /yang la la na re sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ 'pho ba nā ro sdig rdug gnyis rje mar pas rje btsun mid la ras pa la/ lho brag rang du dngos su gnang ba yin bya ba yang 'dug ste/ de rang yin pa 'dra ste/ sras dar ma mdo sde grongs pa'i rjes nas/ ye shes mkha' 'gro la bskur bar byed do// rje khyung tshang pa dang zhang lo ts+tsha ba'i zhal gsal 'dug lags/ yang dwags po lha rje pas/ rje btsun gyi drung du/ zla ba dgu dang zhag bzhi las ma bzhugs par byed pa la/

rje khyung tshang pa dang zhang lo ts+tsha ba'i zhal nas/ de mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang rku ba'i phyir du phyed phyed gnang ba yin la/ don la zla ba bco brgyad zhag brgyad bzhugs par 'dug gsung bar gda' lags/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ dus phyis tsa na nga'i rgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis chos skor gdams ngag gi rgyud pa ma bcad cig gsungs so// bla ma mid la ras pas gsungs pa'i chos 'di'i rgyud pa ni/ (475)sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ lus med ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la ras pa/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ khyung tshang pa/ mnga' rigs pa ye shes grags/ sras grub chen zhig po rdo rje dpal/ yab bka' yin/ yum bka'i rgyud pa ni/ khams pa dar ma dpal/ rje 'dul dkar ba/ mkhas grub ram bhe ba/ bla chen rog shes rab 'od zer/ des chos rje nyi seng dang*/ chos rje brtson seng gnyis ka la gnang*/ des chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa la gnang*/ des chos rje kun dga' 'od zer dang*/ kun dga' don grub la gnang*/ des rje la stod pa la gnang*/ des chos rje glang 'khor ba sku mched la gnang*/ des bdag zhi byed ri pa la gnang*/ yang lugs gcig la/ ras chung pa yan chad gong dang 'dra/ ras chung pas rgyal ba rten ne la sgos skyes mdzad nas gnang bar 'dug ste/ gnas lugs kyang*/ sprul sku jo sras skyabs pa la/ ras pa dang dwags po lha rje gnyis kas/ khyed kyi sras 'di la grub thob chen po rnams kyi nang nas khyu rgyan cig 'byon par 'dug pas/ nged kyi yang rgyud pa 'dzin par zhu gsung nas/ bla ma mid la ras pa'i chos rnams gnang gda' 'o// rje btsun (476)rgyal ba rten ne dgung lo brgya rtsa la nye bar byon dus na/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa sku 'khrungs nas/ zla ba dgu song ba de la gnang gda'/ des chos rje kun dga' 'od zer dang*/ kun dga' don grub la gnang gda'/ des la stod pa la/ des chos rje glang 'khor ba sku mched la/ des bdag zhi byed ri pa la gnang*/

yang lugs gcig la mid la yan chad gong dang 'dra/ des ngam rdzong ras pa la/ des gung thang ras chung pa la/ des rgya 'pho ba lung pa la/ des rje btsan 'phrang ba la/ des chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa la/ de man chad sngar dang 'dra/ 'di rnams lus med ma'i snyan rgyud yin/ yang lugs gcig la/ khyung tshang pa yan chad gong dang 'dra/ des ma cig ong co dang*/ mar ston tshul 'byung dang*/ star sgom zhig po dang gsum ga la gnang*/ de gsum ka'i zhabs la mnga' rigs zhang lo ts+tsha ba grub pa dpal bzang pos thug gda'/ des tsho byed dha ra shri la/ des 'gro mgon bsod rgyal la/ des ye shes mkha' 'gro kun ldan dpal la/ des chos rje bya bral ba bde legs rin chen la/ des mkhas grub gzi brjid rgyal mtshan la/ des skyes mchog ri (477)khrod kyi dbang phyug ma ṇi pa la/ des bdag zhi byed ri pa la gnang ngo*// nā ro pa'i 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug dang*/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ nā ro sdig brdugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ lus med ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mid la/ dwags po lha rje pa/ ka la dung tsho ba/ mkhas btsun dmog ston pa/ des bdag zhi byed ri pa la gnang ngo*// bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ rngog gzhung pa/ rngog kun dga' gzi brjid/ lho skyid pa khams pa rin rgyal/ bzhi dhe pa grags pa shes rab/ rtsang ston bla ma rgyal mtshan/ brag gdeng pa rdo rje dpal/ zhang ston dkon mchog dpal/ zhang ston mchog ldan/ paṇa chen tshul khrims 'od/ chos rje glang 'khor ba sku mched/ des bdag zhi byed ri pa la gnang ngo*// yang lugs gcig la/ mar pa yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas yum bdag med ma nas kyang ded la/ rngog gzhung pa nas mid la ras pa/ de nas nā ro chos drug gi khrid 'debs na/ dbang ka 'di byed dgos pa yin la/ dus da lta ni dwags po lha rje'i brgyud par rdzus pa'i rmongs pa res rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs lha pho reng mo reng re'i sgo nas (478)dbang bskur zhing chos sgo 'byed par snang te/

des dbang bskur yang dbang thob ni mi thob/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang gdan gsum ma tshang na dbang bskur du mi 'gro ste/ dbang don ngo mi 'phrod pa'i phyir ro// phag mo'i byin rlabs rgyas bsdus rnams gtum mo'i sngon 'gro la dgos pa ni dgos te/ bdag med ma'i dbang 'di ni med thabs rang med do// lar chos la chos bzhin byed na dga' ste/ byed mkhan rang nyung bar snang ngo*// gzhan yang sgos bla ma mid la ras pa'i chos skor rnams ni ma tshang med par thob pa'i rgyu yig /thob yig dkar chag rnams zur na yod do// rnam thar 'di la brgyud pa dpag med cig yod de zur yod do// rje mar pa'i chos skyong gi 'thil ma ni gri gug ma yin ste/ ngo bo gur mgon dang*/ bka' gdams pa'i gri gug can dang gcig ste/ kye rdor khros pa yin no// da lta ni mar pa'i brgyud 'dzin du rdzus pa'i rmongs pa cig gis ni/ phyag bzhi pa gsar pa 'di la mar pa'i chos skyong dngos gzhi ru byed cing 'dug ste/ kha gzhang nor ba yin no// rje mar pas ni phyag bzhi pa'i lung re tsam zhus pa srid do// 'di ni khams pa rga lo'i drung du/ dpal phag (479)mo grub pa rdo rje rgyal pos zhus pa yin no// phag gru'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyis chos skyong dngos gzhi dang 'dra nyen yod dam/ 'on kyang mar pa la ltos na/ chos skyong ni gtso bo gri gug can yin no// bya rog gdong can 'di phyag bzhi pa'i las mgon zer yang*/ bka' brgyud spyi'i las mgon yin pas/ sus rten yang 'dra mod/ dwags po lha rje pa ni/ rje mi la'i gri gug can dang*/ bka' gdams pa'i gri gug can gnyis ka brten pa yin no// lar chos pa ci rigs pa rnams kyis bsam gzhig mi gtong bar/ rgod dang ngu gnyis kar bro ba rnams byed cing 'dug pa ngas mang po mthong ste/ ya ki phu nas kyi bka' mdo rgyud dang*/ grub thob gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros la lta rgyu med par/

bka' chad lung rdum gyi dpe cha 'khyar ma re la an thas phyogs med byas nas/ rang re lam log pas mi chog par/ skal med blun po dad pa can mang po yang phung bar 'dug ste/ snying re rje na/ lar yang dang po mkhas pa'i slob dpon mang rab cig brten dgos so// chos 'di ni skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma yin pas/ ga dar zhib po cig rang dgos so// las byas pa gron can du mi 'gro la don can yang (480)dag cig dgos pa yin no// rang rang gis nga'i de min bsam pa mi yong ste/ rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud dang rang rang gi nyams len zhu thug thub pa cig dgos pa lags so// lar chos la yar shor bzhi mar shor bzhi bya ba gsungs pa la/ yar shor bzhi ni lta ba thag chod/ sgom pa rang byung*/ bsgrub pa lhur len/ bslab pa lam zhugs pa dang bzhi yin/ mar shor bzhi ni tsha grod grang grod pa/ drod po chos rgyus can/ 'gal nag mgo 'dar dang bzhi yin/ don la lta ba ji ltar mtho ba tsam gyis spyod pa de zhib pa cig yong ba lags so// rgya bod kyi grub chen rnams kyang dgongs pa je zab la song ba dang*/ mi 'dris je chung ba btang nas/ mthar sangs rgyas pa dang snang ba ma dag pa rnams kyis mthong rgyu mi 'dug pa gang zag ya rabs rnams la/ gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa/ de'i mdun na thub pa bzhugs/ ces pa de lags so// lar chos kyi rtsa ba 'di mi rtag pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras rang gal che'o// bla ma tshad ldan cig med thabs rang med do// yang kha cig gis dran med lung ma bstan re la sgom du byed pa yang 'dug /kha cig gis go ba dga' rabs skyes (481)pa la de sgom du byed pa yang 'dug /bsod zad kha cig gis dpe cha 'dra blo la bzung nas gzhan la khrid 'debs zer nas/ 'phrin skyel byed pa yang 'dug ste/ zhe drang na ang*/ byed ni 'dod/ shes ni mi shes/ ngo tsha la snying rje bar 'dug ste/ yang kha cig sgom byas pas brjed ngas che ru song zer ba yang 'dug ste/

de ni shin tu blun pa'i gtam yin no// sgom byas pa ni rtsa mig je dngas/ rig pa je gsal sngar brjed pa thams cad dran nas 'ong ba yin/ mthar 'das ma 'ongs da ltar rnams kyang gsal ba la sogs so// lar sgom chen pa rab kyi yang rab la bar snang gi 'brug 'dra ba cig dgos te/ skad thon la gzugs mi mthong ba cig dgos pa yin/ rab la gangs kyi seng ge ltar du gzugs mthong yang bkol mi btubs pa cig dgos pa yin no// 'bring la ri rtsibs kyi sbyang khu 'dra ba cig dgos/ tha ma la mgron khang gi gnas po 'dra ba cig dgos/ mar shor tha chad ni mdo srang gi khyi 'khyams 'dra ba yin no// lar chos rang cig byed na/ rjen pa rang cig dgos so// da lta rang dbang rang la yod dus 'dir rang mgo rang gis ma bton na/ nang par bem rig bral dus su/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis kyang mi skyobs pa'i (482)dus cig yong ba yin no// sangs rgyas nus pa chung ba min ste/ rang snang ma dag tsa na/ rang snang rang la sdig pa lags so// lar khas mi phan don thog na sleb dgos/ rgyal khams kyi sprang po zhi byed pa khos mi tshe ri la skyal ba 'di/ skye shis rtag tu 'jigs pas lan pa 'dra/ dus da res dmar thag chod/ dkar thag gsal/ yin thog na sleb/ gdos thag chod pa 'di dpal ldan ding ri glang 'khor ba'i sku drin du 'dug go /yang kun mkhyen chos rje'i zhabs la reg pas/ nga khyi rgan mi khyur tshud 'dug go /da rang nyal bas chog pa'i gnad cig go nas 'dug go /'on kyang las rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa 'di ni dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ bka' mdo rgyud nas ma gnang ba lags pas/ gang zag rgyud log par kha ltas pa'i blun po rnams kyi rjes 'breng mi nyan pa gal che'o// rang gis mkha' ltar dag pa'i don rtogs kyang*/ las rgyu 'bras la gtso bor 'don dgos so// sangs rgyas shākya thub pas bdud mi nag mdung thung can bsgral bas/

zhabs la seng ldeng gi tsher ma zug pa dang*/ slob dpon klu grub snying pos/ sbur ba'i ske bcad pas khong rang gi dbu gnang dgos byung ba la (483)sogs rgya gar na yang gtam rgyud grangs med pa rnams 'dug cing*/ bod na yang chos rje sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ rje dam pa sangs rgyas la skur ba zhus pas/ chos rje pa'i spyan 'gribs cing*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mjal 'phro chad pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/ mid la ras pas ser ba phab pas lo grangs de tsam la gsol rgyu ma byung zhing*/ mthu mdzad nas mi mang po bsad pas rje btsun rang la/ dge bshes long ba tsag phug pas dug drangs pa la sogs pa gtam rgyud grangs las 'das pa rnams yod/ de yang khong zhing dag pa chos sku tshe 'dir smin thub pa yin/ rang re phal pa rnams kyis ni/ rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad nas dus 'dir smin ma nus na/ skye ba mang po'i mthar gegs chen po byed pa lags pas/ las rgyu 'bras la blo zhib po dgos so// me stag chung ngus ri rab chen po tshig pa yod do// nga zhi byed ri khrod pas ni skye ba ci rigs kyi gong nas shes bya dpag med la sbyangs pa dang*/ tshe 'dir yang bla ma slob dpon mkhas grub mang po dang mjal ba dang*/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho tsam mthong zhing thos pa dang*/ gnas chen dang ri khrod rnams su/ dka' ba dang 'bad pa byas nas sems dngos po'i (484)gnas lugs gtan la phab nas/ dus da lta ni chos dang chos min phyed pa'i mig dang ldan pas na/ chos pa'i gzugs brnyan bstan pa'i chom rkun sbyang khu 'gas ser rnams la/ ngas 'thab pa ni don dang ldan pa yin no// 'on kyang ngas ni chu dang rlabs sam/ rlung dang sgra'am/ me dang dud pa'i tshul du dran shar gnyis po la/ smon 'jug gnyis kyi rtsi dang 'bral ma myong nas yun ring song yod pas smras pa yin no// don tig pa la chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni/ bla ma mkhas grub cig gi gsung ma gtogs pa gzhan gang yang mi nyan pa cig dgos so// nyams len rdo rus thub nges pa cig dgos so// gnas chen dang*/

ri brag dang*/ bas mtha' rnams su nyams len skad cig kyang ma yengs pa cig dgos so// mdo rgyud phyogs med la lta rtog zhib po dgos so// bka' brgyud phyogs med kyi gdams ngag la thug dgos so// rtsa ba nyams len cig la dril dgos so/ dus da res mi lus lan cig thob pa 'di don yod pa cig dgos so/ chos kyi gnad shos dgos so// gnad khrol dgos so// gnad lam du khyer dgos so// lar rang sar sleb dgos so// chos la chos su shes pa dang*/ (485)chos la lam du go ba dang*/ chos la las su mthong ba dang*/ chos log par 'gro ba dang*/ 'di rnams shad phyed dgos so// 'di don rtogs pa'i gang zag ni nan ltar bzung ngo*// dkon no 'phra'o// thung ngo*// rim dang mi rnams/ rang yang thar la gzhan yang thar ba ni bya pa yod do// 'di dges 'gro rnams bla med byang chub thob par shog /re zhig rdzogs so// i thi/ lar ni bstan bcos la mdzad po las rgyud pa ded mi dgos pa lags so// 'on kyang bka' chad lung rdums du ma song ba cig gal che'o// spyir rje mar pa lho brag lo ts+tsha'i chos skor gyi lo rgyus la/ bla ma rje btsun chen po mid la ras chen zhib par byed pa yin/ rje mid la'i chos skor la/ ngam rdzong ston pa bho dhi rā dza zhib par byed do/ ngam rdzong ston pas bla ma mid la ras pa lo nyi shu rtsa bdun bsten par 'dug go /ras chung rdo rje grags kyis bar ma chad par lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsten par 'dug /lar ni snga phyi rang la ni lo mang rab phyag phyi mdzad par 'dug go /don la thugs kyi sras mchog ni ras chung rdo rje grags pa rang lags so// gzhan yang ras chung rnams kyi lo rgyus ni rang rang gi rnam thar na gsal lo// dwags po lha rje pas (486)zla ba dgu las ma brten par 'dug /lar thams cad kyi 'o tshod dang chos la thob rdzun mi nyan no// phyogs dus kun na dge legs shog

/lags 'di ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum gyi tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i skyabs kyi 'og nas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ri khrod pa'i spyan snga nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems stong nyid g.yo ba med pa'i ngang nas/ thabs bde stong gsal 'bum gyis ting nge 'dzin gong nas gong du bogs 'don pa'am/ shes rab blo 'das brjod du med pa las 'gag med kyi rtsa 'byongs nas gzhan phan thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas bsdu ba bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa la/ sku la bsnyel ba mi mnga' 'am/ cung zhig ma mjal gyi bar du/ thugs dam gyi rim pa la bsnyel ba med par bzhugs lags sam/ ces pa'i lan du/ dran chog rgyal po chos kyi rje/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin la/ bdag cag 'di ltar 'tsham par mchis lags ces pa'o// che ge mo'i spyan snga nas sku rnam dag /gsung rnam dag /gsung dri med/ thugs spros bral phyag rgya chen po'i (487)ngang nas thugs rjes 'gro don la ma bsnyel bar bzhugs lags sam/ ces pa'o// snyun dri'i cho ga dge'o// mid la'i zhal nas rang re gzims mal gyi nang du sleb tsa na/ gti mug gi ro nyal ma log par// nam srod la bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms// nam gung rje la gsol ba thob// tho rangs srog rtsol rlung la 'bod// nyi shar snang ba rgya yis thob// gtso cher sems la ltad mo ltos// ces pa 'di shing ri sna dmar du lha rje g.yeng la gsungs so// bla ma dkon mchog dang*/ khyung po mid la thos pa dga' klu grub mgon/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ dbang phyug mid la ras chen gyi zhabs la 'dud/ de yang thog mar mid la thos pa dgas/ glu sgrung blangs pa'i lo rgyus ni/ gtsang myang stod pa/ glu mkhan stong rtse sgro dmar pa la bslabs pa yin gsungs/

gang bslab na srid pa ba sbal 'khyung gsum gyi khogs phubs steng lha gling gi cag rtse dgu skor dang*/ bar gnyan gling gi dar dkar chag sgo dang*/ 'og klu gling gi sbrul nag 'khyil ba dang*/ tong rtse sgro dmar gyi kha phye nas klu rigs brgyad khri bzhi stong blangs zer yang*/ mid la thos (488)pa dgas bslabs tshad la/ rdo rje dol khrul chos pa rab byung gi glu/ rag sha ma ra sngags pa'i glu/ shug pa rtse rgyal bon po'i glu/ skya bkra chen po jag pa'i glu/ khyed bskyed der byung tshong pa'i glu/ stag g.yag seng gsum bu tsha'i glu/ brag gar rgod glag bu mo'i glu/ za'u za gtam rgan rgon gyi glu/ shul chung dgu 'gyur ra rdzi'i glu/ gar zun gar chod long ba'i glu/ nag chung gla rgod khyim pa'i glu/ lung gsum bzhi mdo rkun ma'i glu/ ku zi tong phran skyid pa'i glu/ de bzhin du/ zha'u sha skor gyi glu dang*/ rta glu rga glu dang*/ rma zla rtsing gsum dang/ bya gshen go bo'i sgro rtsis dang/ stong gro mi'i spu rtsis dang*/ pho gsar pa'i gab rtse dgu bskor dang*/ mo gsar pa'i lam brgya bcu dang*/ de bzhin du rgung rim pa bco brgyad kyi steng nas glu len pa dang*/ 'og gser gyi sa gzhi nas ngag 'bod pa dang*/ bar rgyal khams yangs pa nas tshigs bcad pa dang*/ de la sogs pa'i glu'i bye brag rnams dang*/ sgrung gi lo rgyus ni/ mi ro gser sgrung gang*/ skya ka'i mdo sgrung dang*/ 'chil pa'i byul sgrungs dang*/ lugs kyi skye bo gso thigs dang*/ rigs thigs dang*/ de rnams (489)rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa yin la/ rgya gar nas rgyud pa kho na yin la/ srid pa'i bshad pa'i glu'i rgyud pa ni/ phyad mu btsun gsum nas ston pa 'bong nge*/ a smrags sngon mo/ gnyan cog ro ma sangs khong 'khrul/ zhang a stag 'tshal pa'i glu mo thang bar mi chung dga' ste/ 'jang mo mi zan po zer/ ge sar pa 'khrul gyi nyi ma/

rje gyal btsan pa'i kun chod/ a rog a skyabs gla 'bum/ 'bum za glu'i mtsho mo/ dar a dpal gyi sga tsha ye ram/ srong mkhar skyos mkhar gnyan po ma ra/ ga thor rkyang gi 'phrang pa/ rtsang myang stod kyi rong rtse sgro dmar pa/ khyung po mid la thos pa dga'/ de'i glu yig rnams lho brag na bzhugs pa lcags yul ba rgan mo cig la 'dug pa/ rje btsun ras chung pa rdo rje grags pa la phul bar 'dug /des rje khyung tshang pa/ des ma cig ong co dang*/ mar ston tshul 'byung dang*/ star sgom zhig po dang gsum khar la gnang*/ de gsum kas chos rje zhang paṇa chen la/ des dha ra shri la/ des 'gro mgon bsod rgyal/ drin can ras ma chos rje bde legs rin chen/ ne dbon gnyis kas bla ma gzi brjid rgyal mtshan/ bla ma (490)skyes mchog chen po ma ṇi ba/ shākya dge slong zhi byed ri khrod pa/ lho brag na 'gro mgon rtsang pa rgya ras pa dang*/ chos rje rgod tshang pa dang*/ chos rje lo ras pa dang*/ slob dpon gsum kas rnyed nas/ grub thob me long rdo rje dang*/ sras blo ldan seng ge dang*/ grub thob o rgyan pa dang*/ dbu mdzad bkra shis dpal dang*/ de nas rim gyi rgyud pa cig kyang 'dug /rje khyung tshang pas khams pa dar ma dpal/ des 'dul dkar ba bla ma ro bhe ba/ yang rje khyung tshang pa/ rje btsun mnga' rigs pa ye shes grags des zhig po rdo rje 'od dpal/ des rog rab 'od zer/ des grub thob u rgyan pa/ des chos rje kun dga' don grub/ des rje la stod pa dang*/ mkhas btsun bsod 'od dang*/ bla ma zla seng dang*/ de rnams la gnang bar 'dug ste/ dang po bdag gi ni de 'dra la dgos pa med bsam nas don du ma gnyer ba lags te/ dus phyis bla ma gzi brjid rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ bla ma skyes mchog chen ma ṇi ba/ rje la stod pa mkhas grub chen po de dang*/ khong rnam pa'i zhal nas/ rje btsun mid la ras chen gyi rnam thar la/ de rnams med thabs med pa yin gsungs nas/

(491)der dang du blangs pa yin no// yang rje btsun ras chung pa/ dwags po lha rje/ dwags po sgom tshul/ zhang g.yu brag pa/ des rtogs ldan jo gdan rin ring dang*/ dpal phag mo grub pa rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ gnyis ka la gnang*/ de gnyis ka'i drung du chos rje 'bri lung pas zhus/ de nas dbon rin po che/ ring sing pa/ tad na shi ri/ bla ma bsam gtan byang chub pa dang gnyi ka'i drung du/ bla ma skyes mchog chen po ma ṇi bas zhus/ des zhi byed ri khrod pa la gnang ngo*// chos dang 'dres par gyur cig /maṅga lam//

༈ na mo rad na gu ru bh+yaḥ ye shes me 'od zer chen gyis// dug lnga'i rnam rtog sreg mdzad cing*// thugs rje'i chu rgyun dpag med kyis// nyon mongs dri ma kun bsal nas// dag pa'i lam la 'god mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan srung 'khor kun mkhyen chos rje la// sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs// spyir mkha' mnyam sems can la thugs rjes gzigs// dgos bdag blo'i pad+mo'i kha phye la// thugs mdzod ye shes myur du stsol// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang*// rdo rje 'chang sogs phyogs dus kun bzhugs rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams// khyed zhabs pad+mo bdag spyis (492)gus pas len// mkhyen ldan thugs rje can rnams brtse bas dgongs mdzod la// snyan rgyud dri med yid bzhin nor bu yi// lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdag la stsol// bdag dang sngon sbyangs las 'phro bzang po yis// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas bstan la dad pa thob// dam chos gangs ri'i khrod 'gyur bka' brgyud yongs zhabs spyi bos len// de phyir shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs shing*// yon tan kun rtsa sgrub la brtson byas pas// yun ring ma thogs mgrin pa'i rtsa kha phyes// 'on kyang dman pa'i sa bzung tshe 'dir rlung khyer byas// gnas chen ri khrod bas mtha' bdag gi pha yul yin// 'dre bdud ma rung yongs rnams bdag gi yon bdag yin// byur dang skal ngan log 'dren bdag gi thar lam yin// mdor na mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus bdag gi zab lam yin// de phyir gang snang thams cad dge slong zhi byed ri khrod pas// snyan rgyud dri med nor bu'i bla ma'i rgyud rim dang*// yul mchog nyer bzhi'i rna g.yon la phyi gangs ra'i bkod pa dang*// sprul sku'i pho brang brin dang chu dbar gyi bkod pa dang*// mid la ras chen (493)yab sras rgyud kyi bkod pa rnams// smon 'jug rnam gnyis mtshams sbyar gsal bar ston// dad ldan thos chung yod srid smon lam drag tu thob// thos chung sgom med rmongs pa 'ga' zhig gis// chos brgyad 'dod phyir skal med dad can blun po dog par 'khrid pa mthong*// de rnams snying rjes ma bzod theg chen don brtan yang*// dung dkar sol bar mthong bzhin slar la los lta rgyas// 'on kyang rgyal ba thugs rje can rnams dbyings nas gzigs// slan chad 'gro rnams bde chen rdo rje 'chang thob shog
/snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i bla ma rgyud rim dang*// rje btsun chen po mid la ras chen yab sras kyi mdzad pa// dge slong zhi byed ri khrod pas bkod pa rdzogs so/// /sarba maṅga lam/
